options: A. is made from human skin which is soft and sensitive

questions.analysis:
60.细节理解题。根据“In the future, the skin could be used to develop robots that are better than existing robots and are not easily damaged over time.”可知，在未来，这种皮肤可以用来开发比现有机器人更好的机器人，并且不会随着时间的推移而损坏。故选D。
考向二、记叙文
解题演练：做记叙文的时候先将事情发生的时间、地点，人物弄清楚。然后了解事件发生经过。也可以带着问题进行阅读。

It happened two years ago. It was Mother’s Day morning. I was doing my shopping at our local supermarket with my five-year-old son, Tenyson. As we were leaving, we found that only minutes earlier an elderly woman had fallen over at the entrance and had hit her head on the ground. Her husband was with her, but there was blood everywhere and the woman was embarrassed(尴尬的) and clearly in shock. Walking towards the scene, Tenyson became very sad about what had happened to the couple. He said to me, “Mum, it’s not much fun falling over in front of everyone.”
At the front of the supermarket a charity group had set up a stand selling fish and chips and flowers to raise funds. Tenyson suggested that we should buy the lady a flower. “It will make her feel better,” he said. I was amazed that he’d come up with such a sweet idea. So we went over to the flower seller and asked her if we could buy a flower for the lady to cheer her up. “Just take it,” she replied. “I can’t take your money for such a wonderful gesture(姿势).”
By now paramedics（救援人员）had arrived, and were attending the injured(受伤的) woman. As we walked up to her, my son became intimidated by all the blood and medical equipment(器具). He said he was just too scared to go up to her.
Instead I gave the flower to the woman’s husband and told him, “My son was very sad for your wife and wanted to give her this flower to make her feel better.”
At that, the old man started crying and said, “Thank you so much, you have a wonderful son. Happy Mother’s Day to you.”
The man then bent down and gave his wife the flower, telling her who it was from. Though badly hurt and shaken, the old lady looked up at Tenyson with love in her eyes and gave him a little smile.

questions.prompt: Which word is close to the underlined word “setbacks”?
questions.analysis: 34.词义猜测题。根据“The road to progress is not always smooth. Most progress often comes with setbacks along the way”可知通往进步的道路并不总是平坦的，大多数进步往往伴随着挫折，故此处划线部分意为“挫折，困难”，和difficulties意义相近。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解（说明文，议论文）-备战2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which can be a proper title for the text?
options: B. Keys to Speeding up Progress
questions.analysis: 35.最佳标题题。本文主要介绍了如何取得进步，虽然通往进步的道路不总是平坦的，但是只要我们继续努力，我们就会达到更高的水平，以选项A“关于进步的想法”为标题最合适。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解（说明文，议论文）-备战2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, free time is a good chance for teenagers to ________.
questions.analysis: 1.细节理解题。根据“Free time is a good chance for teenagers to have fun.”可知，空闲时间是青少年玩乐的好机会。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解（说明文，议论文）-备战2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Lin Tao supports his own idea by ________.
questions.analysis: 2.推理判断题。分析第二段内容可知，林涛用自己和同学的例子支持自己的观点，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解（说明文，议论文）-备战2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined words “get indulged in” in Para.(段落)3 probably mean ________.
questions.analysis: 3.词句猜测题。分析“Some guys may have a bad influence on him and some games like LARP(剧本杀) may mislead him. He might even get indulged in the stories and can’t get back to real life.”可知，有些人可能对他有不良影响，比如剧本杀，可能会让孩子们无法回到现实生活中，所以此处 get indulged in的意思是“沉迷，迷失”，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解（说明文，议论文）-备战2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, which of the following may Mr. Ma support?
options: A. He Kai’s parents are around every time he plays with his friends.
B. Feng Zhongfan’s parents never ask him about whom he plays with.
C. Liu Xiang goes out without knowing anything about the activities.
D. Xie Hao talks to his parents about the exact details before playtime.
questions.analysis: 4.推理判断题。根据“However, teenagers should find out the exact details(细节) about the activities before playtime. Then they can communicate with their parents and decide together whether they can go out to play alone.”可知，马博士认为青少年应该在游戏前弄清活动的具体细节，然后他们可以和父母交流，一起决定他们是否可以单独出去玩。选项D“谢浩在游戏前会和父母谈论游戏的具体细节”符合，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解（说明文，议论文）-备战2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined phrase “give it a shot” in the first paragraph most probably means ________.
questions.analysis: 1.词义猜测题。根据“we should keep working hard and give it a shot rather than complaining luck or fate.”可知，应该持续的努力工作，努力尝试而不是抱怨运气或是命运，划线短语的意思是“尝试一下”，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解（说明文，议论文）-备战2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What would the author relate her success to?
options: D. All of A, B, and C
questions.analysis: 2.推理判断题。根据“While we often question our failures and agree them with luck or fate (命运), we proudly relate our success to hard work.”可知，作者认为成功和努力以及运气和命运都有关系，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解（说明文，议论文）-备战2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following would be agreed by the author?
options: A. Hard work is not the only choice for most people.
B. People fail to achieve their dreams because of bad luck.
C. Hard work can determine one’s success.
D. Not all people’s dreams would come true through hard work.
questions.analysis: 3.推理判断题。根据“So hard work cannot be a determining (决定性的) factor for success”可知，努力工作不能成为成功的决定性因素，所以作者认为并非所有人的梦想都会通过努力实现。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解（说明文，议论文）-备战2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What would be the main idea of this passage?
options: A. Life is not always fair.
B. Luck matters, but hard work is a necessity.
C. Keep an eye on opportunity.
D. Work hard and fight against all odds.
questions.analysis: 4.主旨大意题。根据“But that should not stop us from working hard. We should keep fighting against the difficulties to achieve our dreams.”可知，本文主要表达了人生的机遇并不公平，运气也许很重要，但是努力工作是必要的。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解（说明文，议论文）-备战2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which suggestion is wrong when you worked hard in English learning for a period of time but failed in the last exam?
options: A. Ask your teacher or parents for help.
B. Think of what caused your failure and find better learning methods.
C. We should keep fighting against the difficulties to achieve our dream.
D. Working hard is useless and you can draw lots to choose keys for the next exam.
questions.analysis: 5.推理判断题。根据“But that should not stop us from working hard. We should keep fighting against the difficulties to achieve our dreams.”可知，文章说明即使努力可能会没有结果，但是也要努力去做，来实现自己的梦想，选项D“努力工作是没有用的，你可以抽签选择下一次考试的答案。”是错误的，不能靠运气，要依靠自己的努力，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解（说明文，议论文）-备战2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How does an energy-smart building save energy for heating and cooling?
options: C. It has special thick walls.
D. It has fewer room lights.
questions.analysis: 1．细节理解题。根据“An energy-smart building starts with thick walls. Special insulation(隔热材料)inside keeps heat inside in winter and keeps heat outside in summer. This saves energy for heating and cooling.”可知，厚墙内的特殊材料可以用于节省能源，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Bamboo is used instead of wood in green buildings because ________
options: A. it is a recycled material
B. it grows back much faster
C. it can keep the room warm
D. it can save a lot of money
questions.analysis: 2．细节理解题。根据“Bamboo looks like wood, but it’s actually a grass. It grows back 20 times faster than a tree.”可知，因为它的生长速度是树的20倍，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In Paragraph 4, the writer advises us to ________
options: A. build a whole new green building
B. pay attention to climate change
C. make small changes to our home
D. use only gas to cook our meals
questions.analysis: 3．细节理解题。根据“But you don’t need to build a whole new building. Simple changes like shading windows and planting trees can make any home greener—and a better Earth home for us all.”可知，对房屋作一些简单的改变，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When was the first dinosaur fossil discovered?
options: C. More than 65 million years ago.
questions.analysis: 6．细节理解题。根据“We have known about these strange living things for more than 200 years. Their fossil (化石) record was first discovered in 1818”可知恐龙化石于1818年首次被发现，即200多年前。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What are people sure about dinosaurs?
questions.analysis: 7．细节理解题。根据“We have a pretty good picture of their size and structure”可知我们对它们的大小和结构有一个很好的了解。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the main idea of Paragraph 4?
options: C. The size and structure of dinosaurs.
D. Some unknown things about dinosaurs.
questions.analysis: 8．主旨大意题。根据“We have a pretty good picture of their size and structure, but not much else is known for certain...”以及本段内容可知，本段主要介绍了关于恐龙的一些未知。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the best title for the text?
options: B. The places where dinosaurs lived
C. The reasons why dinosaurs died out
D. Known and unknown facts about dinosaurs
questions.analysis: 9．最佳标题题。本文主要介绍了我们对恐龙的已知和未知，以选项D“关于恐龙的已知和未知事实”为标题最合适。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the influence, Yue Opera is the ________ major Chinese operas.
questions.analysis: 10．细节理解题。根据第二段“Yue Opera, one of the five major Chinese operas (Peking Opera, Yue Opera, Huangmei Opera, Ping Opera, Yu Opera in the order of influence)”可知，越剧是中国五大戏曲种类之一（京剧，越剧，黄梅戏，评剧，和豫剧，按影响力排序），可见，越剧是“中国第二大剧种”。故选B。

source.sourceSection: （2023·福建厦门·厦门外国语学校校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the passage, you can learn the following about Yue Opera EXCEPT ________.
options: A. it has six major roles
C. it is an intangible cultural heritage
D. it is known as “Chinese drama” abroad
questions.analysis: 12．细节理解题。根据第二段“Yue opera started in Shaoxing, Zhejiang and later became popular in Shanghai.”可知，越剧起源于浙江绍兴，后来在上海流行起来。所以选项B描述错误。故选B。

source.sourceSection: （2023·福建厦门·厦门外国语学校校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The 4th paragraph mainly talks about ________.
options: A. why Voice of China is popular
B. what performers do in the show
C. how the special season runs
D. who the team leaders are
questions.analysis: 13．段落大意题。根据第四段“The special season has kept the form of Voice of China, inviting four experienced performers as team leaders to choose their team members. ... If someone’s singing wins their hearts, they can push a button to turn around the chairs to see the face of the performer.”可知，《中国好声音》特别季邀请了四位经验丰富的表演者作为团队领导者来选择他们的团队成员。表演者的歌声赢得了他们的心，他们才会转身看到演出者。由此可见，本段是在说中国好声音特别季是怎样运营的。故选C。

source.sourceSection: （2023·福建厦门·厦门外国语学校校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The topic of the passage is about ________.
questions.analysis: 14．主旨大意题。通读全文可知，本文由《中国好声音》特别季引入越剧，进而介绍越剧的起源、特点、角色等。由此推知文章的主题是关于文化和艺术的。故选C。

source.sourceSection: （2023·福建厦门·厦门外国语学校校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does Karen Bakker’s new book mainly talk about?
options: A. Why humans should protect animals.
B. How AI helps humans to understand animals.
C. When humans can get closer to animals.
questions.analysis: 15．细节理解题。根据“In Professor Karen Bakker’s new book, The Sounds of Life: How Digital Technology Is Bringing Us Closer to the Worlds of Animals and Plants, she talks about how AI is helping us to make an animal version”可知，这本书主要谈论了人工智能如何帮助我们制作动物版。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did elephants talk with each other?
options: C. By waving their big ears.
questions.analysis: 16．细节理解题。根据“elephants talk with each other using infrasound far below our human hearing range”可知，大象使用远低于人类听觉范围的次声波相互交谈。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “equipment” in Paragraph 3 mean in Chinese?
questions.analysis: 17．词义猜测题。根据“Scientists have placed listening equipment into these environments to pick up the sounds humans cannot hear.”可知，为了收集人类听不到的声音，需要一些设备，故此处划线部分意为“设备”。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we infer（推断）from Paragraph 4?
options: A. Scientists have got to know how bats argue with each other.
B. Israeli researchers are the first to use AI to translate animals’ languages.
C. Scientists have been able to translate some animals’ languages with AI technology.
questions.analysis: 18．推理判断题。根据“After the sounds are recorded, AI can study their meaning...”可知，在声音被记录下来之后，人工智能可以研究它们的含义，由此推知科学家们已经能够用人工智能技术翻译一些动物的语言。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did scientists tell bees where the nectar was?
options: A. They trained other bees to lead them there.
B. They asked a robot bee to teach them a new language.
C. They made a robot bee to tell the bees about the route by dancing.
questions.analysis: 19．细节理解题。根据“A research team in Germany, therefore, put the bee language AI system into a robot bee. They asked the robot to create a dance routine（路线）to tell the bees where the nectar was”可知，他们让机器人创造一个舞蹈程序，告诉蜜蜂花蜜在哪里。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The biofuel cell can ________.
questions.analysis: 20．推理判断题。根据第二段“When you stick the biofuel cell to your finger, it takes in sweat.”可知，当你把生物燃料电池粘在手指上时，它会吸收汗液；根据“Besides using the sweat, the device also produces small amounts of energy when it is pressed”可知，除了使用汗液，该设备在按压时也会产生少量能量。由此推知生物燃料电池可以利用汗水，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “queer” mean in Paragraph 3?
questions.analysis: 21．词义猜测题。根据“choose fingertips as the source of sweat”和“but in fact, they are the sweatiest part of the body.”可知，人们普遍认为指尖的汗水比较少，所以利用指尖的汗水作为来源对人们来说是很奇怪的，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the advantage of the biofuel cell?
options: A. It can influence the temperature greatly.
B. It can power a smart phone in a day.
C. It makes you comfortable when you are in pain.
D. It works for nearly 24 hours a day when you wear it.
questions.analysis: 23．细节理解题。根据倒数第二段“You can comfortably wear it for a long period of time”可知，当你戴着它的时候，它几乎一天24小时都在工作。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the best title for the passage?
options: A. The History of the Biofuel Cell
B. A Traditional Technology—the Biofuel Cell
C. A New Technology—the Biofuel Cell
D. The Inventor of the Biofuel Cell
questions.analysis: 24．最佳标题题。根据本文介绍了一种新型的生物燃料电池。所以最好的标题是“一种新技术——生物燃料电池”。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which design of the following didn’t Leonardo da Vinci draw according to the passage?
questions.analysis: 25．细节理解题。根据“In his notebooks, there were designs for flying machines.”和“Leonardo da Vinci drew pictures and designs of war machines, musical instruments and many other things as well.”可知，达·芬奇画过飞行器、战争机器、乐器等设计。没有提到画过翻转的镜子的设计。故选C。

source.sourceSection: （2023·福建福州·福建省福州第一中学校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined word “They” in Paragraph 2 refers to ________.
questions.analysis: 26．词句猜测题。根据“He left behind many notebooks full of creative ideas and inventions. They were also full of different subjects that he was studying.”可知，他留下了许多充满创意和发明的笔记本。它们也充满了他正在研究的不同物品。因此代词they指代“达·芬奇笔记本”。故选A。

source.sourceSection: （2023·福建福州·福建省福州第一中学校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following was Leonardo da Vinci’s idea ?
options: A. Science and his artworks weren’t closely connected.
B. Learning science helped him make better works of art.
C. All artists should learn to make scientific inventions.
D. The study of nature couldn’t improve his work as an artist.
questions.analysis: 27．细节理解题。根据“In his opinion, the study of science and nature helped shape his work as an artist.”可知，在他看来，对科学和自然的研究有助于他塑造艺术作品。故选B。

source.sourceSection: （2023·福建福州·福建省福州第一中学校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the main purpose of the passage?
options: A. To let us know more about the Mona Lisa and The Last Supper.
B. To show us some of Leonardo da Vinci’s flying machines.
C. To let us know more about Leonardo da Vinci.
D. To let us help find Leonardo da Vinci’s special notebooks.
questions.analysis: 29．推理判断题。根据“But do you know that he also did well in many other areas outside of art?”可知，本文主要介绍了达·芬奇在艺术之外的其他领域也有卓越的表现。因此本文的写作目的是让我们更了解达·芬奇。故选C。

source.sourceSection: （2023·福建福州·福建省福州第一中学校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does “it” refer to?
questions.analysis: 30．词句猜测题。根据“a complete ecosystem (生态系统) has been set up for activities such as shopping, traveling, giving hongbao and making payments. So in a short time, the “digital renminbi wallet” can hardly shake it.”可知，这里指一个完整的生态系统已经为购物、旅游、发红包和支付等活动建立起来。所以短时间内，“数字人民币钱包”很难撼动它，因此it指代上文的“完整的生态系统”。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the writer think of the future of the digital renminbi?
options: D. Not mentioned in the passage.
questions.analysis: 31．推理判断题。根据“Yet the use of the digital renminbi faces some challenges.”和“And as a tool that can meet the needs of the public in many fields, it is likely to be widely used in the future.”可知，作者认为数字人名币既面临着一些挑战，但仍然未来可期。故选C。

questions.prompt: What are the activities Zhang Lingling do at the party with her friends?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following sentence can be put in _______?

B. She always loses herself in singing those ancient poems.

D. Popular modern culture is the best way for young people to show their personalities.
questions.analysis: 34．主旨大意题。根据第三段空后内容可知，此段主要描述越来越多的年轻人如张玲玲一般热爱具有传统文化的东西，因此此处需要一个过渡句，从个例过渡到大众的句子，选项C“如张一般，有很多年轻人热爱中国传统文化”最符合语境。故选C。

questions.prompt: What does the product God of Fortune by Yu Yang stand for?
options: C. Mixture of eastern and western cultures.
D. Mixture of traditional and modern cultures.
questions.analysis: 35．细节理解题。根据第四段“others are mixing it with modern things. Pop culture designer Yu Yang is one of them.”可知，有些人在把传统文化和现代文化融合在一起，例如流行文化设计师于洋，因此于洋的作品代表的是现代和传统文化的结合。故选D。

questions.prompt: What does Yu Yang hope for the future?
questions.analysis:
36．细节理解题。根据第四段倒数第二句“I hope more people will accept and love my work and know Chinese culture through my art pieces,”可知，于洋希望越来越多的人能通过他的作品了解到中国传统文化。故选B。

questions.prompt: How does the writer describe the changes of the Earth in Paragraph 2?
questions.analysis: 1．推理判断题。根据“For example, glaciers rivers of ice can cut through mountains and make lakes and deep valleys…”可知，通过举例子的方式来描述地球的变化，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From Paragraph 3, we can mainly learn about ________.
options: A. the age of the Earth
C. the life of the farmers
questions.analysis: 2．推理判断题。根据“The weather is getting wetter in some places and drier in others, and there are more big storms…As a result, many cities will possibly be covered by water and much of the most productive farming areas will be lost. Some island countries are likely to disappear on the map of the world”可知，第三段主要介绍了这些变化所带来的问题，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined word “beneficial” in Paragraph 4 is the closest in meaning to “________”.
questions.analysis: 3．词义猜测题。根据“These changes will bring great harm to the planet.”以及“However, they can be beneficial to some people.”可知，这些变化会带来危害，However表示转折，划线句子应说也可以带来好处，也就是给一些朋友带来帮助，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: There are at least ________ laws in Paragraph 2.
questions.analysis: 4．细节理解题。根据“The system includes the Environmental Protection Law and a lot of laws in some other areas, such as the Yangtze River Protection Law, the Yellow River Protection Law, the Black Soil (土壤) Protection Law, the law on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and so on”可知该体系包括《环境保护法》和其他一些领域的许多法律，如《长江保护法》、《黄河保护法》、《黑土保护法》、《青藏高原法》等。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined word “assist” in Paragraph 2 is similar to ________.
questions.analysis: 5．词义猜测题。根据“These environmental protection laws assist with beautiful China.”可知这些环境保护法有助于建设美丽的中国，故此处划线部分和help意义相近。故选C。

questions.prompt: Over the past five years, the air quality in cities has generally stayed at the ________ level.

questions.analysis: 8．主旨大意题。根据“The Chinese government has taken action to protect both. the environment and ourselves.”以及本文内容可知本文主要介绍了中国已采取了很多行动保护环境和人类。故选D。

questions.prompt: What is the altitude of the highest automatic weather station?
questions.analysis: 14．细节理解题。根据“They set up the world’s highest automatic(自动的) weather station at an altitude(海拔) of 8,830 meters.”可知，他们在海拔8830米的地方建立了世界上最高的自动气象站。故选D。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “It” refer to(指代) in Paragraph 3?
options: A. Reaching the top of Qomolangma.
B. The influences of climate change.
D. The highest automatic weather station.
questions.analysis: 15．代词指代题。根据“But the data will give valuable information about the condition of local glaciers(冰川) and mountain snow. It will also help scientists study and understand the global monsoon(季风) system, so experts can make proper decisions about climate change.”可知，这些数据将提供有关当地冰川和高山积雪状况的宝贵信息。它还将帮助科学家研究和了解全球季风系统，这样专家们就可以对气候变化做出正确的决定。此处It指的是“这些数据”，故选C。

questions.prompt: How many weather stations were set up at an altitude higher than 7,000 meters?
questions.analysis: 16．细节理解题。根据“Yao Tandong, a famous expert, said Chinese scientists had set up eight weather stations from 5,200 to 8,830 meters above sea level. Half of the stations were set up at an altitude higher than 7,000 meters.”可知，中国科学家已经在海拔5200米到8830米的地方建立了8个气象站，一半的观测站建立在海拔7000米以上的地方，所以是有4个气象站超过7000米。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which statement(陈述) is NOT right according to the passage?
options: A. Chinese scientists can directly collect data from the top of Qomolangma now.
B. It is hard to collect and study data from Qomolangma.
C. The second highest weather station is on the north side of the mountain.
D. China has made great achievements in fields such as climate change.
questions.analysis: 17．推理判断题。根据“It is the highest automatic weather station in the world now. It has taken the place of the station sitting at an altitude of 8,430 meters on the south side of the mountain, which is the second highest now.”可知，它是目前世界上海拔最高的自动气象站，它取代了位于珠峰南侧海拔8430米的气象站，这是目前海拔第二高的气象站。选项C“第二高的气象站在山的北侧”表述错误，故选C。

questions.prompt: In which part of a newspaper can we find the passage?

questions.prompt: How many times has the Chinese science expedition team reached the top since last year?
questions.analysis: 19．细节理解题。根据“ It’s the second time since last year for the science expedition (考察) team to reach the top.”可知，自去年以来，中国科学考察队登顶了两次，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does Paragraph 5 mainly talk about?
options: A. The way of scientists studying climate change.
B. The effort of government to solve climate change.
C. The influence of climate change on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau.
D. The importance of studying ecosystem of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau.
questions.analysis: 21．段落大意题。根据“Over the last fifty years, the temperature on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau has risen about 0.5℃ every ten years. Studying the ecosystem(生态系统) of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau will help scientists have a better understanding of the influence of climate change, and help scientists and the government make proper decisions.”可知，本段主要是介绍研究青藏高原的生态系统的重要性，故选D。

questions.prompt: What can we know from the passage?
options: A. The team set of fat a height of 8,830 metres for the top at about 3 a.m.
B. The team collected rock samples on the top for further research.
C. China has setup the world's highest automated weather station so far.
D. All the key scientific questions have been answered up to now.

questions.prompt: What did Mrs. Thompson do on the first day of school?

questions.prompt: Why did Mrs. Thompson feel even worse?

questions.prompt: In what way did Mrs. Thompson change?

questions.analysis: 4．细节理解题。根据“On that very day, she stopped teaching reading, writing and math. Instead, she began to teach children.”可知，汤普森夫人的改变在于她更关心教育学生，故选D。

questions.prompt: What is the best title for the passage?
options: B. Enjoy our journey of life

questions.analysis:
28．最佳标题题。根据最后一段“All in all, we should cherish everyone, everything and every scenery we see. Life is too short. Be kind to yourself, live in the present and let life show its beauty, because we only have one life. Please feel the scenery along the way with your heart!”和通读全文后可知，本文讲述了人生如旅程，在这趟旅程中，我们要怀揣梦想并且坚持到底，而且不要把目标定得太高，要学会如何去爱以及平静且耐心地对待人生这趟旅程。最后，作者呼吁大家要珍惜眼前的一切，人生短暂且人只活一次，要用心感受沿途的风景。所以文章的最佳标题应是选项B“享受我们的人生旅程”，符合文意。故选B。

（一）（2023·辽宁大连·统考中考真题）
Ray was a naughty(淘气的) student. But he was smart and hard-working. And he never lost a race or a chess game. He always came first in school. He was so pleased with himself that he would always refuse to help others.
“Ray, are you able to go to the market and buy some eggs?” asked his mother. Ray gave an excuse and refused, “Sorry, Mom. I would be busy with my homework.”
Jack, one of Ray’s friends, wanted his help and asked, “Please help me solve this math problem.” “You must use your brain and solve it yourself.” replied the arrogant(傲慢的) Ray. Only one thing was important to Ray. His precious(珍贵的) pen! He considered it as his lucky pen. But one day Ray lost the pen.
Worried Ray looked everywhere for the pen, but couldn’t find it. Helplessly, he went to his mother for help, “Mom, I lost my lucky pen! Please help me find it. I have a test tomorrow.”
His mother ignored(不理睬) his request and said, “I’m sorry. I’m going out with Aunty Christme.”
With tears rolling down his eyes. Ray asked his friend for help, “I have lost my lucky pen. I cannot finish the test without it. Please help me find it!” “I’m sorry, Ray. I have to revise for tomorrow’s test. I don’t have time to waste.” Jack replied.
Ray sat at his desk, crying his eyes out, when his mother walked in to give his lucky pen to him. “I found it under the sofa in the drawing room.” said his mother.
“Many thanks. Mom!” said Ray. And thus, Ray learnt his lesson.
After that day, Ray helped everyone when possible for him.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which is NOT true according to the passage?
options: A. Mary thinks having life skills classes at school is important.
B. In Kevin’s school, many students pay no attention to learning life skills.
C. Mrs. Blair thinks children don’t need to learn most of the life skills at school.
questions.analysis: 4．细节理解题。根据“Children need to learn most of the life skills at school.”可知，Mrs. Blair认为孩子们需要在学校学习大部分的生活技能，C项错误。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the best title for the passage?
options: C. Opinions on Life Skills Education
questions.analysis: 5．标题归纳题。根据“Here are some opinions about life skills education.”及全文可知，本文主要讲述了人们对于生活技能教育的不同观看法。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following affects exam results most according to paragraph 1-2?
options: A. The sound of the clock.
B. The silence of the hall.
C. The pressure of the review.
D. The proud look from the neighboring desk.
questions.analysis: 6．细节理解题。根据“ it is not the pressure(压力) of the exam hall that causes the problem. It is the pressure of review.”可知，造成这个问题的不是考场的压力。而是复习的压力。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Paragraph 4 mainly talks about the ________ of the research.
questions.analysis: 7．主旨大意题。根据第四段主要是关于实验的结论的，即考试前几天焦虑程度越高，复习获得的知识越少，考试结果越不好。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “it” in paragraph 5 refer to?
questions.analysis: 8．词义猜测题。根据“ they can reduce the importance of the test by telling themselves that, though it is important, it is not a life-or-death situation.”可知，他们可以通过以下方法降低测试的重要性：告诉自己，尽管这个考试很重要，但这不是生死攸关的事情。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we infer(推断) from the text?
options: A. The more mock exams you take, the better results you will get.
B. Students should pay less attention to the test to reduce the anxiety.
C. If you have more knowledge before exams, you will have less anxiety in exams.
D. Anxiety during review affects exam performance more than that during the exams.
questions.analysis: 9．推理判断题。根据“Dr. Theobald found that anxiety on the day of the test did not predict exam performance at all.”可知，考试当天的焦虑根本不会影响考试成绩，“what actually affected students were high levels of anxiety during the weeks before the real exam took place. ”，可知，真正影响考试成绩的是考试前复习阶段的焦虑程度。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can be the best title for the text?
options: A. Can you perform well in exams?
B. What may cause you exam anxiety?
C. How can you reduce exam anxiety?
D. Does anxiety affect exam performance?
questions.analysis: 10．最佳标题题。根据全文都是关于考试中压力的来源，且用实验的方法告诉人们考试前期复习过程中压力才会影响考试成绩。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The meaning of the underlined word “reality” in the first paragraph is ________?
questions.analysis: 11．词义猜测题。根据“Reality TV shows have no actors. The stars are real people like you and me. ”可知，没有演员，明星都是像你我一样的真人，所以推断这种节目应是“电视真人秀”，是展示人物的真实情况的，所以划线单词表示“真实，现实”。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: You can win ________ in “Survivor”.
questions.analysis: 12．细节理解题。根据“In “Survivor”, sixteen people try to win one million dollars”可知，在《幸存者》中，你可以赢得100万美元，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Watching too much TV is unhealthy for children because ________.
options: C. it prevents children from doing exercise
questions.analysis: 13．细节理解题。根据“Some people think that watching too much TV is unhealthy for children because it stops them doing exercise. ”可知，看太多电视对孩子来说是不健康的，因为这会妨碍他们做运动。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
options: A. People at the age of sixteen try to win one million dollars.
B. Watching TV can help children to relax before the exam.
C. Most children watch TV nore than three hours every week.
questions.analysis: 14．细节理解题。根据“They found that children who watch TV before an exam can get higher grades. This is because TV helps them to relax before the exam.”可知，看电视可以帮助孩子们在考前放松，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the passage?
options: A. To discuss whether watching TV is good or not.
B. To describe one TV show.
questions.analysis: 15．主旨大意题。本文主要介绍了一个电视节目《幸存者》引出关于看电视的话题，讨论了孩子们看电视的利弊，并说明了孩子们应该适度看电视，不能过量。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How do people around the world get to know more about China?
options: B. By reading books about China.
C. By listening to true stories of China.
D. By experiencing living in China.
questions.analysis: 16．细节理解题。根据“By listening to true stories of China, many people around the world get to know more about China.”可知可以通过倾听中国的真实故事来更多地了解中国，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is a good Chinese story?
options: A. It should tell people how to live well in China.
B. It should tell people how to communicate with Chinese.
C. It should be about how People’s Volunteer Army fought the enemy.
D. It should be about Chines national spirit and culture confidence.
questions.analysis: 17．细节理解题。根据“First, a good Chinese story should be about the Chinese national spirit and Chinese cultural confidence (自信).”可知一个好的中国故事应该跟中华民族精神与中华文化自信有关，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did Li Ziqi tell Chinese stories?
options: A. By making movies about Chinese culture.
B. By showing her daily life in the countryside.
C. By sharing Chinese stories with short videos.
D. By talking about Chinese culture on the Internet.
questions.analysis: 18．细节理解题。根据“She spread Chinese culture to the world by showing her daily life in the countryside.”可知李子柒通过展示她的乡村日常生活来讲述中国故事，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: ________ young people talk about their opinions on filial piety.
questions.analysis: 19．细节理解题。根据“Anna, 25, Shenyang”及“Yan Zihan, 13, Guangzhou”可知，两个年轻人谈论了他们对孝道的看法。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The word “it” in Paragraph 2 refers to “________”.
options: A. giving up one’s own life and dreams
B. sacrificing one’s own life unconditionally
D. doing all the chores for the parents
questions.analysis: 20．词义猜测题。根据“Doing one’s filial duty doesn’t mean giving up one’s own life and dreams. It means more about understanding one’s parents and giving them enough attention and love.”可知，尽孝道并不意味着放弃自己的生活和梦想。它更多地意味着理解自己的父母，并给予他们足够的关注和爱。it指代前文的“Doing one’s filial duty”。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The best title of the passage may be ________.
options: B. Different Opinions on Filial Piety
questions.analysis: 22．最佳标题题。根据“I’m curious about what the younger generation of Chinese people thinks of traditional filial piety. Let’s have a look. Have you seen any changes?”及全文可知，本文主要讲述了中国年轻一代对传统孝道的不同看法。因此最佳标题为“对孝道的不同看法”。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How does the writer feel about social media?
options: A. People seldom use it to argue with each other.
B. Many people use it to voice their opinions.
C. It’s a good way to connect with strangers.
D. You can’t see what other people have written on it.
questions.analysis: 23．细节理解题。根据第一段“Social media(社交媒体)is certainly an interesting place to learn others’ opinions. You can read everything from strange ideas to true facts and everything in between.”（社交媒体当然是一个了解他人观点的有趣地方。你可以阅读任何东西，从奇怪的想法到真实的事实，以及介于两者之间的任何东西。）可知，社交媒体是一个可以读到他人观点的有趣的地方，很多人通过它来发表自己的观点。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “it” refer to?
questions.analysis: 24．推理判断题。根据“You might do some research, find some facts of your own and reply to what they’ve written. ”（你可以做一些研究，找到一些你自己的事实，然后回复他们写的内容。）可知此处的“it”应指前文提到的“reply”。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How might arguing online influence you?
options: A. You will face a lot of dangers.
B. You will become more confident.
C. You might feel bad and argue more.
D. You will get better at arguing.
questions.analysis: 25．细节理解题。根据“If you argue often, you start to enjoy arguing and then end up doing it even more.”（如果你经常争吵，你会开始喜欢争吵，最终会吵得更凶。）可知，参与网上争论后，就会开始喜欢争吵，并且最终争吵得更多。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the best title for the passage?
options: A. Argue until finding the truth
D. Not worth it to argue online
questions.analysis: 26．细节理解题。根据最后一段“There are much better and more interesting things to do, whether online or in real life.”（无论是在网上还是在现实生活中，都有更好、更有趣的事情可以做。）可知，无论是在网上还是在现实生活中，都有更好更有趣的事情可以做，所以作者的建议是找些更好的事情做，而不是争吵。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why is spring mentioned in the beginning?
options: B. It is a pretty season.
D. It is the start of a year.
questions.analysis: 27．细节理解题。根据“Spring is nature’s sign that however dark or cold things might be, better days are around the corner. That is hope.”可知，春天是大自然的标志，无论天气多么黑暗或寒冷，美好的日子就在眼前。这就是希望。可见，春天代表希望。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What question is answered in Paragraph 2?
options: A. How can hope change our life?
B. What does hope really mean?
C. Why do firefighters need hope?
D. Who can help us find hope?
questions.analysis: 28．推理判断题。根据“Hope is the feeling that things can get better”可知，希望是一种事情可以变得更好的感觉。根据“In addition, hope is also about taking action.”可知，此外，希望还在于采取行动。并以消防员灭火为例。所以第二段主要回答的问题是，希望到底意味着什么。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we infer from paragraph 3?
options: A. Hope is never easy to find.
B. Experts never give up hope.
C. Hope is important to our health.
D. Experts often give us hope.
questions.analysis: 29．推理判断题。根据“They also say that research shows hope can build up your body and help you deal with pain.”可知，他们还说，研究表明希望可以增强你的身体，并帮助你处理疼痛。所以说，希望对我们的健康很重要。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does Dr. White mainly talk about?
options: A. The steps of seeing hope.
B. The kinds of practical hope.
C. The possibility of seeing hope.
D. The value of practical hope.
questions.analysis: 30．推理判断题。根据“Feeling disappointed and worried is part of life. If it’s possible to see hope in them, you should; if it’s not, don’t worry. Dr. White calls this ‘practical hope’.”可知，感到失望和担忧是生活的一部分。如果有可能你应该在他们身上看到希望；如果不是，别担心。怀特博士称之为“现实的希望”。所以怀特博士主要谈论的是现实的希望的价值。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What would be the best title for the passage?
options: D. Where Can We See Hope
questions.analysis: 31．最佳标题题。通读全文可知，第一段讲述的是：春天代表希望；第二段讲述的是：希望是一种事情可以变得更好的感觉。第三段讲述的是：在困难时期抱有希望可以帮助你减少担忧，感到平静，振奋精神。希望对我们的健康很重要。第四段讲述的是：现实的希望的价值。所以本文主要告诉我们要充满希望以及拥有希望的好处。所以有希望是有帮助的。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In the soap opera, the little girl isn’t allowed to ________.
options: C. go to the key school
D. watch TV or play computer games
questions.analysis: 32．细节理解题。根据第一段“The tiger mother is pretty strict with her daughter and the little girl is not allowed to watch TV or play computer games.”可知，妈妈对女儿很严格，不允许小女孩看电视或玩电脑游戏。故选D。

source.sourceSection: （2023·四川雅安·雅安中学校考一模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In the soap opera, the father is called “Cat Father” because ________.
options: A. he enjoys eating fish just like a cat
B. he gives her daughter more independence
C. he is afraid of his wife
D. he always stays up late just like a cat
questions.analysis: 33．细节理解题。根据第一段“He gives her daughter more independence and doesn’t make many rules for her.”可知，他给了女儿更多的独立性，没有给她制定很多规矩。故选B。

source.sourceSection: （2023·四川雅安·雅安中学校考一模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following can be put in “________” in the second paragraph?
options: B. Tiger Mother is the better.
C. Chinese parents dislike their children.
D. Children can’t decide anything for themselves.
questions.analysis: 34．推理判断题。根据上一句“In China, it seems that in each family, there is a tiger mother and a cat father, even worse, some families have two tigers.”可知在中国，每个家庭都有一个虎妈妈和一个猫爸爸，甚至有的家庭还有两只老虎，由此推测孩子们不能自己做决定，选项D符合语境。故选D。

source.sourceSection: （2023·四川雅安·雅安中学校考一模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Except ________ all are the most important qualities to develop a child in this passage.
questions.analysis: 35．细节理解题。根据最后一段“Confidence, kindness, honesty and independence are the most important qualities to develop a child, not the grades.”可知，自信、善良、诚实和独立是培养孩子最重要的品质，而不是成绩。故选C。

source.sourceSection: （2023·四川雅安·雅安中学校考一模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The writer thinks it’s good to ________.
options: A. slow your steps and grow together with your children
B. take a walk with your children often
C. be strict with your children like “Tiger Mother”
D. buy an expensive house near the key school
questions.analysis: 36．观点态度题。根据最后一段“Whether the tiger mother or the cat father, respecting children and growing together are the keys to family education.”可知，作者认为无论是虎妈还是猫爸，尊重孩子，共同成长，都是家庭教育的关键。故选A。

source.sourceSection: （2023·四川雅安·雅安中学校考一模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following in the dictionary best explains the underlined word “company”?
options: A. a business organization that makes or sells goods or services
B. the fact of being with somebody else and not alone
C. a group of people who work or perform together
D. a social or business visitor
questions.analysis: 37．词句猜测题。根据下文“When children come home from school, pets are always there to greet them. They love children and always want to play. As a result, children will be less likely to experience loneliness.”可知，当孩子们放学回家时，宠物总是在那里迎接他们。他们爱孩子，总是想玩。结果，孩子们将不太可能经历孤独。所以company意为“与他人在一起而不是独自一人”。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the text, what may people who are against children owning a pet worry about?
questions.analysis: 38．推理判断题。根据第四段“On the other hand, some pets can be dangerous. Some dogs, for example, are likely to bite. If they are treated in the wrong way, cats can use their claws to hurt others.”可知，另一方面，有些宠物可能很危险。例如，有些狗可能会咬人。如果猫受到错误的对待，它们可能会用爪子伤害其他的。以此为例说明一些宠物很危险。可见，反对孩子养宠物的人主要担心孩子的安全。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the writer’s purpose in writing the text?
options: A. To introduce how to take good care of a pet.
B. To solve the problem of children owning a pet.
C. To list the disadvantages of children owning a pet.
D. To show different opinions on children owning a pet.
questions.analysis: 39．主旨大意题。通过“there are many arguments（争论）for and against children owning pets.”可知，有许多支持和反对孩子养宠物的论点。通过文章可知，本文主要讲述了对于孩子养宠物，存在支持和反对两方面的争论点。所以本文表达了对孩子养宠物的不同意见。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, hobbies can make teens ________.
options: A. be sure something they want will happen in the future
B. know they are different from their parents
C. feel a little bad about themselves
D. have no time to fight with parents
questions.analysis: 41．推理判断题。根据“Hobbies help build a teen’s confidence (自信). By finding an area of interest, a teen can build his skills. This leads to positive results and builds teenagers’ confidence.”可知，爱好有助于建立青少年的自信心，通过找到感兴趣的领域，青少年可以学习新技能，这会产生积极的结果。故可推断爱好可以帮助青少年增强自信心，使他们确信能实现自己的愿望。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined word “positive” in the passage probably means “________”.
questions.analysis: 42．词句猜测题。根据“Hobbies help build a teen’s confidence (自信). By finding an area of interest, a teen can build his skills. This leads to positive results and builds teenagers’ confidence.”可知，“积极的”结果会帮助建立青少年的自信心，划线部分单词意为“积极的”。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The passage is mainly about ________.
options: A. why it’s not easy to find a hobby
B. how to develop a hobby
C. why teens need a hobby
D. when a teen is busy with a hobby
questions.analysis: 43．主旨大意题。通读全文可知，本文主要介绍了爱好对于青少年身心发展的好处，也就是说明了青少年为什么需要爱好的原因。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we infer from the first paragraph?
options: A. Housework is a must-do for parents.
B. Very few children get housework done
C. Children are very busy with housework.
D. Family members should admire each other.
questions.analysis: 44．推理判断题。根据第一段“Many more of us ask them to do housework, or say we believe in them, but the housework just doesn’t get done.”可推断，尽管分派了家务活，但是很少有孩子真正去做。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is found in the small study?
options: A. Housework develops a sense of responsibility.
B. Housework helps a man live a happy life.
C. A child must start doing housework at the age of 3.
D. A man’s success depends on his housework.
questions.analysis: 45．细节理解题。根据第三段“Those who early shared responsibilities developed a sense of responsibility in other areas of their lives.”可知，该研究发现做家务活有助于孩子们培养责任意识。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What docs the writer advise parents to do in the last paragraph?
options: A. Pay the child for housework.
C. Do house work by themselves.
D. Help the child do housework actively.
questions.analysis: 46．推理判断题。根据最后一段“What should you do when getting children to do housework? Accept no excuses.”可知，作者建议家长给孩子分派家务活时不接受孩子的任何托词，应该让孩子真正去行动才是关键。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following can be the best title of the passage?
options: C. Children Need More Care at Home
D. Adults Do Less Housework in the US
questions.analysis: 47．最佳标题题。通读全文可知，第一段首句“Children should do housework.”为该文的核心话题，并在后文论述了做家务可以给孩子带来的好处。B项“家务对儿童至关重要”贴合主旨。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In this passage, Aristotle is taken as an example to show that ________.
options: A. he is the greatest and respected scientist of all
B. huge influence of great thinkers may stop human thought from developing
C. advancements are made when thinkers start to question
D. great thinkers make mistakes and then correct them
questions.analysis: 48．推理判断题。根据第一段“Unfortunately, it is often the great and respected thinkers who end up slowing the progress of human thought.”可知第一段以亚里上多德为例，就是为了说明这个观点（伟大思想家的巨大影响可能会阻碍人类思想的发展），故选B。

source.sourceSection: （2023·江苏南京·南师附中树人学校校考三模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined sentence in Paragraph 2 has an adverbial clause which expresses ________.
questions.analysis: 49．推理判断题。根据第二段“He was so respected by the scientific community that even 1,200 years after his death, scientists were still trying to build upon his mistakes rather than correct them!”可知在他去世后，人们依然没有纠正错误，可推知句子中的状语从句表明了结果，故选C。

source.sourceSection: （2023·江苏南京·南师附中树人学校校考三模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can be inferred from the last paragraph?
options: A. The author is not quite sure about his future.
B. We human beings are afraid of dreaming about the future.
C. The things about black holes will change in two years.
D. Questioning is necessary to intellectual advancement.
questions.analysis: 51．推理判断题。根据最后一段“Questions are said to be the path to knowledge and truth, and I plan to continue questioning.”可知，最后一段说明了质疑是促进进步的必要条件，故选D。

source.sourceSection: （2023·江苏南京·南师附中树人学校校考三模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which skill do most teachers think is important to children in future life?
options: B. To get help from others.
questions.analysis: 52．细节理解题。根据“Children will learn how to use resources (资源) such as texts, libraries and the internet. They think it’s a skill which is important to them in future life.”可知大多数老师认为学习如何使用资源对孩子未来的生活很重要。故选C。

source.sourceSection: （2023·河北石家庄·石家庄市第四十一中学校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who suggest giving children more time for reading?
questions.analysis: 53．细节理解题。根据“Some parents disagree...The time spent on homework could have been used to do other activities like reading and playing sports.”可知一些家长建议给孩子们更多的阅读时间。故选B。

source.sourceSection: （2023·河北石家庄·石家庄市第四十一中学校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined expression “back up” probably mean?
questions.analysis: 54．词义猜测题。根据“Some parents disagree, though. They think homework puts too much stress on children”可知一些家长不同意，他们认为家庭作业给孩子们带来了太大的压力。根据“they give the example of Finland(芬兰). In Finland, student have little homework. But the country remains one of the most educationally successful countries in the world.”可知这些家长为了支持自己的观点，给出了芬兰的例子，故选A。

source.sourceSection: （2023·河北石家庄·石家庄市第四十一中学校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following would the writer probably agree with?
options: A. We must learn from Finland.
B. Homework with clear reason is good.
C. Students should be polite to their teachers.
D. Parents should set good examples for their children.
questions.analysis: 55．细节理解题。根据“In my opinion, whether the homework is good or bad depends on the purpose of it. If there is no clear reason for giving homework, the students will not get anything from doing it, so it should not be set.”（在我看来，家庭作业是好是坏取决于它的目的。如果没有明确的理由布置作业，学生不会从中得到任何东西，所以不应该设置。）可知作者认为有明确理由的家庭作业是好的。故选B。

source.sourceSection: （2023·河北石家庄·石家庄市第四十一中学校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the best title for the text?
options: A. Ways to Deal with Stress
questions.analysis: 56．最佳标题题。根据“People have been trying to find out whether homework is good or bad for school children and they have different opinions.”可知，本文主要介绍了关于孩子家庭作业的不同观点，故选D。

source.sourceSection: （2023·河北石家庄·石家庄市第四十一中学校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Many men think ________.
options: A. women can’t do what men can
B. men have to work much harder than women
C. men can make money more easily than women
D. women’s duty is mainly to do housework at home
questions.analysis: 57．推理判断题。根据“Some are even against their wives at all. When wives go out to work, the home and children can’t be taken good care of. If women take full-time jobs, they won’t be able to do what they are best at doing: making a nice room and bringing up the children.”可知，许多男人认为，如果女性从事全职工作，她们将无法做自己最擅长的事情：打造一个漂亮的房间和抚养孩子，所以许多男人认为女性的主要工作就是在家料理家务，故选D。

source.sourceSection: （2023·山东东营·东营市胜利第一初级中学校考三模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Anne Harper didn’t wish to be a man ________.
options: A. because she believed in women’s liberation
B. but she wished to get the same job as men
C. but she wished to be treated the same as a man
D. because she had a good job
questions.analysis: 58．细节理解题。根据“But I do wish people stop treating us like second-class people. At work, for example, we usually do the work that men do but get paid less. There are still a lot of jobs only to men-usually they are the best ones.”可知，希望不要把女性当成二等人，通常做男性的工作，但得到的报酬较低，所以她是希望被像男人一样的对待，故选C。

source.sourceSection: （2023·山东东营·东营市胜利第一初级中学校考三模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Many men say that they have more duties than women. Why?
options: A. A man has to make money to support his family.
B. It is right for men to be paid more.
C. A man has to make the important decision.
questions.analysis: 59．细节理解题。根据“Many men say that they have more duties than women. A man has to make money to support his family and to make the important decision, so it is right for men to be paid more. ”可知，男人要赚钱养家，要做重要的决定，所以男人得到更多的报酬是正确的，故选D。

source.sourceSection: （2023·山东东营·东营市胜利第一初级中学校考三模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the passage, Ann Harper believes people often treat women like second-class people, such as ________.
options: A. at work, women usually do the most work
B. scientists and engineers are all men
C. a man has a much better chance of living a wonderful life
D. all the jobs only to men
questions.analysis: 60．细节理解题。根据“If you are a man, you have a much better chance of living a wonderful life.”可知，男人有更好的机会过上美好的生活，故选C。

source.sourceSection: （2023·山东东营·东营市胜利第一初级中学校考三模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT true according to the passage?
options: A. There are more men scientists, engineers than women ones.
B. Women are second-class people, so they shouldn’t live a better life.
C. Women do the same job as men, but get paid less than men.
D. There are some best jobs that women have few chances to take.
questions.analysis: 61．推理判断题。根据“and I don’t think women do. But I do wish people stop treating us like second-class people.”可知，Ann Harper希望人们停止对待妇女像对待二等人，而不是妇女是二等人，故选B。

source.sourceSection: （2023·山东东营·东营市胜利第一初级中学校考三模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the writer’s main purpose of writing Paragraph One?
questions.analysis: 62．主旨大意题。根据“From an early age, we were taught that if we wanted to be successful, we had to study hard and get good results at school. In fact, good students may just end up doing jobs they don’t like, and some even lead an unhappy life. Why is it like that?（从小，我们就被教导，要想成功，就要努力学习，在学校取得好成绩。事实上，好学生可能只是做他们不喜欢的工作，有些人甚至过着不快乐的生活。为什么会这样呢？）”可知，作者写第一段主要是为了引出本文主题。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In some parents’ eyes, what’s the most important for their kids based on Paragraph Two?
questions.analysis: 63．细节理解题。根据“In some parents’ eyes, school grades matter most for their kids.”可知，在一些父母的眼中，好的学习成绩是最重要的。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined expression “big shots” in the third paragraph mean?
questions.analysis: 64．词义猜测题。根据“like Thomas Edison and Steve Jobs, didn’t do very well at school or even failed to finish school.”可知爱迪生和乔布斯是一些没有完成学业，却取得成功的大人物，划线单词表示“大人物”。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, which sentence may agree with the writer’s idea?
options: A. It takes money to be successful.
B. Doing well in school is the most important.
questions.analysis: 65．观点态度题。根据“That is to say, school is not just enough if you want to have a great life.”可知，想要拥有美好生活，只成绩好是不够的，由此可知“学校成绩并不代表一切。”这一句符合作者的观点。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the text?
options: B. Learning is a lifelong journey.
C. Good grades always promise a successful life.
questions.analysis: 66．推理判断题。根据“Life is really a long lesson, so long that you can’t define（界定）a person’s success by just one part of it. If you have already finished school, keep learning because what you have learned at school will never be enough to live a satisfying life. ”可知，即使完成学业了也要继续学习，学习是一个终生旅程。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did the writer feel before the piano grade test?
questions.analysis: 67．细节理解题。根据“Before a piano grade test, I felt I was not skilled enough to pass the exam”（在一次钢琴等级考试之前，我觉得我的技能还不够好，无法通过考试）可知，作者是担心的，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What kind of problem do most of us have according to the second paragraph?
options: A. We refuse to accept others’ help.
B. We don’t have enough opportunities.
C. We have to deal with our bad luck.
D. We fail to take the opportunities.
questions.analysis: 68．细节理解题。根据“The problem is that most of us usually miss the opportunities, or when they come, we don’t act.”可知，问题是，我们大多数人经常错过机会，或者当机会来临时，我们不采取行动。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “avert” probably mean?
questions.analysis: 69．词义猜测题。根据下文“We have no choice but to face the difficulties.”（除了面对困难，我们别无选择。）可知，划线单词所在句是指我们不能也不应该回避挑战，所以划线单词表示“回避，避免”，与划线单词avoid同义，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the relationship between opportunities and challenges?
questions.analysis: 70．细节理解题。根据“So opportunities and challenges always come together.”可知，机遇和挑战总是相伴而来的，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the best title for this passage?
questions.analysis: 71．最佳标题题。本文作者用自己的经历向我们证明了机遇和挑战总是相伴而来的，全文围绕着机会和挑战来展开的，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the discussion mainly about?
options: A. When the British send cards and letters.
B. Whether the British should keep the tradition.
C. Why the British like sending cards and letters.
questions.analysis: 72．主旨大意题。根据“As we know, the British have been sending cards since the 19th century...Should the tradition of sending cards and letters be stopped?”可知本文在讨论英国人是否应该保留寄卡片和信件这一传统。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who thinks it’s necessary to keep the tradition?
questions.analysis: 73．细节理解题。根据Group B“The tradition has been around for hundreds of years and should stay”可知B组认为有必要保持传统。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does Group A think of sending cards?
questions.analysis: 75．细节理解题。根据“Making paper uses lots of energy and some cards are hard to recycle. It’s bad for environment. What’s more, cards are expensive to buy and so is posting. Nowadays, we usually use our phones and computers because they are quick, easy and free.”可知A组认为寄卡片既浪费又昂贵。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following facts directly caused the discussion?
options: B. Fewer British people send cards and letters.
C. The British spend too much money on cards and letters.
questions.analysis: 76．推理判断题。根据全文可知本文在讨论英国人是否应该保留寄卡片和信件这一传统，B选项“更少的英国人寄卡片和信件”可以直接引起文章的讨论，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How does the writer introduce the topic of the passage in Paragraph 1?
questions.analysis: 77．细节理解题。根据“Do you like to travel alone? Or do you think it’s better to travel with friends?”可知作者通过两个问题引出本文的话题。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “it” in Paragraph 3 refer to?
questions.analysis: 78．词义猜测题。根据“Traveling alone really shows you what you’re made of and helps you to discover inner strength (内心的力量) you didn’t know you had. Besides, it also gives you time to think”可知独自旅行真的向你展示了自己的实力，并帮助你发现内心的力量，它也给你思考、学习和成长的时间，故此处it指代“独自旅行”。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Traveling with friends has the following advantages EXCEPT ________.
options: A. sharing a lot of things
D. having a sense of safety
questions.analysis: 79．细节理解题。根据“One of the main advantages of traveling with friends is being able to share these things and support each other through the process”可知与朋友一起旅行的主要优势之一是能够分享这些东西，并在整个过程中相互支持；根据“it’s true that traveling with others can give you a sense of safety”可知与他人一起旅行确实能给你一种安全感。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the word “fake” mean in the passage?
questions.analysis: 81．词义猜测题。根据“Last week, we asked if fake grass was better than a real lawn.”可知，fake应是与real相反的词义，也就是“假的”，与unreal词义相近，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do 11% of the readers in the poll probably think of fake grass?
options: A. It looks untidy and hard to care for.
B. It makes gardening difficult or boring.
C. It takes effort to mow. weed and water.
D. It makes shady space bright.
questions.analysis: 82．细节理解题。根据“A fake grass lawn looks fresh, bright and colourful in a shady (背阴的) outdoor space.”可知，调查中11%的读者认为它可以使阴凉的空间明亮，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do 89% of the readers in the poll probably think of fake grass?
options: B. Hot for bare feet in warm days.
questions.analysis: 83．细节理解题。根据“In warm weather, it can be too hot for bare (光脚的) feet or paws to stand on.”可知，调查中89%的读者认为在温暖的日子里光脚很热，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which is mentioned in the passage?
options: A. Fake grass can be used indoors too.
B. 50% more companies sold fake grass last year.
C. Some people think fake grass mustn’t be sold.
D. Everybody is willing to use fake grass.
questions.analysis: 84．细节理解题。根据“Some people think fake grass is bad for wildlife and the environment, and mustn’t be sold”可知，有些人认为人造草对野生动物和环境有害，不应该出售，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which is the main idea of the passage?
options: C. Fake grass is better than a living grass lawn.
D. People have different opinions about fake grass.
questions.analysis: 85．主旨大意题。通读全文可知，本文是人们对于人工草坪的不同看法，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What kind of people have fewer chances to succeed according to the article?
options: A. People with a growth mindset.
B. People with a fixed mindset.
C. People who often learn from challenges.
D. People who often learn from mistakes.
questions.analysis: 86．推理判断题。根据“Some students were told that they were good at a task. They didn’t try very hard the next time”及“The first group of students was learning that they had a set amount of skill. They didn’t think they could do any better. This is called a fixed mindset（思维模式）.”可知，文章介绍了拥有固定型思维模式的学生在面对一项任务时，如果受到了夸赞表扬，那么下一次他们就不会再继续努力了，故可推知拥有固定型思维的人获得成功的机会较小。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the form we can know people with a growth mindset consider challenges as ________.
options: B. things they need to avoid
C. things that help them learn
D. things that stop them improving
questions.analysis: 87．推理判断题。根据表格最后一行Challenges中“Things that help you learn”可知，拥有成长型思维的人会把挑战视为可以帮助他们学习的事情。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How does the writer organize the ideas in the article?
questions.analysis: 88．推理判断题。根据第二段“Psychologists（心理学家）looked at what students did after they were given different types of praise. Some students were told that they were good at a task. They didn’t try very hard the next time. Other students were told that they had worked hard at a task. They worked even harder the next time.”可知，文章第二段介绍了两组不同的学生在接受不同表扬后的行为表现，说明了固定型思维和成长型思维的不同；故文章通过对比事实来组织文章中心思想。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the first step of expressive writing?

B. To train yourself into an excellent writer.
C. To talk about your feelings to others.
D. To think about the bad experience carefully.
questions.analysis: 1．细节理解题。根据“As you write, you are recognizing what is happening around, and accepting that something is bothering you is an important first step”可知表达性写作的第一步是意识到周围发生了什么，接受一些困扰你的事，故选A。

questions.prompt: Why do more and more people speak to their computers or mobile devices?
options: A. Because they like to show off.
B. Because they want to search for things online or on their hard drives.
C. Because this is the only way to look for information.
D. Because they are busy with others matters.
questions.analysis: 14．细节理解题。根据“More and more people are speaking to their computers or mobile devices to search for things online or on their hard drives.”可知，因为他们想在网上或硬盘上搜索东西。故选B。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined phrase “tech savvy” in paragraph two mean?
options: A. Having a good knowledge of technology.
D. Making full use of technology.
questions.analysis: 15．词句猜测题。根据“The research found that many teenagers thought voice search was a normal part of technology”可知，许多年轻人认为语音搜索是技术的正常部分，后文表示转折，说明后文中成年人不这样认为，即“精通技术”。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When do teens and adults use voice search to multi-task?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE about voice search?

B. Teens use it to play games.
C. It is the achievement of the development of technology.
D. It suggests that people like talking more than they like typing.
questions.analysis: 17．推理判断题。根据“Voice recognition technology, like Google’s Voice Search or Apple’s Siri, means our technology is beginning to understand what we are saying”可知语音识别技术意味着我们的技术开始理解我们在说什么，所以语音搜索是科技发展的成果。故选C。

questions.analysis: 19．细节理解题。根据“They found that friends have 1% of genes that match.”可知，研究发现朋友有1%的基因匹配。故选B。

questions.prompt: The writer takes the example of ancient people in Paragraph 5 to ________.
options: A. study how ancient people dealt with the cold
B. predict that similar environments lead to friendship
C. prove that it is evolution that brings friends together
D. explain why ancient people gave each other chance to keep alive
questions.analysis: 20．推理判断题。根据“So do you happen to become friends with people who share your genes? Not at all. In fact, it is evolution that brings you together.”可知，事实上，是进化让你们走到了一起。所以第五段列举古人的例子是为了证明是进化使朋友聚在一起，故选C。

questions.prompt: According to this passage, what is the right relationship?
options: A. Evolve same skills and hobbies → Same Genes → Become friends
B. Same Genes → Evolve same skills and hobbies → Become friends
C. Same Genes → Become friends → Evolve same skills and hobbies
D. Become friends → Evolve same skills and hobbies → Same Genes
questions.analysis: 21．细节理解题。根据“Among all the genes studied, those producing a change in sense of smell were the most similar in friends. For example, people who like the smell of coffee may hang out at cafes more often and as a result are more likely to meet and become friends with each other.”可知，正确的关系为：相同的基因→发展相同的技能和爱好→成为朋友，故选B。
