B. Labor education for primary and middle school students.
C. Ways to cultivate students’ social values.
D. New technologies used in primary and middle schools.
questions.analysis: 27．主旨大意题。通读全文可知，本文着重介绍教育部劳动教育关于中小学的实施的新标准。故选B。

source.sourceSection: （2023·福建福州·福建省福州第十六中学校联考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: If you don’t use your arms or legs for some time, they will ________.
questions.analysis: 28．细节理解题。根据“If you don’t use your arms or your legs for some time, they will become weak”可知如果你一段时间不使用你的胳膊或腿，它们会变得虚弱。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the word “ fault” mean in the second paragraph?
questions.analysis: 29．词义猜测题。根据“If a friend says that his arms and legs are weak, we know that it is his own fault”可知，如果一个朋友说他的胳膊和腿虚弱，我们知道这是他自己的错，是因为他自己不锻炼的原因，所以划线单词意为“过错”，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do many people think of the person with a poor memory?
options: A. His parents are to blame.
D. His parents are very clever.
questions.analysis: 30．细节理解题。根据“But if he tells us that he has a poor memory, many of us think that his parents are to blame”可知，很多人会认为他的父母是罪魁祸首，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Some people can’t read or write, but they usually have better memories because ________.
options: B. they often practice remembering things
C. they have strong arms and legs
questions.analysis: 31．细节理解题。根据“This is because they can’t read or write and they have to remember things; they can’t write them down in a little notebook. They must remember dates, names, songs and stories; so their memories are being exercised the whole time”可知，因为他们不能读或写，所以他们必须经常练习记忆，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the passage mainly (主要) talk about?
questions.analysis: 32．主旨大意题。根据全文内容可知，本文围绕“记忆力”这条主线展开描述，介绍如果想有一个好的记忆力，必须不断练习记忆，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is the provincial capital city of Xinjiang?
questions.analysis: 33．细节理解题。根据第一段的关键词“the provincial capital city Urumqi”可知，新疆的省会城市是乌鲁木齐。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the underlined word “It” in Paragraph Two refer to?
questions.analysis: 34．词句猜测题。根据第二段第一句可知，葡萄节是吐鲁番的一个传统节日，本句表示它是葡萄之乡，因此It指的是吐鲁番。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE?
options: A. Xinjiang is a popular tourist place in the northeast part of China.
B. Xinjiang doesn’t have many people from the minority groups.
C. Grape Festival in Turpan is a good way to enjoy the local way of life.
D. In the old times, Urumqi was the starting point of the ancient Silk Road
questions.analysis: 35．细节理解题。根据第二段“This festival is not just a celebration of Turpan's most important agricultural product, but a good chance to enjoy the local way of life.”可知，葡萄节不仅是为了庆祝吐鲁番最重要的农产品，也是一个享受当地生活方式的好机会。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined word “commemorate” probably means “ ________”.
questions.analysis: 36．词句猜测题。根据第三段的“so that people will not forget about this road”可知，吐鲁番葡萄节是为了让人们不忘记这条路，因此是纪念古丝绸之路的特殊活动。因此commemorate表示“纪念”，remember意思与之相近。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A. It tells us which part Xinjiang is in.
B. It introduces Grape Festival in Turpan.
C. It tells us the importance of Silk Road.
D. It tells us some traditional festivals in Xinjiang.
questions.analysis: 37．主旨大意题。通读全文可知，本文介绍了新疆及其传统节日——吐鲁番葡萄节。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where are rice noodles cooked with river snails usually sold?
questions.analysis: 38．细节理解题。由“Known as Luosifen in Chinese, the dish is usually sold from roadside stands in night markets in Guangxi.”可知，用河螺煮的米粉通常在路边的摊位上出售。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Luosifen restaurants have developed quickly all over the country since ________.
questions.analysis: 39．细节理解题。由“The dish was listed as part of Liuzhou’s intangible cultural heritage in 2008 and became popular after being introduced in the food show A Bite of China in 2012. Since then, Luosifen restaurants have developed quickly across the country.”可知，then代指上一句提到的2012年。自2012年以来，螺蛳粉餐厅在全国范围内迅速发展。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the meaning of the underlined word “export” in Chinese?
questions.analysis: 40．词义猜测题。由下文提到的“including the US, Australia, France”可知，国内的产品销售到这些国家应该称为“出口”。由此推出画线单词“export”的意思是“出口”。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following markets is new for rice noodles cooked with river snails?
questions.analysis: 41．细节理解题。由“new markets such as Singapore and New Zealand.”可知，新加坡是螺蛳粉的新市场。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does this article mainly talk about?
questions.analysis: 42．主旨大意题。通读全文可知，本文主要介绍的是柳州螺蛳粉的发展壮大，截至目前它已成为畅销国内外的网红食品，因此这篇文章主要讲了食品。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “irate” mean?
questions.analysis: 43．词义猜测题。根据“The teacher gets irate and suddenly everyone is in trouble instead of just the students who caused the problem.”可知，老师“生气”了，以致全体同学都遭殃。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In what way is collective punishment good?
options: A. It gets students to work harder.
B. It brings students hearts closer.
C. It helps keep order in the classroom.
D. It helps form good teacher-student relationships.
questions.analysis: 44．推理判断题。根据第二段中“As most of us want to be liked and “fit in” (顺应), all students then feel that they have to behave well.”可知，集体惩罚有助于维持班级秩序。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How can collective punishment harm students who want to do the right thing?
options: C. They hate to go to school.
questions.analysis: 45．细节理解题。根据第四段中“Teachers at my school say that some students become too disappointed to come to school.”可知，好学生因为对自己的集体感到失望会变得厌学。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why does the parent find collective punishment useful?
options: A. It helps teachers to find troublemakers.
B. It makes students tell on one another.
C. It allows students to know one another better.
D. It gets teachers to help badly-behaved students.
questions.analysis: 46．细节理解题。根据第二段中“A parent at this same school believes that this type of punishment is useful because it helps teachers to know which students are not behaving well.”可知，这位家长认为集体惩罚可以帮老师找出表现不好的学生。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does Miriam Koch think of troublemakers in a classroom?
options: A. They want to get rewards.
B. They have good social skills.
C. They are not clear about rules.
D. They may get worse after collective punishment.
questions.analysis: 47．推理判断题。根据最后一段中“Her opinion is that collective punishment can keep these students away from their classmates.”可知，集体惩罚会让这些总是惹麻烦的学生与其他同学的关系更加疏远，因此他们会变得更加糟糕。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do we know about the hours of sleep? ________
options: A. Most teenagers need less sleep than adults.
B. We need more sleep as we grow older.
C. The hours of sleep change through our lives in almost the same way.
D. There are small differences in the hours of sleep adults and children need.
questions.analysis: 48．细节理解题。根据第一段最后一句“which isn’t too dissimilar to adults 7 to 9 hours per night.”可知，青少年所需的睡眠时间与成年人的相差不大。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following can be put in ★? ________
options: B. they stay up late and play games.
C. they fall asleep earlier and wake up later.
D. they talk about their school lives with their parents.
questions.analysis: 49．推理判断题。根据第二段最后一句“They may try to ‘catch up’ on sleep loss during the school week.”可知，他们在上学的日子里可能努力补觉。由此推断出，他们在周末可能会熬夜玩游戏。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following may best describe “social jetlag”? ________
options: A. A change in sleep timing.
C. A feeling about sleep loss.
D. An action of a weekend lie-in.
questions.analysis: 50．词句猜测题。根据最后一段第一句“This shift in sleep timing has been called ‘social jetlag’”可知，这是一种睡眠时间上的改变。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, to stop social jetlag from becoming worse, we can ________.
options: A. wake up at 7:30 on the weekday and wake up at 9:00 on the weekend
B. wake up two hours earlier on weekends than the wake time on weekdays
C. take a nap often and wake up at the same time on the weekend
D. have a weekend lie-in all the morning and not wake up till noon
questions.analysis: 51．细节理解题。根据最后一段最后一句“but that proper wake time should be within two hours of that during the weekday, to make people become well from no enough sleep, while stopping social jetlag from becoming worse.”可知，为了防止“社交时差”变得更糟，作者建议适当的起床时间应该在工作日的两小时之内。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The writer’s writing purpose is to ________.
options: A. tell people something about “social jetlag”
B. advise people to go to bed early and get up early
C. show his surprise about the change in people’s lives
D. show the society is developing
questions.analysis: 52．主旨大意题。根据标题“Do you have social jetlag?”并结合文章大意可知，作者旨在向人们介绍“社交时差”的现象。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from every failure according to the text?
questions.analysis: 53．细节理解题。根据“However, we can learn something valuable from every failure (失败).”可知，我们可以从每一次失败中学到一些有价值的东西。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In the writer’s eyes, why did Edison achieve success?
options: A. He got help from others.
C. He saw the bright side of losing
questions.analysis: 54．细节理解题。根据“When he was asked how he felt, he said that he hadn’t failed10, 000 times but had learned 10, 000 things which didn’t work.”可知，爱迪生认为他没有失败一万次，而是学到了一万件不起作用的东西。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “disgraceful” probably mean?
questions.analysis: 55．词义猜测题。根据“We must accept our failure and learn to take advantage of it. Remember that it can be helpful.”可知，我们必须接受我们的失败并学会利用它。记住它是有帮助的。所以disgraceful意思是坏的，即失败并不是坏事情，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the writer advise the losers to do in a competition?
options: C. Share in the winners’ enjoyment.
questions.analysis: 56．细节理解题。根据“If we offer our congratulations (祝贺) to the winners and share in their happiness, we won’t feel sorry for our failure.”可知，如果我们向获奖者表示祝贺并分享他们的快乐，我们就不会为我们的失败感到遗憾。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the best title for the text?
options: A. Ideas about How to Avoid Mistakes
B. Advice on How to Be a Good Loser
C. Advantages of both Success and Failure
questions.analysis: 57．最佳标题题。根据“However, we can learn something valuable from every failure (失败). This may help us succeed in the future. So we must know how to be a good loser.”和“In a word, being a good loser will help us to succeed in life.”可知，本文主要讲述了我们要从失败中学习，做一个好的失败者会帮助我们在生活中取得成功。B项“关于如何成为一个好失败者的建议”符合内容，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word it refer to in Paragraph 3?
questions.analysis: 58．词义猜测题。根据第三段“ Dog parks are not safe places to“socialize”a young dog. An energetic, noisy greeter at the park may be enough to cause it to be afraid of everything. ”可知，狗狗公园不是让小狗“社交”的安全场所，公园里一个充满活力、吵闹的迎宾员可能会让它害怕一切。此处it指代的是前句提到的young dog。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does Paragraph 4 mainly tell us?
options: A. The rules of the dog parks.
B. The risks of the dog parks.
C. The safety tips from the dog parks.
D. The new experiences in the dog parks.
questions.analysis: 59．主旨大意题。根据第四段“Yet one of the biggest dangers of dog parks is that most dogs there don’t receive vaccines”可知，然而狗狗公园最大的危险是大部分狗都没有接种疫苗。选项B“狗公园的风险”符合段落大意。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The purpose of this passage is to ________.
options: A. expect dog parks to have a stronger and better management
B. call on dog parks to offer different classes to different dogs
C. encourage more dog owners to take their dogs to dog parks
D. advise dog owners to find other ways to help dogs socialize
questions.analysis: 60．推理判断题。根据最后一段“To conclude, it is far safer and more fun...similar ages.”可知，总而言之，远离狗狗公园，和你在一起对你的狗来说是更安全更有趣的，你可以带它去小狗班，在那里你的狗可能会遇到年龄相仿的玩伴。所以作者不建议主人带狗去狗公园，而是建议他们用其他方法帮助狗狗社交。选项D表述符合写作目的。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did the scientists find out about telling lies?
options: B. Most students have done it.
C. It is bad for people’s brains.
D. It’s an important way to protect oneself.
questions.analysis: 61．细节理解题。根据“However, scientists found that lying can harm your brain.”可知，科学家们发现说谎会伤害你的大脑，即说谎对你的大脑有害。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What happens to your brain when you lie?
options: B. It has to do some extra work.
C. It often says yes to others.
D. It becomes better at answering questions.
questions.analysis: 62．细节理解题。根据“When you tell the truth, your brain doesn’t have to do any extra work. But lying takes much more work.”可知，当你说实话的时候，你的大脑不需要做任何额外的工作，在说谎时你的大脑会做更多额外的工作。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the story, why is it harder for people under 25 to tell lies?
options: A. Because they are not clever enough.
B. Because they have too much brainpower.
C. Because they don’t have fully grown brains.
D. Because they are still learning how to talk to other people.
questions.analysis: 63．推理判断题。根据“Lying is even harder for young people. The prefrontal cortex is not fully developed until age 25.”可知，对于年轻人来说，说谎更加困难因为前额皮质直到 25 岁才完全发育，可推测25岁以下年轻人说谎困难因为他们的前额皮质还没有发育完全，C选项“因为他们没有完全发育的大脑。”与文章相符。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the best title of the passage?
questions.analysis: 64．标题归纳题。根据全文通篇主要介绍了说谎对大脑的伤害以及在说谎时，你的大脑还需要进行更多的额外工作，即更多的谎言，更多的工作。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “It” in Paragraph 1 refer to?
questions.analysis: 65．词义猜测题。根据“Do you know that his motherland is Denmark? It lies in northern Europe.”（你知道他的祖国是丹麦吗，它位于北欧）可知此处it指代“丹麦”。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之说明文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to Paragraph 4, we can call Denmark “________”.
options: B. the land of fairy stories
questions.analysis: 66．细节理解题。根据“Bicycling is popular in Denmark”可知自行车在丹麦很受欢迎，所以可以叫丹麦为“自行车之国”。故选A。

questions.prompt: What did the receivers do in the experiments?
options: A. They showed kindness to others.

questions.prompt: Why do Olympic runners often yawn before a race?
options: A. They are too tired or too bored.
B. A yawn can let good things in.
C. A yawn can help a warm brain cool down.
D. A yawn can stretch the muscles in their faces.
questions.analysis: 74．细节理解题。根据“In 2007, scientists found that a yawn can help a warm brain cool down.”可知科学家发现打哈欠可以帮助温暖的大脑冷静下来。故选C。

questions.prompt: What can we probably infer from the passage?

questions.analysis: 76．推理判断题。根据“scientists found that a yawn can help a warm brain cool down”以及“Some scientists believe that yawning makes you notice things more quickly”可知科学家发现打哈欠会帮助大脑冷静下来，能让你更快地注意到事情，由此可推知一些科学家认为打哈欠对人有好处。故选D。

questions.prompt: How long has Zhao Xinlu worked in Hoh Xil?
questions.analysis: 25．推理判断题。根据“He has been on patrol(巡逻) since 1997.”可知他自1997年以来一直在巡逻，2023-1997=26，所以他在可可西里工作已经26年了。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did Zhao Xinlu and his team light a fire in the tent?
options: A. Because they wanted to keep themselves warm.
B. Because they wanted to light up the dark night.
C. Because they wanted to tell others where they were patrolling.
D. Because they wanted to stop dangerous animals from getting near.
questions.analysis: 26．细节理解题。根据“At night, there were often brown bears and wolves. ‘We light a fire in the tent to drive them away.’ Zhao said.”可知赵警官和他的团队在帐篷里点火是因为他们想阻止危险的动物靠近。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the main reason for the WGA members’ strike? ________
options: A. Many writers cannot find jobs without AI.
B. The writers want a raise for their hard work.
C. Writers don’t want AI to be used to create and rewrite scripts.
D. Many new projects were recently stopped because of the use of AI.
questions.analysis: 28．细节理解题。根据第二段“They said that AI not be allowed to write or rewrite literary material or be used as source material.”（他们说，AI不被允许编写或改写文学材料，也不被用作原始材料。）可知作家罢工的原因是不想使用AI编写或改写文学材料或用作素材，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do the plagiarism problems in Paragraph 3 refer to? ________
options: A. Writers creating scripts based on AI drafts.
B. Writers copying other writers’ works.
C. AI producing no creative works.
D. AI writing scripts based on a writer’s works.
questions.analysis: 29．细节理解题。根据第三段“AI usually creates scripts based on a writer’ work”（AI通常是基于作家的作品创建剧本）可知抄袭问题就是AI通常是基于作家的作品创建剧本。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined sentence mean? ________
options: A. Writers are happy to see that.
B. Writers want to stop that from happening.
C. Writers don’t care about that.
questions.analysis: 30．句意猜测题。根据第四段“This makes writers want to ‘nip that in the bud’.”（这使得作家们想要“把它扼杀在萌芽状态”。）可知，作家想从开始就阻止这个问题发生，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What might be James Perry’s idea? ________
options: A. AI brings a sense of crisis to writers.
B. AI is affecting the industry in a positive way.
C. AI will replace writers soon.
D. AI doing most jobs is a historical trend.
questions.analysis: 31．推理判断题。根据最后一段“As James Perry, a TV actor and vice—chair of the WGA’s Disabled Writers Committee told Reuters, ‘This is a crisis（危机）for writers.’”可知James Perry认为这是所有作家的一次危机，会给他们带来危机感，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the passage mainly talking about? ________
options: A. A strike requiring limits on AI use.
B. The functions of AI in life.
D. The disadvantages of AI in life.
questions.analysis: 32．主旨大意题。通读全文，可知文章主要介绍了要求限制人工智能使用的罢工。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is A Lion’s Traveling mainly about? ________
options: A. How to survive in the wild.
B. How to be a lion king.
C. The adventures of five lions.
questions.analysis: 33．主旨大意题。根据第二段“The book tells the story of five male lions. They are driven out of their home and begin their adventure.”可知，这本书告诉了五只雄狮的故事：他们被赶出家门，开始了他们的冒险之旅。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How does the third lion die in the book? ________
options: B. It dies in a fight for water.
C. It is killed by a hunter.
D. It is killed by a giraffe.
questions.analysis: 34．细节理解题。根据第二段“The third one dies during a fight for water with a rhino”可知，第三只狮子在与犀牛争夺水源时死亡。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the story, the writer learned that ________.
options: A. passion is the key to a good life
B. good friends are the treasures of life
C. we should defeat people who challenge us
D. difficulties can’t stop us from being our better selves
questions.analysis: 35．细节理解题。根据第三段“Those who cannot defeat you will make you stronger.”和“We should learn to stay strong and continue to find our better selves.”可知，那些不能打败你的人会让你变得更强大，我们应该学会保持坚强，继续寻找更好的自己，即困难不能阻止我们做更好的自己。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why does the writer recommend this book? ________
options: A. Because it offers a good reading experience with vivid details.
B. Because it has great pictures drawn by famous painters.
C. Because it tells people how to protect animals and the environment.
D. Because it comes from a real-life story.
questions.analysis: 36．细节理解题。根据“ The book is filled with exciting details about the life of lions. Together with vivid pictures, it gives readers an immersive experience.”可知，这本书详细的讲述了狮子的生活，并且有生动的插图，给读者以沉浸式的阅读体验。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In which part of the newspaper can we read the passage? ________
questions.analysis: 37．推理判断题。根据文章最后一段“You can not only read the great story but also learn a lot about the animals in the real world. I highly recommend it!”可知，你不仅可以阅读这个伟大的故事，还可以了解很多关于现实世界中动物的知识，因此作者强烈推荐这本书。由此推断本文会出现在“阅读建议”部分。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Deborah Sampson started to work as a servant in ________.
questions.analysis: 38．细节理解题。根据“Deborah Sampson was born in Massachusetts, US in 1760.”以及“At the age of 5, Deborah was taken in by an old woman and was then sent to work as a servant in another home one year later.”可知，是六岁的时候做仆人，也就是1766年。故选C。

questions.prompt: Deborah’s ________ made her different from the average woman of her day.
questions.analysis: 39．细节理解题。根据“growing to be about 173cm tall, almost 30cm taller than the average woman of her day.”可知，她的身高使得她与普通女性不同。故选A。

questions.prompt: The word “it” in Paragraph 4 refers to ________.
questions.analysis: 40．词义猜测题。根据“The bullet was deep in her leg. Using a pocket knife, Deborah took it out.”可知，此处it指的是“腿里的子弹”。故选B。

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is NOT TRUE about Deborah?
options: A. Deborah denied(否认) having another wound when being asked.
B. Deborah treated the wound in her leg by herself.
C. Deborah walked to the hospital after being shot.
D. Deborah went on fighting in the war after being treated.
questions.analysis: 41．推理判断题。根据“One day, during an attack, Deborah was shot in the back and leg. Another soldier took her to the hospital.”可知，黛博拉背部和腿部中弹是另一个士兵把她送到了医院，故选C。

questions.prompt: What was the story mainly about?
options: B. Reasons why Deborah liked adventures.
C. A big poor family Deborah had.
questions.analysis: 42．主旨大意题。根据“She dreamed of going on some adventures.”以及“she still longed for adventure.”可知，文章主要讲述的是Deborah Sampson的冒险经历。故选A。

questions.prompt: The word “gift” in Paragraph 3 probably means “ ________”.
questions.analysis: 43．词义猜测题。根据前句“What they really need is feedback from their leaders.”可知，他们真正需要的是来自领导的反馈，坎迪并没有激发弗兰克的天赋，即能力。故选B。

questions.prompt: According to this article, what is necessary between leaders and team members?
options: A. Being nice to team members is likely to win leaders great respect.
B. Criticizing team members results in serious complaints to the leader.
C. Open and honest communication is a must for leaders and team members.
D. Praise and encouragement from leaders bring out better team performance.
questions.analysis: 44．推理判断题。根据第四段“But with a different mindset, she could have led her team to success and have been a likeable and critical leader.”可知，领导者和团队之间需要进行坦诚的沟通，故选C。

source.sourceSection: （2023·重庆渝中·重庆巴蜀中学校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Based on the passage, which of the following is TRUE?
options: A. Candy should patiently encourage Frank to try his best.
B. Candy should gradually kick Frank off her team.
C. Candy should politely show Frank the improvement he made.
D. Candy should clearly tell Frank her judgment of his performance.
questions.analysis: 45．细节理解题。根据第三段“Failing to question or criticize Frank’s work, Candy was in fact unkind.”以及最后一段“Back to Candy’s case. Not telling Frank how he was on the team only made a hard situation worse.”可知，不告诉弗兰克他在团队里的情况只会使情况变得更糟，坎迪应该清楚地告诉弗兰克她对他的表现的评价。故选D。

source.sourceSection: （2023·重庆渝中·重庆巴蜀中学校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the best title of the passage?
questions.analysis: 46．最佳标题题。根据第四段“A leader had better use open, honest, continuous and clear feedback to help solve someone’s best fit in their job or in the organization.”以及通读全文可知，优秀的领导者要为团队成员提供明确的反馈。所以本文的最佳标题是“成为一名优秀的领导者”。故选A。

source.sourceSection: （2023·重庆渝中·重庆巴蜀中学校考模拟预测）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did the writer learn from her first summer camp?
options: A. How to do a complete job.
B. How to work with others.
C. How to put together a team.
questions.analysis: 47．细节理解题。根据第二段“The camp taught me the ability to work together with others.”可知，这位作家从她的第一次夏令营中学到了如何与他人合作。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why was the writer’s teacher dissatisfied with her job of mopping?
options: A. Because she didn’t finish it.
B. Because she did it too slowly.
C. Because she did a careless job.
D. Because she didn’t know what to do.
questions.analysis: 48．推理判断题。根据第四段“Right when I thought I had completed the job, my teacher kindly pointed out that I had left dirty mop strings (细线) all over the floor.”可知，作者的老师指出作者拖得地板上到处都是脏拖把细线。由此可推知，作者的老师对她的拖地工作不满意是因为她工作粗心大意，不够认真和细心。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did the writer use to be like?
questions.analysis: 49．推理判断题。根据第三段“I felt nervous whenever I had to speak in front of a group,”可知，作者过去害羞，胆小怕人。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which has the closest meaning to the underlined word “transform” in the last paragraph?
questions.analysis: 50．词义猜测题。根据“The experience is likely to transform your life and make you a stronger person in the process.”可知，参加夏令营的这种经历可能会改变你的生活，让你在这个过程中成为一个更强大的人。划线单词transform意为“使改变”。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the writer’s purpose in writing this passage?
options: A. To ask us to be group leaders.
B. To advise us to take part in summer camps.
C. To help us create camp chances for teenagers.
D. To encourage us to be role models for young people.
questions.analysis: 51．推理判断题。根据最后一段“If you are ever given the chance to attend a summer camp and are thinking about not going, think again. The experience is likely to transform your life and make you a stronger person in the process.”可知，作者建议我们参加夏令营，这种经历可能使我们成为一个更强大的人。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: ________ lasts for three days according to Paragraph 1.
questions.analysis: 52．细节理解题。根据“Songkran is the Thai New Year’s national holiday which starts on April 13 every year and lasts for 3 days.”可知，泼水节是泰国新年的国定假日，从每年4月13日开始，为期3天。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: We can know from the passage that ________.
options: A. people go to big cities to celebrate Songkran every year
B. parents can get gifts instead of water on their hands
C. Chiangmai is one of the most popular places during the festival
D. foreign tourists can’t experience Songkran in Thailand
questions.analysis: 53．细节理解题。根据“Chiangmai is the most famous place for Songkran.”可知，清迈是节日期间最受欢迎的地方之一。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why could Ghanem be the ambassador for the Qatar World Cup?
options: A. He is a half-and-half boy.
B. He is good at Qatari dancing.
D. He could swing the soccer ball with hands.
questions.analysis: 55．细节理解题。根据“As an ambassador(使者) for the Qatar World Cup, what he has experienced is more inspirational and legendary!”可知他的经历很励志和传奇。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When Ghanem was born, his parents ________.
options: A. was told that he had a serious disease
B. set up a personal website for him
C. began to practise his hands hard
D. named him and was ready to help him
questions.analysis: 56．细节理解题。根据“But his parents decided to keep the baby and named him Ghanem which means ‘victor’ in Arabic, hoping the boy could be surely the victors of fate. In order to help classmates and neighbors understand the disease”可知他的父母给他命名加内姆，并决定帮助他。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined phrase “become aware of” is closest in meaning to ________.
options: D. pay lots of attention to
questions.analysis: 57．词义猜测题。根据“Ghanem’s parents bought pamphlets(小册子) about caudal-degeneration syndrome and shared them to people so that they could learn about the disease and relieve their curiosity and fear.”以及“Gradually, many of them became aware of Ghanem’s illness and no one laughed at him anymore”可知他父母帮助人们了解这种疾病，人们了解之后，就没有人嘲笑他了，故此处划线部分和“learn a lot about”意义相近。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What made Ghanem overcome difficulties?
questions.analysis: 58．细节理解题。根据“It means everything to me to see my dear parents being proud”可知看到我亲爱的父母感到骄傲对我来说意味着一切，所以是父母的爱让他克服了困难。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which sentence could best describe Ghanem’s stories?
options: A. Action speaks louder than words.
B. Every dog has its day.
C. Nothing is impossible for a willing heart.
D. Who laughs last laughs best.
questions.analysis: 59．推理判断题。本文主要介绍了加内姆·艾·穆夫塔尔虽然天生患有尾部退化综合征，但是在他父母的鼓励下，他克服了很多困难，实现了自己的梦想，从他的故事我们可以学到：心之所愿，无所不成。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did the writer probably feel after Mrs. Blackstone asked her to stay after class?
questions.analysis: 60．推理判断题。根据“My mind raced. Had I made a bad grade? Had I hurt someone’s feelings?”（我的脑子飞快地转。我考得不好吗？我伤害了别人的感情吗？）可知，作者被留下时，是很紧张的，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did Mrs. Blackstone say?
options: A. She saw something special in the writer.
B. The writer didn’t communicate with others.
C. The writer should tell others what she told him.
D. The writer could do better though he didn’t have potential.
questions.analysis: 61．细节理解题。根据“I see something special in you. ”可知，布莱克斯通夫人说她在作者身上看到了一些特别的东西，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following would the writer probably agree with in the end?
options: A. Mrs. Blackstone liked her shoes.
B. The color of the shoes was important.
C. Believing in herself is important.
D. She made a bad grade in the test.
questions.analysis: 62．推理判断题。根据“But you must believe in yourself. Remember that and you’ll go far.”和“I walked out of her class, not looking down at my Mary Jane shoes, but looking straight ahead with my head high.”可知，作者听了老师的话后，走出教室，没有低头看他的鞋，而是抬头直视前方，说明他同意“相信自己很重要”，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many suggestions did the paper doll accept to make a perfect face?
questions.analysis: 63．细节理解题。根据“One with a big beak”、“The perfect face is full of leaves.”“If you want a perfect face, you fill it with colours”以及“drew the paper doll a big smile”可知，一共得到了不止三种建议，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined word “it” in Paragraph 5 refers to “_________”.
questions.analysis: 64．词句猜测题。根据“The doll took all of their advice. Then he had a face. However, it turned out that nobody liked it”（娃娃听从了他们的建议。然后他有了一张脸。然而，事实证明没有人喜欢它。）可知it指的是face。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did the cloud do to help the paper doll?
options: A. She hugged the doll and encouraged him.
B. She helped to paint a beautiful face for the doll.
C. She found out what the perfect face was like by herself.
D. She changed faces to help the doll find the perfect face.
questions.analysis: 65．细节理解题。根据“I think I can help you. As I’m a cloud and do not have a shape, I can make any face you like. What do you think about me changing faces until there is one that you like? I’m sure we can fix you a little bit”可知云换了各种各样的脸，帮助娃娃找到完美的脸。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did the doll’s feelings change according to the passage?
questions.analysis: 66．细节理解题。根据“Once upon a time, there was a happy paper doll that had no face”（快乐）、“‘I only wanted a face that everyone would like,’ he cried.”（悲伤）、“The doll again felt hopeful.”（充满希望）、“the doll jumped excitedly ”（激动）可知，纸娃娃的感觉是从“快乐→悲伤→充满希望→激动”。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the passage we learn _________ is the key to a perfect face.
questions.analysis: 67．细节理解题。根据“And that face was indeed the only one that everyone liked because it had the secret ingredient for perfect faces: a big smile that came from the heart and which could never be erased.”可知那张脸确实是每个人都喜欢的唯一一张脸，因为它有完美面孔的秘密成分：发自内心的灿烂笑容，永远无法抹去。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What was Jackson doing when he almost fell?
questions.analysis: 1．细节理解题。根据“Jackson was walking home from school one afternoon when his untied shoelaces (鞋带) caught his foot. He almost fell.”可知，在街上走路的时候差点摔倒，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is the best to fill in the “ ▲ ” in the passage?
options: A. Jackson fell down and hurt his knee.
B. Jackson got hit by a car and kept bleeding.
C. Jackson got caught by his shoelaces and fell.
D. Jackson broke his leg and his head was hurt.
questions.analysis: 2．推理判断题。根据“He doesn’t even remember anything about the accident!”可知，脑袋受伤了所以几乎记不得任何东西，D选项“Jackson摔断了腿，头部也受了伤”符合，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the last sentence of the passage, we can infer that everyone was ________.
questions.analysis: 3．推理判断题。根据“Everyone stopped talking and stared at him.”可知，大家都传Jackson被车撞，失忆了，当Jackson出现在大家面前的时候，每个人停止讨论盯着他，都感到很惊讶，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The best title for the passage can probably be ________.
questions.analysis: 4．最佳标题题。通读全文可知，本文由Jackson差点摔倒而引发一系列的谣言，每个人都有不一样的说法，所以B选项“他说，她说”符合本文标题，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The kites were invented more than ________ years ago.
questions.analysis: 5．细节理解题。根据“He told them that kites were invented in China more than two thousand years ago.”可知风筝是中国两千多年前发明的。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Judie wanted to make a ________ kite.
questions.analysis: 6．细节理解题。根据“Judie’s dad agreed that it would be a good idea to make a butterfly kite.”可知朱迪想要做蝴蝶风筝，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When Judie made a kite she used ________.
questions.analysis: 7．细节理解题。根据“They made a cross with some wood sticks, then Judie painted a butterfly on a piece of white paper. Next, they stuck the paper on the cross. Finally, they tied a long tail to the bottom”可知用到了木棍和纸，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does a butterfly mean to Judie?
questions.analysis: 8．细节理解题。根据“To me, butterflies mean beauty and freedom”可知对朱迪来说，蝴蝶意味着美丽和自由。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE?
options: A. Judie asked her parents for help and they agreed.
B. Judie might have a better understanding of kites than before.
C. Judie stuck the paper on the cross and tied a long tail to the top.
D. Judie took the kite to the yard and played with her dad.
questions.analysis: 9．推理判断题。根据“I expect each of you to make a kite that means something important to you. In that case, you will have a better understanding of kites than before.”（我希望你们每个人都能做一个对自己有重要意义的风筝。在这种情况下，你会比以前更好地了解风筝。）可推断朱迪可能比以前更了解风筝了。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did the writer buy a bottle of water for the old man?
options: A. Because the old man was one of his friends.
B. Because he was a nice person.
C. Because his daughter asked him to do that.
D. Because he wanted the old man to say “thank you”.
questions.analysis: 10．细节理解题。根据“We just wanted to be nice.”可知，作者给老人买了一瓶水，因为作者是个好人。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “scoops” probably mean in Paragraph 4?
questions.analysis: 12．词句猜测题。分析“She scoops up things that other people drop.”可知，别人掉的东西，她应该是捡起来。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the passage, we can know that ________.
options: A. the old man said “thank you” to the writer and his daughter
B. the businessman bought a bottle of water for the old man
C. the writer’s daughter hardly reaches out to help people
D. the writer sets a good example to his daughter in her life
questions.analysis: 13．细节理解题。根据“And because I see you do that all the time.”可知，作者为他女儿的生活树立了一个好榜样。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the writer’s purpose of writing this passage?
options: A. To tell us to learn to share with others.
B. To tell us not to laugh at the poor.
C. To tell us kindness in action speaks louder than words.
D. To share a funny experience with us.
questions.analysis: 14．主旨大意题。本文讲述作者做善事给女儿树立了一个很好的榜样，女儿长大后养成了乐于助人的好品质，选项C“告诉我们，行动中的善良比言语更响亮”符合主题，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where did Jim and Jack come from?
questions.analysis: 15．细节理解题。根据“Jim and Jack came from a small town.”可知他们来自一个小镇。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why didn’t Jim and Jack realize their dream according to Paragraph 3?
options: A. Their pots were not good.
B. City people didn’t like pots.
C. They lost the way to the city.
D. Their pots were broken into pieces.
questions.analysis: 16．细节理解题。根据“Unluckily, the ship met a strong storm on the way. After the storm, the ship landed. All the pots were broken into pieces”可知不幸的是，船在途中遇到了一场强风暴，暴风雨过后，船靠岸了。所有的罐子都碎了。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did Jim and Jack do to make money at last?
questions.analysis: 17．细节理解题。根据“So Jim and Jack used the broken pots to make mosaic tiles (马赛克瓷砖) and sold them to the city people. In this way, they made much money and returned home happily.”可知他们用破罐子做马赛克瓷砖，然后卖给城里人，就这样，他们赚了很多钱。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the story mainly want to tell us?
options: B. It never rains but it pours.
C. Where there is an active mind, there is hope.
D. The grass is always greener on the other side.
questions.analysis: 18．推理判断题。本文主要讲述了两人制作了陶瓷罐，在运输途中遇到暴风雨，陶瓷罐都碎了，但是两个人在城里玩得很开心，因为他们认为陶瓷罐已经碎了，如果再失去开心就更不幸。结果他们发现可以用破罐子做马赛克瓷砖，故本文主要告诉我们：哪里有积极的思想，哪里就有希望。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What was the weather like in the story?
questions.analysis: 19．细节理解题。根据“When Mark walked empty-handed up the sand, the sun was shining brightly.”可知，那天天气很好，阳光明媚，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “beneath” in Paragraph 5 mean?
questions.analysis: 20．词义猜测题。根据“Mark knew crayfish usually hid in the darkness beneath rocks, only coming out at night to feed. How long would his crayfish remain there before it went back under the rocks?”可知，小龙虾通常躲在黑暗的岩石下面，只在晚上出来觅食，单词“beneath”指的是“在……下方”，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the underlined sentence, we can see the children were ________.
questions.analysis: 21．推理判断题。根据“They looked at each other and spoke softly so he couldn’t hear. ‘Is that all?’ ‘Is he giving up?’ ”以及划线句子可知，岸边观看的孩子原本以为Mark放弃了，但是Mark休息之后又振作起来了，再次下到水里，孩子们都在为他这次能否抓住小龙虾而紧张，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the last two paragraphs?
options: A. Mark caught the crayfish at last.
B. Mark was building up his confidence.
C. Mark lost heart and planned to give up.
D. Mark hurried to dive before everything was right.
questions.analysis: 22．细节理解题。根据“ ‘You hurried too much. Take your time. Prepare yourself. Don’t dive until everything feels right,’ he spoke to himself calmly, and he felt the confidence building up inside him. ‘I can do it. I can do it.’ He felt good”可知，Mark正在建立他的信心，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the main idea of the story?
options: A. What Mark ate to get his energy back.
B. What Mark did to reduce his pressure.
C. How Mark kept trying to get the crayfish.
D. How Mark prepared himself well for diving.
questions.analysis: 23．主旨大意题。根据整个文章的介绍可知，主要介绍在阳光明媚的一天，Mark试图抓小龙虾的故事，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did the writer go to the coffee shop?
options: B. To have a cup of coffee.
D. To watch some boys playing.
questions.analysis: 24．细节理解题。根据“Last Saturday, I went to a coffee shop to meet a friend of mine.”可知，作者去咖啡店见一位朋友。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the cause of the accident?
options: A. The driver was too tired.
C. The driver drove too fast.
D. There was something wrong with the car.
questions.analysis: 25．细节理解题。根据“Suddenly, there came a car. It was going very fast.”可知。司机开得太快了，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How long did the writer stay in the police station?
options: C. About one and a half hours.
questions.analysis: 26．推理判断题。根据“At 6: 30 pm, the police arrived and started questioning people. About half an hour later, they asked me to go to the police station because I saw everything…I didn’t leave the police station until 8: 00 p.m.”可知，晚上6：30警察到了，开始询问人们，半个小时之后，也就是7点钟作者到了警察局，直到晚上8点才离开警察局，所以是在警察局待了1个小时，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did the parents say thanks to the writer?
options: A. He sent the boy to the hospital.
B. He helped catch the driver.
C. He caught the card river himself.
D. He made the call to the police.
questions.analysis: 27．推理判断题。根据“I gave them all the information I knew because I really wanted them to catch the driver.…The next day, the boy’s parents called me to say thanks. They also told me their boy was fine and the driver was at the police station now.”可知，因为作者帮忙抓住了司机，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What made Mark sad?
options: A. His being the shortest among his brothers.
B. His few chances to visit gardens.
C. His low grades in his class.
D. His getting less attention at home.
questions.analysis: 31．细节理解题。根据“There is nothing special about me. Well, I am smaller than my elder brother and I am bigger than my younger brother”和“I knew he felt that he, was not getting the same attention.”可知马克伤心是因为他在家没有得到相同的关注，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What happened when Mark threw the biggest rock into the stream?
options: A. The rock went the farthest.
B. The rock went the nearest.
C. The rock made a very big splash.
D. The rock went as far as the little stone.
questions.analysis: 32．细节理解题。根据“Although it made a very big splash（飞溅的水）, it didn’t go very far. ”可知当马克把最大的一块石头扔进小溪溅了一个很大的水花。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which is the best word to describe the writer?
questions.analysis: 33．推理判断题。根据“You see, Mark, you are like the middle-sized rock. In this situation the little rock was too light, the big rock was too heavy, but the middle-sized rock was just right. ”以及“Yes, Mark, everyone and everything is special and has a special purpose, especially you”可知作者在恰当的时候来开导马克，让马克觉得自己很特别，所以可以看出作者很明智，很聪明，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the writer want to tell us?
options: A. A person may do everything on purpose.
B. Bigger may not be better.
C. One can go the farthest without pain.
D. Everyone is special in fact.
questions.analysis: 34．主旨大意题。根据“everyone and everything is special and has a special purpose”可知作者想告诉我们每个人都很特别，有特殊的用途。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之记叙文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is given to a ticket holder for free?
questions.analysis: 1．细节理解题。根据“Each ticket costs $10 and each ticket holder can get a free bag of popcorn as well.”可知，爆米花是免费提供的。故选C。

questions.prompt: Where should parents pick up their children after the movie?
options: B. In front of the ticket office.
D. At the back door of the New Hall.
questions.analysis: 3．细节理解题。根据“At the end of the movie, children are to be picked up at the back door of the New Hall.”可知，家长们要在新大厅的后门接走孩子。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之应用文（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do Jack and Bryan have in common?
options: A. They have a gift for learning languages.
B. They get along well with others.
C. They are good at solving problems.

questions.analysis: 4．细节理解题。根据“When I’m having trouble with a decision, I usually write things down. questions.prompt: Why do some people like a messy desk?
options: A. Because they are lazy and untidy.
B. Because they want to do things well.
C. Because it helps them focus on tasks easily.
D. Because it helps them do their work patiently.
questions.analysis: 1．细节理解题。根据“People who like a messy desk have their own ideas. Some think it makes them comfortable. Some believe it helps them focus（专注） more easily.”（喜欢凌乱办公桌的人有自己的想法。有些人认为这让他们感到舒适。一些人认为这有助于他们更容易集中注意力）可知，因为凌乱的办公桌能帮助他们更容易地专注于任务。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the experiment done by Kathleen Vohs show us?
options: A. Disorder is welcomed by most people in this world.
B. A messy desktop has a bad influence on people's minds.
C. People working with a tidy desktop can also be successful.
D. People working with a messy desktop may be more creative.
questions.analysis: 2．细节理解题。根据“For example, in an experiment（实验） done by Kathleen Vohs, people in the messy group came up with more interesting and creative ideas about the new uses of ping-pong balls...Messy environments seem to inspire（激发） people to think up fresh ideas”可知，研究表明，在凌乱的环境下工作的人可能更有创造力。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can be the best title for the passage?
options: A. Messy Desk: Do People Need to Change It?
B. Messy Desk: Does It Make People Comfortable?
C. Messy Desk: Do People Get Used to It?
D. Messy Desk: Does It Help People Work Patiently?
questions.analysis: 3．标题归纳题。本文主要围绕桌面凌乱对人的影响展开论述，通过实例验证了在桌面凌乱的环境下工作的人更具有创造性，分析了桌面整洁与凌乱的不同影响：当你需要新想法时，凌乱的办公桌可能是一个不错的选择；但是当你想要快速成功地完成一项任务时，把桌子弄得干净整洁似乎更好。所以最佳题目是：“凌乱的办公桌：人们需要改变它吗？”故选A。

questions.prompt: What kind of difference do heroes make in the world?
questions.analysis: 4．细节理解题。根据第三段中的最后一句“They make a positive difference in the world”可知，英雄对世界有积极的影响。故选C。

questions.analysis: 6．段落大意题。第三段主要讲的是做一些勇敢的事情会让世界有所不同。故选B。

questions.prompt: How does social media change relationships, according to the article? ________
options: A. It pushes people to meet their friends more often offline.
B. It encourages people to pay more attention to those around them.
C. It enables users to understand correctly what others are talking about online.
D. It allows people to keep in touch with their friends who live far away more easily.
questions.analysis: 16．细节理解题。根据第三段“Yet, some people believe social media has made it easier to start relationships with anyone from anywhere. Beth Kaplan from Illinois met her long-distance friend through social media. Now he lives in Scotland, but they’re still often able to communicate with each other.”可知人们相隔遥远也可以通过方便的社交软件得到联系。故选D。

questions.prompt: The underlined word “comments” means ________ in the passage.
questions.analysis: 17．词义猜测题。此句“Negative comments can also do damage to a teenager self-esteem(自尊). Teenagers who get negative comments can’t help but feel hurt.”句意为“负面评论也会损害青少年的自尊。受到负面评价的青少年会不由自主地感到受伤。”由此可知，下划线单词 “comments”意为“评价”。故选A。

questions.prompt: What does Essena O’Neill think of social media? ________
options: B. It helps her make friends.
D. It makes her tired of using social media app Yik Yak.
questions.analysis: 18．细节理解题。根据第五段“The 19-year-old Essena O’Neill announced on the social networking service Instagram that she had stopped using social media. She thought she had gotten lost in appearing perfect online.”可知她发现自己过度沉迷于网络。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which statement about the use of social media would Armin Korsos probably agree with? ________
options: A. Using social media can only get negative comments.
B. Using social media can only reduce face-to-face communication.
C. Using social media is necessary because it can help know friends well anytime.
D. Social media can create opportunities for teenagers to develop themselves.
questions.analysis: 19．细节理解题。根据第七段“Social media can help people show themselves and their talents to the world in a way that was never possible before”可知Korsos 认为, 合理正确的使用了社交媒介能够对青少年有很大的好处，可以向他人展示才华。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about? ________
options: A. The major problems with social media.
B. Social media’s influence on teenagers.
C. How teenagers benefit (受益) from social media.
D. Why social media attracts so many teenagers.
questions.analysis: 20．主旨大意题。根据第—段“Social media is one of the fastest-growing industries in the world today…The wide use of social media has changed nearly all parts of teenagers lives.”可知，社交媒体是当今世界上发展最快的行业之—，社交媒体的广泛传播改变了青少年生活的几乎所有部分，主要从三个方面的改变进行说明。由此可知，本文的主题是社交媒体对青少年的影响。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第04讲 阅读理解之议论文（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How does the writer begin the text?
questions.analysis: 21．细节理解题。根据第一段“Huang Yu’s beloved cat Dasuan died. Huang was quite sad. But 66 days later, Dasuan ‘come back’. Huang got a new cat that looks almost the same as Dasuan thanks to cloning technology.”可知，作者通过列举黄雨的例子开始写文章，故选A。

options: B. Why Do You Take Selfies

questions.analysis:
37．最佳标题。通读全文并根据“But what does it say about selfies...”及“Selfies allow you to keep taking pictures until you manage to take one you’re happy with...”可知，文章主要论述人们为什么要“自拍”。所以，文章的最佳标题为“你为什么‘自拍’”。故选B。
（一）（2023·浙江湖州·统考中考真题）
①Chinese calligraphy (书法) was once considered an important part of the school curriculum (课程). However, for many reasons, some people think it’s less important to teach this art form at school now. In this article, I will look at both the pros and cons of learning Chinese calligraphy at school.
②One reason why Chinese calligraphy should be learned at school is that it is an important form of culture expression. Clearly, it is not just about practicing handwriting. It is also about connecting with a traditional Chinese art form. When students learn this art in class, they will become more interested in the works of famous Chinese artists.
③Another reason is that it may help students to develop patience. At the times of high technology, students are getting less patient for traditional classroom learning. By introducing Chinese calligraphy into the classroom, students’ patience can be improved because they have to practice focusing on each brush movement.
④From the above, it can be seen that there are clear advantages. However, others think there are some disadvantages. The first one is that it has little to do with students’ life. Living in a modern age, pens and paper will lose their importance by and by. So, wouldn’t it be a backward (倒退的) step if students were asked to spend their valuable time at school learning Chinese calligraphy?
⑤The second argument against learning Chinese calligraphy at school is that it takes a long time to master. The time at school is better spent on more important subjects. After all, learning Chinese calligraphy can always be done as an after-school activity if students are really interested in it.
⑥In my opinion, the advantages far outweigh the disadvantages. This special art form is one of China’s national treasures. It also helps to enrich students’ life and improve their sense of beauty. So without doubt, it is worth being included in the school curriculum.

options: A. if parrots can learn to make video calls
B. if parrots can benefit from video calling
C. why parrots can have so many benefit

questions.analysis: 1．细节理解题。根据“There are 20 million parrots living in people’s homes in the USA, and we wanted to explore whether those birds might benefit (受益) from video calling too.”可知，在美国，有2000万只鹦鹉生活在人们的家中，我们想探索一下这些鹦鹉是否也能从视频通话中受益。由此可知，这项研究的主要目的是找出鹦鹉是否能从视频通话中受益。故选B。

questions.analysis: 11．最佳标题题。通读全文可知，文章以克丽丝丢失一条项链为起点，讲述了瑞安从发现项链、到内心挣扎，最后再归还项链的过程。结合文章最后“I thought about the mean kids at school and how holding on to beautiful things often made me feel better.”可知，瑞安虽然“失去”了项链，但是最后找到了诚实善良的美好品质，故“Lost and Found”可作为文章标题。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题08 阅读理解（记叙文）-学易金卷：三年（2021-2023）中考英语真题分项汇编（江苏专用）

questions.prompt: Which dynasty is the poem Song of Autumn written in?
questions.analysis: 20．细节理解题。根据“Today, I’d like to recommend Song of Autumn, one of the poems by Liu Yuxi(772-842), a famous poet and writer in the mid Tang dynasty.”可知，《秋词》是唐代诗人刘禹锡写的，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题08 阅读理解（记叙文）-学易金卷：三年（2021-2023）中考英语真题分项汇编（江苏专用）

questions.prompt: How was autumn in Liu’s eyes at that time?
options: A. He thought it was a sad time.
B. He thought that autumn was rather cloudy.
C. He thought Spring was better.
D. He thought autumn was a hopeful season.
questions.analysis: 21．细节理解题。根据“In Liu’s eyes, autumn, full of life and hope, is even better than spring morning.”可知，在刘的眼中，充满生机和希望的秋天甚至比春天的早晨还要美好。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题08 阅读理解（记叙文）-学易金卷：三年（2021-2023）中考英语真题分项汇编（江苏专用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is the feature of Liu Yuxi’s works according to the passage?
options: B. Describing daily life of young people.
C. Picturing blue sky and a crane.
D. Writing songs according to music.
questions.analysis: 22．细节理解题。根据“With his poems paying special attention to expressing personal feelings, as well as the daily life of common people, Liu wrote poems with beautiful music-like words.”可知，他的诗特别注重表达个人情感，以及普通人的日常生活，他的诗用优美的音乐般的词语。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题08 阅读理解（记叙文）-学易金卷：三年（2021-2023）中考英语真题分项汇编（江苏专用）

questions.prompt: How did Liu feel about living in a humble cell in the writer’s opinion?
questions.analysis: 23．细节理解题。根据“However, it also shows how he was pleased with the poor and simple life.”可知，《陋室铭》显示了他是如何满足于贫穷和简单的生活。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题08 阅读理解（记叙文）-学易金卷：三年（2021-2023）中考英语真题分项汇编（江苏专用）

questions.prompt: Influenced by Liu Yuxi, which of the following does the writer think is the most important?
options: A. To be a respectable man.
B. To live in a big house.
questions.analysis: 24．细节理解题。根据“I think to be a respectable man is more important than to live in big houses, to wear beautiful clothes, to enjoy delicious food, and even to gain knowledge.”可知，作者认为做一个受人尊敬的人比住大房子，穿漂亮的衣服，享受美味的食物，甚至获得知识更重要。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题08 阅读理解（记叙文）-学易金卷：三年（2021-2023）中考英语真题分项汇编（江苏专用）

questions.prompt: When Mother was ill, Peter, Roberta, and Phyllis tried to get help by ________.
options: B. looking for a greater doctor
C. waiting for Father at the station
D. writing a letter to the old gentleman
questions.analysis: 25．细节理解题。根据“The train left the station. The old gentleman sat down and read the letter. It was from Peter.”可知，母亲生病时，彼得、罗伯塔和菲利斯给老先生写了一封信，试图寻求帮助。故选D。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “it” in paragraph 6 refer to?

questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes the old gentleman?

questions.prompt: According to the story, Ginger ________ her training.
questions.analysis: 30．推理判断题。根据“My training started with several men forcing me against a wall. One held my nose and another pulled my mouth open to put a bit(马嚼子) in.”可知，Ginger的训练始于几个人把她逼到墙边，一个捏住她的鼻子，另一个把她的嘴拉开，往嘴里塞东西。由此推知，Ginger会讨厌她的训练。故选C。

questions.prompt: Which can be put in “________” in the story?
options: A. If you had a master like Mr Gordon.
B. If you had no food to eat
C. If you went through my life
D. If you were a female horse
questions.analysis: 31．推理判断题。联系后文内容可知，Ginger讲述了自己的经历，说明自己为什么会咬人，选项C“如果你经历我的生活”符合语境，故选C。

options: A. How Ginger met Black Beauty.
B. When Ginger would leave this home.
C. Where Black Beauty would go next.
D. How Black Beauty helped Ginger.
questions.analysis: 32．推理判断题。根据“What can I do for her? I couldn’t stop thinking about it.”可知，Black Beauty一直在想能为Ginger做些什么，由此推知，接下来作者可能会写Black Beauty是如何帮助Ginger的。故选D。

questions.prompt: Why is today a typical day for Yang Jinlong?
options: A. He is teaching students about kuaiban as usual.
B. His work starts at 9 and lasts 6 hours like every day.
C. He is preparing for a kuaiban competition today.
D. His life today is as busy and boring as every day.
questions.analysis: 33．细节理解题。根据“At 9 a. m. , he drives to primary schools and middle schools in Xi’an, Shaanxi Province, to teach students about Shaanxi kuaiban”可知，因为他和往常一样去教学生快板，故选A。

questions.prompt: Which of the following about Shaanxi kuaiban is TRUE?
options: A. It is named after the Shaanxi dialect.
B. It is listed in the national intangible cultural heritage.
C. It is more popular than the piano and violin in northern China.
D. It is played to tell stories usually about common people.
questions.analysis: 34．细节理解题。根据“On June 10, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism announced 325 national intangible cultural heritage(非物质文化遗产) items in Beijing, increasing the list to 1, 557 items. Shaanxi kuaiban, which appeared during the late Qing Dynasty, has been included”可知，陕西快板被列为国家级非物质文化遗产，故选B。

source.sourceSection: （2022·江苏常州·统考中考真题）This is a typical(典型的) day for Yang Jinlong.

questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes Yang Jinlong?
questions.analysis: 35．推理判断题。根据“including Shaanxi kuaiban, which I’ll work for my whole life”及“Thanks to artists like Yang, this traditional Chinese form of storytelling is passed on and stays alive in our country”可知，杨金龙将为快板奉献一生，他也将中国文化传递下去，由此可推断他是有奉献精神的，故选A。

source.sourceSection: （2022·江苏常州·统考中考真题）This is a typical(典型的) day for Yang Jinlong.

questions.prompt: Why does the writer report Yang Jinlong’s story?
options: A. To show how to play Shaanxi kuaiban in the local dialect.
B. To tell the difference between Chinese and Western arts.
C. To prove that kuaiban players are living a busy life.
D. To praise the work of spreading traditional Chinese art.
questions.analysis: 36．推理判断题。根据“Thanks to artists like Yang, this traditional Chinese form of storytelling is passed on and stays alive in our country”可知，作者想通过杨金龙通过教授学生快板来传递中国文化的故事，来赞扬传播中国传统艺术的作品，故选D。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “budge” mean in this story?
questions.analysis: 37．词句猜测题。根据“She practiced shooting softly at first. The marble rolled from her thumb(拇指) and clicked against the targeted(作为目标的) marble. But the target wouldn’t budge.”可知，起初，她轻轻地弹。弹珠从她的拇指上滚下来，在目标弹珠上发出咔嗒声。但目标弹珠没有移动。budge此处与move意思一致，表示“移动”。故选D。

questions.prompt: How does Dacty hurt his wings?
options: A. He plays games with the children.
B. He falls off the tree when flying.
C. He bangs on the walls in Helen’s room.
D. He practises flying in the museum.
questions.analysis: 40．细节理解题。根据“My room is too small and Dacty keeps banging（碰撞）his wings on the walls”可知它的翅膀撞到了海伦房间的墙上伤到了翅膀。故选C。

questions.prompt: Which word can best describe Dacty?
questions.analysis: 41．推理判断题。根据“Thank you, you did a great job”以及文章可知Dacty能够将小偷抓住，可知它非常的聪明。故选D。

questions.prompt: What can we infer（推断）from the story?
options: A. All dinosaurs enjoy cold weather and jungles.
B. Humans and animals should care about each other.
C. Children think it necessary to raise an animal at home.
D. It is better for a dinosaur to live with humans than in nature.
questions.analysis: 43．推理判断题。通读全文可知，海伦和罗杰照顾Dacty，在它受伤的时候给它看医生，Dacty也帮助抓到了小偷，由此我们可推出人类和动物应该互相关心。故选B。

questions.prompt: Which sentence should go in the empty box in Paragraph 4 from the bottom?
options: A. The neighbourhood I grew up in has a fence like this.
B. We’ve passed through the hole in the fence.
C. Beyond that fence stands Sandy’s blue house.
D. I’m a person who looks on the bad side of the fence.
questions.analysis: 49．推理判断题。根据“We have a pleasant afternoon with Sandy, my son’s adult friend, the first friend Daniel has made on his own”可知，作者和桑迪度过了愉快的下午，儿子的成年朋友丹尼尔是他自己交的第一位朋友，儿子和桑迪之前通过篱笆的洞进行交流，现在直接见面，已经打破了篱笆的障碍。B选项“我们穿越了篱笆的那个洞”合适。故选B。

questions.analysis: 51．主旨大意题。文章主要讲述作者的儿子丹尼尔和成年的朋友桑迪忘年交的经历。B选项“Trust and friendship can go beyond ages信任和友谊可以打破年龄的界线”可概括。故选B。

questions.prompt: Why did White Fang always lose the fights with Lip-Lip?
options: A. Because he was bigger and stronger than Lip-Lip.
B. Because he was smaller and weaker than Lip-Lip.
C. Because he wanted to make Lip-Lip happy.
D. Because he wanted to make friends with Lip-Lip.
questions.analysis: 52．细节理解题。根据“He was bigger and stronger than White Fang and always won their fights”可知，因为Lip-Lip比White Fang更强壮更大，故选B。

B. White Fang would enjoy staying with people

questions.prompt: Why did Lisa stay with Grandpa alone for a few days?
options: A. She was on her summer vacation.
B. She missed her grandfather very much.
C. Her grandfather needed an operation soon.
D. Her parents had to look after her sick brother.
questions.analysis: 57．细节理解题。根据“But now Jack needed an operation. Lisa had to stay here alone for a few days.”可知，现在杰克需要做手术，丽萨不得不独自在这里跟爷爷待几天，故选D。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “muffled” probably mean?
questions.analysis: 58．词义猜测题。分析“Grandpa’s voice sounded muffled. His words were coming from inside the storehouse.”可知，爷爷的声音听起来很低沉，他的话是从仓库里传出来的。所以muffled的意思是“低沉的，不清楚的”，故选C。

questions.prompt: The passage tells about Grandpa EXCEPT that ________.
options: B. he was a man of few words
C. he had black and white hair
D. he kept a wooden box for Lisa
questions.analysis: 59．细节理解题。根据“His hair was black and white”，“You don’t talk much, Grandpa”和“He pointed to a small wooden box with ‘Lisa’ painted on it in bright green letters.”可知，文章没有提到爷爷喜欢做DIY，故选A。

questions.prompt: What did Lisa promise to do at the end of the story?
options: A. Take care of her brother.
questions.analysis: 60．推理判断题。根据“I might need more than one visit to my box”可知，丽萨可能需要不止一次的访问盒子，也就是说丽萨会经常来看爷爷，故选D。

questions.prompt: The meaning of the underlined word “perseverance” is ________.
options: A. the quality of continuing trying
B. the quality of being brave enough
C. thinking about what will happen next
D. thinking about what's the best thing to do
questions.analysis: 61．词义猜测题。根据“Be in earnest, and you will soon learn it. To show you that it only requires perseverance”可知，父亲希望儿子认真一点，只要有毅力，不断地去尝试，很快就会学会它，perseverance与the quality of continuing trying同义，故选A。

source.sourceSection: （2021·江苏南通·统考中考真题）“Have you finished your lesson, George?” said Mr. Prentice to his son, who had laid aside his book and was busy making a large paper kite.

questions.prompt: According to the passage, we can see Mr. Prentice ________.
options: A. was encouraged by his teacher
B. was a top student at first
C. is always impatient with his son
D. is a kind and wise father
questions.analysis: 63．推理判断题。通读全文可知，爸爸看到儿子中途放弃了功课，并没有马上责怪儿子，而是通过讲述自己的故事来告诉儿子，要不断地去尝试，不能轻易地放弃，由此可见，这位父亲是和蔼和明智的，故选D。

questions.prompt: Which can be the best title for the passage?
questions.analysis: 64．最佳标题。通读全文及本文反复出现“Try again”这个词，可知，父亲不断鼓励儿子再次尝试，不要中途放弃，所以“再次尝试”适合本文标题，故选B。

questions.prompt: What information is mentioned in the first story?
options: A. The time Derek spent on the race.
B. The person who crossed the line with Derek.
C. The speed Derek ran for the first 150 meters.
D. The names of the runners who went past Derek.
questions.analysis: 65．细节理解题。根据“And so together they walked the last 50 metres and crossed the line”可知，第一个故事里提到了和Derek一起冲向终点的人，也就是他的爸爸，故选B。

questions.prompt: Which of the following can be put in ________.
options: A. Gerlinde went back to base-camp
C. Gerlinde tied some rope to the rocks
D. Gerlinde wanted to try again
questions.analysis: 66．句意猜测题。根据上一段“He fell 1,000 metres and was killed.”可知在第一次攀爬中，失去了朋友，所以她回到了大本营，A选项“Gerlinde回到了大本营”符合，故选A。

questions.prompt: What did the two main characters have in common?
options: A. They both came from Britain.
B. They both failed the 400-metre race.
C. They both had the dream to climb high mountains.
D. They were both brave people who didn’t give up.
questions.analysis: 67．推理判断题。通读全文可知，这两个人的共同特点都是遇到了某些困难，但是最终都没有放弃，故选D。

questions.prompt: What does the writer mainly want to tell us?
options: A. The most important thing is to win the race.
B. When things go wrong, we must stop at once.
C. When we start something, we should try to finish.
D. We shouldn’t start a race if we think we can’t win.
questions.analysis: 68．主旨大意题。通读全文可知，作者想通过运动员Derek Redmond和登山员Gerlinde Kaltenbrunner的励志故事告诉我们，当我们开始某件事时，应该坚持完成，而不要中途放弃，故选C。

questions.prompt: Which of the following words best describes Miss Temple in the passage?
questions.analysis: 69．推理判断题。根据“We followed Miss Temple to her apartment...Tell us the truth, but add nothing and exaggerate（夸大）nothing.” ”可知，Miss Temple是一个乐于助人，关心他人的人，故选C。

options: A. Miss Temple was going to punish Jane.
B. Helen would rather leave Jane alone.
C. Nothing could make Jane happy again.
D. Jane’s luck might change for the better.
questions.analysis: 70．推理判断题。根据文中划线部分可知，通过周围景色的描述以及Miss Temple的出现可以推断出，在Miss Temple的说服下，Jane可能会有些改变，Jane的运气可能从此会变好，故选D。

questions.prompt: According to the passage, which of the following is true about Jane?
options: A. She chose to trust Miss Temple.
B. She didn’t mind being accused.
C. She made up her childhood story.
D. She once behaved as a bad girl.
questions.analysis: 71．推理判断题。根据“I made up my mind that I would be most modest and most correct. Having thought for a few minutes about where to start, I told her all the story of my sad childhood.”可知，作者最后决定做一个最谦虚、最正确的人，告诉了Miss Temple她的悲惨童年的故事，说明她最终选择相信Miss Temple，故选A。

questions.prompt: What is Around the World?
questions.analysis: 1．细节理解题。根据文中“Around the World was Eddie's favorite classroom game. He loved racing against a classmate to solve a math problem.”可知，环球世界是数学游戏，故选A。

source.sourceSection: （2023·浙江丽水·统考中考真题）There were only 15 minutes until lunch. But everyone in Mrs. Stretch’s math class was waiting excitedly for the start of Around the World.

options: A. Talia was really good at math.
B. Mrs. Stretch liked the champion best.

D. Michael was hard-working but seldom helped others.
questions.analysis: 2．细节理解题。根据“The class sat shocked, then everyone cheered for Talia, today’s champion.”可知，塔里亚的数学真的很好，故选A。

questions.analysis: 3．推理判断题。根据“I think they cheered because they were too surprised,”可知，此处是问原因的，故选B。

questions.prompt: Which of the following can best express the message（启示）of the story?
options: A. Once a champion, always a champion.
B. To be a good loser is to learn how to win.
C. The only way to grow is to challenge yourself.
D. Never forget failure is just an event, not a person.
questions.analysis: 4．主旨大意题。根据“Because of you, we probably have the best math class in the whole school.”可知，文章告诉我们失败只是一件事们不要因为失败而否定自己曾经的成就，选项D“永远不要忘记失败只是一件事，而不是一个人。”符合题意，故选D。

questions.prompt: What was Caspian’s favourite hour during a day?
options: A. When he played with wonderful toys.
B. When his uncle had a walk with him.
C. When he learned to ride a horse.
D. When Nurse told him stories.
questions.analysis: 5．细节理解题。根据“Though he had wonderful toys, he liked best the last hour of the day when the toys had all been put away and Nurse would tell him stories.”可知，虽然他有很多很棒的玩具，但他最喜欢一天的最后一个小时，那时玩具都收好了，保姆会给他讲故事。故选D。

source.sourceSection: （2023·重庆·统考中考真题）Prince Caspian’s parents died. He lived with his uncle, Miraz, the King of Narnia and his aunt. Though he had wonderful toys, he liked best the last hour of the day when the toys had all been put away and Nurse would tell him stories.

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “tiresome” in Paragraph 5 mean?
questions.analysis: 6．词句猜测题。分析“Up till now the King had been talking in a tiresome way, which made it quite clear that he wasn’t really interested in what they were saying, but he suddenly gave Caspian a sharp(锐利的) look.”可知，到现在为止，国王一直在用一种令人厌烦的口气说话，显然他对他们说的话并不感兴趣，但他突然狠狠地看了凯斯宾一眼。此处tiresome的意思是“令人厌烦的”，故选B。

source.sourceSection: （2023·重庆·统考中考真题）Prince Caspian’s parents died. He lived with his uncle, Miraz, the King of Narnia and his aunt. Though he had wonderful toys, he liked best the last hour of the day when the toys had all been put away and Nurse would tell him stories.

questions.prompt: What can we infer from the passage?
options: A. Caspian didn’t live with his uncle and his aunt.
B. Caspian wasn’t satisfied with his present life.
C. Caspian thought this uncle was a great king.
D. Caspian had an enjoyable walk with his uncle.
questions.analysis: 7．推理判断题。根据“I wish-I wish—I wish I could have lived in the Old Days”可知，凯斯宾希望生活在过去，所以对现在的生活并不满意。故选B。

source.sourceSection: （2023·重庆·统考中考真题）Prince Caspian’s parents died. He lived with his uncle, Miraz, the King of Narnia and his aunt. Though he had wonderful toys, he liked best the last hour of the day when the toys had all been put away and Nurse would tell him stories.

questions.prompt: How did the King feel at the end of the story?
questions.analysis: 8．推理判断题。根据“If Caspian had been a little older, the tone(语气) of his uncle’s voice would have warned him it would be wiser to shut up.”可知，如果凯斯宾再大一点，他姨父说话的口气就会警告他，最好还是闭嘴。所以故事的最后可以推断出国王是生气的，故选C。

questions.prompt: Who taught the writer to make bread?

source.sourceSection: （2022·广东深圳·统考中考真题）I took up baking(烘焙) when I was twelve. At that time I was working on my school bakery project with my classmates. I tried a few times, but I wasn’t very successful. My parents advised I learn from my grandmother, who later gave me her recipe (食谱) and instruction as well. After two years’ practice, I was able to make delicious bread. I have come to realize making bread means a lot to me although it takes a long time.

She went home and told her parents (my grandparents), and they thought it was a good idea.

questions.prompt: The writer mentions “Roger Federer” in Paragraph 1 to show that ________.

B. we should get away from trouble

questions.prompt: What do we know about He Jiankui?
options: A. He was the first person to edit genes.
B. He made the twins suffer from HIV when he edited their genes.
C. He made the world’s first genetically edited babies.
D. He was the first person whose genes were edited.
questions.analysis: 32．细节理解题。根据“In an online video posted on Nov. 26, 2018, He Jiankui, a researcher at the Southern University of Science and Technology, said that he had helped to make the world’s first genetically edited babies.”可知，在2018年11月26日发布的一段网络视频中，南方科技大学研究员贺建奎表示，他帮助制造了世界上第一批基因编辑婴儿。故选C。

questions.prompt: According to the writer of the book "How to make friends with foreigners" , ________.
options: A. his advice may make foreigners angry
B. it is rude of you to ask a foreigner questions
C. you should choose a good foreigner to practise English with
D. don’t waste time on a foreigner who doesn’t answer your questions
questions.analysis: 39．细节理解题。根据第二段“ In the writer’s opinion, foreigners are an ‘opportunity’ to improve your oral English; whenever you see a foreigner, American or English, you should practise speaking English with him or her.”可知，书的作者认为外国人是提高你英语口语的“机会”，每当你见到外国人，你应该和他或她练习说英语，故选C。

B. he wanted to show how he hated to make friends with Chinese.
C. he wanted to show how he hated to be treated as an “opportunity”.
D. he met Chinese who wanted to make friends with him only three times.
questions.analysis: 40．细节理解题。根据第二段“One piece of advice really caught my attention and, I must say, made me feel quite angry.”以及第四段“However, I have also met many Chinese people who consider me only as an ‘opportunity’ to improve their oral English.”可知，这里作者用了三次“I have had…”，因为他想表明他是多么讨厌被当作“机会”来对待，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题08 阅读理解之议论文-学易金卷：5年（2019-2023）中考1年模拟英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which sentence may be the best to fill in the "________" in the last paragraph?
options: A. True friendships stand (经得起) the test of time.
B. Learn about different cultures to make real friends.
C. Friends are about opportunities or personal advantages.
D. There’s real friendship between people from different countries.
questions.analysis: 41．词句猜测题。根据前一句“Expect to make friendships step by step, over a period of time, not in a rush.”可知，这里作者想告诉我们要一步一步地建立友谊，在一段时间内，不要匆忙，真正的友谊经得起时间的考验的，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题08 阅读理解之议论文-学易金卷：5年（2019-2023）中考1年模拟英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Franklin did the experiment in order to prove ________.
options: A. he was an excellent scientist
B. flying a kite in the storm was safe
C. he was not afraid of lightning
D. lightning was a form of electricity
questions.analysis: 42．细节理解题。根据This, he said, proved （证明） the electrical nature of lightning可知，Franklin做这个实验想证明闪电是电的一种形式。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题08 阅读理解之议论文-学易金卷：5年（2019-2023）中考1年模拟英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined word “fiction” probably means something ________.
questions.analysis: 43．词义猜测题。根据instead of fact“而不是事实”提示，这个实验是虚构的，所以fiction表示“不是真实的”。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题08 阅读理解之议论文-学易金卷：5年（2019-2023）中考1年模拟英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Some scientists questioned whether Franklin ________ in the experiment.
questions.analysis: 44．推理判断题。根据It’s true that he did the experiment with the rope and the key. But scientists all agree that if Franklin had actually touched the key, he would certainly have died from the electric shock可知，一些科学家质疑他是否触碰了那个钥匙。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题08 阅读理解之议论文-学易金卷：5年（2019-2023）中考1年模拟英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The purpose of the passage is to tell us ________.
options: B. fiction is more interesting than the truth
C. Franklin’s experiment is not real
D. we shouldn’t always believe accepted ideas
questions.analysis: 45．主旨大意题。根据But in science, facts should be tested by experiments and research, and we should not always believe everything we read or hear even if it is a great story可知，这篇文章想告诉我们，事实应该通过实验和研究来测试，我们不应该总相信我们看过或听过的一切事物，尽管它是一个很棒的故事。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题08 阅读理解之议论文-学易金卷：5年（2019-2023）中考1年模拟英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who did the mouse betray in the passage?

questions.prompt: What can we know from Paragraph 4?
options: A. The mouse created the world by stealing something.
B. The mouse took people's grain seeds secretly.
C. The mouse did many things to save humans.
D. The mouse can never be a hero.
questions.analysis: 47．主旨大意题。根据第四段“It's said that the mouse created the world by taking a bite of heaven, bringing light to humans. It helped people survive by stealing firewood and grain seeds”可知，本段主要介绍了老鼠为人类做出的贡献，它为拯救人类做了许多事情。故选C。

questions.prompt: What's the Chinese meaning of the underlined phrase “survival rate” in Paragraph 5?
questions.analysis: 48．词句猜测题。根据倒数第二段“Since mice live together in societies and have many babies”可知，老鼠在社会中生活在一起，有许多的小老鼠，故可知老鼠的存活率很高，故划线部分survival rate意为“存活率”。故选D。

questions.prompt: Which saying can be used as the writer s opinion?
options: A. Where there is a will, there is a way.
B. Each coin has two sides.
C. God help those who help themselves.
D. A friend in need is a friend indeed.
questions.analysis: 49．主旨大意题。根据第三段“There are always different ways to look at the same thing.”及全文内容可知，本文先从反面介绍老鼠的贪婪背板等负面形象，然后又通过民间故事向我们展示了老鼠所代表的英雄形象，故作者主要是告诉我们任何事物都有两面性，我们应该辩证性的，以一种新的角度来看待问题，故“任何事物都有两面性”可代表作者的观点。故选B。

questions.prompt: How does the writer introduce the topic of the passage?
questions.analysis: 58．细节理解题。根据“One day, while I was waiting for my father, I saw a little boy, around two years old, running freely on the grass as his mother watched from a short distance. The boy had a big smile on his face. The boy would fall on the grass, get up, without looking back at his mother, run as fast as he could, again, still with a smile on his face, as if nothing had happened.”可知作者通过小男孩的事情引出话题，这是在交待背景。故选D。

source.sourceSection: （2023·内蒙古兴安盟·统考一模）One day, while I was waiting for my father, I saw a little boy, around two years old, running freely on the grass as his mother watched from a short distance (距离). The boy had a big smile on his face. The boy would fall on the grass, get up, without looking back at his mother, run as fast as he could, again, still with a smile on his face, as if nothing had happened. Most adults, when they fall down, make a big deal out of it and don’t even make a second attempt (尝试). They will be so embarrassed (尴尬) that they will not try again if someone sees them fall. Or, because they fall, they will find a good excuse for themselves that they are not fit for it. They will end up being too afraid to attempt again for fear of failure (失败).

questions.analysis: 53．细节理解题。根据第三段“Because of the development of the technology, there has been an increase in the number of people using it for fraud.They may steal our information from the internet and use it to pretend to be us.They can even use our information to take our money or buy things without our permission. We want people to know that protecting personal information is important.”可知，由于技术的发展，越来越多的人使用它进行欺诈。他们可能从互联网上窃取我们的信息，并用它冒充我们。他们甚至可以在未经我们许可的情况下用我们的信息拿走我们的钱或购买东西。我们希望人们知道，保护个人信息很重要。根据第五段“If a company needs to keep their data safe and they work in finance or healthcare, they can trust us and use Morse Station to help.”可知，如果一家公司需要保护他们的数据安全，并且他们从事金融或医疗保健工作，他们可以信任我们，并使用Morse Station提供帮助。所以奇安信科技集团希望提高人们的安全意识，蚂蚁集团的摩斯隐私计算一体机可以保护金融、医疗等行业的数据安全，两者的共同点是“致力于保护个人信息”。故选A。

questions.analysis: 56．推理判断题。根据第一段“Companies at the World Internet Exhibition in East China are showing their newest technologies, but what’s been special this year is the worry of companies in dealing with Internet security challenges. Chen Tong has the story.”可知，在中国东部举行的世界互联网展览会上，各家公司正在展示他们的最新技术，但今年的特别之处在于公司在应对互联网安全挑战时的担忧。陈彤报道。再根据后文中陈彤与奇安信科技集团、蚂蚁集团的两个负责人的对话，可推断出陈彤可能是“展览上的一名记者”。故选D。

questions.prompt: What do the underlined words “in a draw” mean in Paragraph 5?

But in the second half, Huang Bo scored a hat-trick — three goals in a row — to end the game in a draw.”可知上半场落后三球，下半场连进三球，打了平手，in a draw与in a tie意思相近。故选D。

questions.prompt: Where does the biggest danger the volcano caused come from?
options: C. The smoke and ash from the volcano.
questions.analysis: 63．细节理解题。根据“In the following days, the smoke and ash from the volcano covered much of Tonga. ... That was the biggest danger which might last for a long time.”可知最大的危险来自火山喷出的烟和灰。故选C。

questions.prompt: Which of the following is the best sentence to fill in the blank “________” in Paragraph 6？

B. People couldn’t make sure what was happening in Tonga at that time.
C. The local government quickly took steps to solve the serious problems.
D. The ash made the air dangerous to breathe and polluted many sources of drinking water.
questions.analysis: 64．推理判断题。根据“In the following days, the smoke and ash from the volcano covered much of Tonga. ... That was the biggest danger which might last for a long time.”可知此处空前讲到了火山喷出的烟和灰覆盖了汤加的许多地方，空后将这是最大的危险，可能持续很长时间，由此推出设空处填“火山灰使空气呼吸变得危险，并污染了许多饮用水源”符合语境。故选D。
