questions.analysis: 66．标题归纳题。根据“On January 14th, 2022, an underwater volcano erupted near Tonga.”及全文内容可知本文主要讲2022年1月14日，汤加附近的一座水下火山爆发了，用“An underwater volcano erupted near Tonga”做标题最合适。故选C。

questions.prompt: Which sentence can be put in the ______ ▲ ?
options: A. As we know, there are possible huge risks for society and human life
B. Also, you can find AI serving our daily life in every possible field
C. Without doubt, AI is a fantastic technology to lead us into the future
D. Humans ate surely more creative and better at many things than AI
questions.analysis: 2．推理判断题。根据“especially when you consider some countries are racing to develop AI-enabled autonomous weapons”以及“The same worries also come from the public”可知当你考虑到一些国家正在竞相开发人工智能自主武器时，人类可能会面临危险，选项A“正如我们所知，社会和人类生活可能面临巨大风险”放于此处。故选A。

questions.prompt: What are the scientists studying according to the passage?
questions.analysis: 5．细节理解题。根据“With the help of tiger sharks, a team of researchers has discovered the world’s largest seagrass meadow（grassland）on the seafloor near the Bahamas.”可知科学家在研究海草。故选C。

source.sourceSection: （2023·浙江丽水·统考中考真题）Seagrass, an underwater plant that grows on the ocean floor, is very important for sea life. It also helps prevent global warming by storing carbon, a harmful gas. However, scientists don’t know exactly how much seagrass is at the bottom of the ocean. With the help of tiger sharks, a team of researchers has discovered the world’s largest seagrass meadow（grassland）on the seafloor near the Bahamas.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题06 阅读理解之说明文-学易金卷：5年（2019-2023）中考1年模拟英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which italic（斜体）word has the same meaning as the underlined word “map” in Paragraph 3?
options: A. Is there a map of China in the classroom?
B. Amy mapped out her plans on the new project.
C. It is the West lake that really puts Hangzhou on the map.
D. The police have successfully mapped where the missing boy is.
questions.analysis: 6．词义猜测题。根据“After noticing tiger sharks swimming through seagrass off the Bahamas, an American scientist worked with a seagrass expert, trying to map the locations of the plants”可知在注意到虎鲨在巴哈马群岛附近的海草中游动后，一位美国科学家与一位海草专家合作，试图绘制这些植物的位置图，故此处mapped意为“绘制……的位置”；分析四个选择可知，选项D“警方已成功绘制出失踪男孩的位置”中的mapped也以为“绘制……的位置”。故选D。

source.sourceSection: （2023·浙江丽水·统考中考真题）Seagrass, an underwater plant that grows on the ocean floor, is very important for sea life. It also helps prevent global warming by storing carbon, a harmful gas. However, scientists don’t know exactly how much seagrass is at the bottom of the ocean. With the help of tiger sharks, a team of researchers has discovered the world’s largest seagrass meadow（grassland）on the seafloor near the Bahamas.

questions.prompt: Why does the writer mention ABC Song?
options: A. Because it is the most popular song in the world.
B. Because everyone can sing this song very well.
C. Because washing hands is as easy as singing ABC Song.
D. Because you can sing this song to know the length of washing hands.
questions.analysis: 9．推理判断题。根据“How do you know the length (长度) of 15-20 seconds? You can sing ABC Song.”可知可以通过唱歌知道洗手的时间，故选D。

questions.prompt: The underlined word “note” in Paragraph 3 means “________” in Chinese.
questions.analysis: 10．词句猜测题。根据“You can sing ABC Song. By the time you get to the last note, your hands will be clean!”可知，唱到最后一个音符，手就洗好了，可推测“note”意为“音符”，故选A。

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the passage?
options: A. Using soap to wash your hands.
B. Using a clean towel (毛巾) to dry your hands.
C. Washing your hands for about 20 seconds.
D. Rubbing under and around your fingernails.
questions.analysis: 11．细节理解题。根据“Always use soap to wash your hands.”，“You should wash your hands for 15-20 seconds.”和“Rub your hands together.”可知，并没有提到用干净的毛巾擦干手，故选B。

B. what the best soap people usually use is
C. what kind of germs there are on your hands
D. how many germs there are on your hands
questions.analysis: 12．推理判断题。根据“Many illnesses are caused by germs, so you should often wash your hands.”可知，细菌可以导致很多疾病，所以要勤洗手，说明我们可以知道为什么要经常洗手，故选A。

questions.prompt: Why are bats helpful to farmers in the USA?

B. Because there are more than 1, 400 kinds of bats.

questions.prompt: Children like to ask questions because ________.
options: A. they are born with natural curiosity
B. they don’t know about the human nature
C. they are known for reading and watching
D. they don’t want to find the answers by themselves
questions.analysis: 32．细节理解题。根据“Children are known for wanting answers to many questions because curiosity (好奇心) is part of human nature”可知孩子喜欢问问题，因为好奇心是人类天性的一部分。故选A。

source.sourceSection: （2023·山东滨州·统考中考真题）Do you often ask questions? Children are known for wanting answers to many questions because curiosity (好奇心) is part of human nature. Books and TV shows often depend on curiosity. People keep reading or watching because they want to find out what happens.

questions.prompt: When was the opera first performed in San Francisco?
questions.analysis: 16．推理判断题。根据“The opera of Dream of the Red Chamber《红楼梦》, the first opera adapted from an 18th century Chinese novel of the same name, returned to San Francisco in mid-June this year, six years after its world deut（首演）.”可知，歌剧《红楼梦》是第一部改编自18世纪中国同名小说的歌剧，于今年6月中旬返回旧金山，距离其全球首秀已经过去了六年，所以第一次在旧金山上映应该是2016年，故选C。

source.sourceSection: （2023·天津和平·统考二模）The opera of Dream of the Red Chamber《红楼梦》, the first opera adapted from an 18th century Chinese novel of the same name, returned to San Francisco in mid-June this year, six years after its world debut（首演）. The opera, developed for Western audiences Zhang Meigui, a 28-year-old opera singer, played the role of Daiyu in the opera. To show the audience a fresh version（版本）, she had been preparing for the opera for half a year. “I’ve watched the video of the 2016 production for many times. I think the performance of the singer （playing Daiyu） is excellent, which is very challenging and requires a lot of skills,”she said. “For example, Daiyu finds her world increasingly helpless as her health continues to worsen. She sings, ‘When spring is gone and beauty is spent’, who cares for the dying flowers?” “The singer needs to keep the high notes（高音） with a soft sound, which requires more breath support and air control.” said Zhang, “Some parts of the music are more powerful and require very expressive sound.” Bright Sheng, the opera’s composer, explained in an interview why Daiyu sang in a loud voice. “Music carries feelings that words cannot explain or say. To me, beating her chest as she looks up at the sky to ask these questions.” For the new production, Sheng said he made some changes. He said, “A great opera is not only a big musical theater in action, but also a perfect mixture of music and drama.”

questions.analysis: 25．推理判断题。根据最后一段“Sometimes you can find very old and rare （稀有的） books at Strand, for example, a Shakespeare book that was published in 1632.”可知，Strand书店的特别之处是你可以在那里找到非常古老和稀有的书籍。故选D。

source.sourceSection: （2023·天津红桥·统考二模）To compete with online sellers, traditional bookstores have tried everything to win customers. And it’s true that a great bookstore can encourage people to read in many ways.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题06 阅读理解之说明文-学易金卷：5年（2019-2023）中考1年模拟英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What will travel be like in 2070 according to the passage?
questions.analysis: 1．细节理解题。根据“Maybe travel will become smarter and easier by that time.”可知，也许到那时旅行会变得更智能、更容易。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “predictions” in Paragraph 1 probably mean?
questions.analysis: 2．词句猜测题。分析“Here are some amazing predictions about traveling that might happen in 2070.”可知，以下是关于2070年可能发生的旅行的一些惊人预测。所以此处predictions的意思“预测”，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: You will use _________ at the airport instead of passport checks.
questions.analysis: 3．细节理解题。根据“You will use ‘heartbeat passport(护照)’ at the airport. And passport checks will not be used any more.”可知，你将在机场使用“心跳护照”，护照检查也将不再使用。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: 3D print technology can _________.
options: A. help us to check passports
B. provide many kinds of movies
C. print almost everything like clothes and food
D. take us to see the first Olympic Games
questions.analysis: 4．细节理解题。根据“3D print technology will develop surprisingly fast. It can print almost everything like clothes and food.”可知，3D打印技术将以惊人的速度发展。它几乎可以打印任何东西，比如衣服和食物。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the best title of the passage?
questions.analysis: 5．最佳标题题。本文是关于2070年可能发生的旅行的一些惊人预测，选项D“2070年的旅行”符合主题，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is paragraph 2 mainly about?
questions.analysis: 6．主旨大意题。根据“Burning these fuels produces carbon dioxide (二氧化碳) and other pollutants into the atmosphere, which hold heat in the atmosphere, leading to warmer global temperatures over time.”可知，第二段主要介绍了导致气温上升的原因。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What will the warming temperatures cause according to the text?
questions.analysis: 7．推理判断题。根据“Robinson says there are signs that snowstorms are becoming stronger. This is because of this connection between moisture and precipitation.”可知，变暖的温度会导致更强的暴风雪。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of paragraph 5?
options: B. To report the biggest 10 snowstorms.
D. To show the increase of temperatures.
questions.analysis: 8．推理判断题。根据“Of the 10 biggest snowfalls in D. C. region, five happened in the past 25 years, …average winter temperatures in D. C. increased. In 1996, the average winter temperature was 1.8℃. In 2020, it was 6℃.”可推知，作者在第五段通过陈述华盛顿地区的事实，进一步印证了Robinson的观点。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does Robinson think of the future warming temperatures?
questions.analysis: 9．推理判断题。根据“One day, winter might not have any days below the freezing temperature.”以及“According to Robinson, that time could come sooner than we think.”可推知，Robinson认为未来全球变暖，气温升高会很严重。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where is the text probably taken from?
questions.analysis: 10．推理判断题。通读全文可知，本文主要讲了温度上升与更多的暴风雪是否有关系的问题。故可推知，文章可能来源于一本科学杂志。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the writer want to tell us about gardening in paragraph 1?
options: A. The gardeners can make much money.
B. It’s just about creating a beautiful place.
C. The most important is to express yourself.
D. It means different things to different people.
questions.analysis: 11．推理判断题。根据“For me, it’s a bit of all these things. I know it may sound strange for a 13-year-old girl to be interested in gardening, but I have always been and I would love to make a career (职业) out of it.”可知，园艺对作者来说，有着重要的意义。故可推知，作者在第一段告诉我们园艺对不同的人意味着不同的东西。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How would the writer describe her favorite garden?
questions.analysis: 12．推理判断题。根据“Some of the gardens that I think are the prettiest are just lines of plants. There aren’t many garden decorations (装饰) and pathways. It’s just beautiful plants with fruits and vegetables.”可推知，作者描述的最喜欢的花园是简单的。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What advice does the writer give us about gardening?
options: A. Use what we can find around us.
B. Try to make a career out of it.
C. Ask other gardeners to give help.
D. Spend as much time as we can.
questions.analysis: 13．推理判断题。根据“We can also find many useful things for free, from pieces of old wood to old pots and pans. Or, we can build things for free from materials that other people have thrown away.”可推知，作者建议利用周围能找到的东西。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn about the writer’s gardening experience?
options: A. She wants to grow everything.
C. She has a lot of fun in doing it.
D. She needs to work harder.
questions.analysis: 14．推理判断题。根据“I know it may sound strange for a 13-year-old girl to be interested in gardening, but I have always been and I would love to make a career (职业) out of it.”以及“It will save you a lot of stress.”可推知，她做这件事很开心。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “devote” mean in the last paragraph?
questions.analysis: 15．词句猜测题。根据“Once I decide to do something, I usually devote every waking hour to it for a little while and then get tired.”可知，一旦作者决定做某件事，通常会很投入，然后就会感到疲倦。因此“devote”与“Spend”语义相近。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which statement is NOT right?
options: A. Visitors can show lava makes the island bigger.
B. There are many protected animals in the park.
C. Almost all of the plants in the park only grow in Hawaii.
D. The whole park will be closed if the volcanoes erupt.
questions.analysis: 24．细节理解题。根据“However, when the volcanoes possibly erupt, parts of the park close.”可知如果火山爆发，公园会关闭一部分，并非整个公园都要关闭。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined sentence mean?
options: D. Too many cars are in the park.
questions.analysis: 25．句意猜测题。根据“It’s almost impossible to know when a volcano will erupt. ... This special park is never quiet for long.”可知字面意思是“这个特别的公园从来不会安静太久”，结合上文讲到不可能知道火山爆发的时间，由此推出含义是火山经常喷发。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The author wrote the passage mainly to ________.
options: A. tell people the volcanoes in Hawaii Volcanoes National Park
B. introduce what people can do in Hawaii Volcanoes National Park
C. tell people the wildlife of Hawaii Volcanoes National Park
D. give an introduction to Hawaii Volcanoes National Park
questions.analysis: 26．主旨大意题。通读全文可知本文主要向大家介绍了夏威夷火山国家公园，这也是作者写这篇文章的目的。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The passage is probably from ________.
questions.analysis: 27．推理判断题。本文主要向大家介绍了夏威夷火山国家公园，可能出现在一本杂志上。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we know from the first paragraph?
options: A. No robots are like big machines.
B. Robots all have long arms.
C. Robots are in different shapes.
D. Robots can’t work out problems by themselves.
questions.analysis: 32．细节理解题。根据“Many robots don’t always look like people. Some are like big machines, and some are nothing but long arms”可知机器人有不同的形状。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where are robots helpful to us according to the third paragraph?
questions.analysis: 33．细节理解题。根据“Robots are useful in our homes, too”可知机器人在我们家里很有用，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the advantage of robots according to the text?
options: A. They are as clever as people.
C. They can think like people.
D. They can work in dangerous places.
questions.analysis: 34．细节理解题。根据“They can work in some dangerous places where people cannot.”可知机器人可以在一些人们无法工作的危险的地方工作。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the text mainly about?
options: A. It’s about what robots will be like in the future.
B. It’s about what robots can do in many years.
C. It’s about how robots are used in our life.
D. It’s about how scientists invented robots.
questions.analysis: 35．主旨大意题。根据“Robots are more and more useful and important in our life.”和全文可知，本文主要讲述了机器人在我们的生活中的作用和重要性，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where is the text probably from?
questions.analysis: 36．推理判断题。通读全文可知，本文是关于机器人，所以可能在科学杂志上看到，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What time do most students in our school usually get to school?
questions.analysis: 37．细节理解题。根据“In our school, most students get to school between 7:30 and 8:00 in the morning.”可知大多数学生在早上7:30到8:00之间到校。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How do most of the students go to school according to the text?
questions.analysis: 38．细节理解题。根据“However, eighty percent of the students arrive in their parents’ cars.”可知大部分学生是乘坐父母的汽车去上学的，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined (划线的) word “cautious” mean?
questions.analysis: 39．词义猜测题。根据“when parents park dangerously in front of the school entrance, they will be punished and have to pay some money—a fine (罚金).”可知当家长在学校门口危险停车时，他们将受到惩罚，必须支付一些罚款，所以他们在停车前会小心谨慎，三思而后行。cautious和careful“小心的”同义，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many suggestions are mentioned in the second paragraph (段落)?
questions.analysis: 40．细节理解题。根据“First, we should encourage students to take the bus or walk to school.”、“Next, what should parents do if their children have to come to school by car? ”以及“Finally, in my opinion...”可知第二段给出了三条建议，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which can be the best title (标题) of this text?
options: A. Ways to Arrive at School.
B. Ways to Park Cars at the School Gate.
C. Ways to Solve the Air Pollution around the School.
D. Ways to Solve the Traffic Problem near the School Gate.
questions.analysis: 41．最佳标题题。根据“The entrance (入口) to the school is crowded and dangerous. I think cars are the main problem. I think there are a few things we can do.”和全文可知，本文作者针对学校门口附近交通问题提出了几点建议，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “It” refer to (指代) in Paragraph 1?
questions.analysis: 42．代词指代题。分析“Iceland is a northern European country with amazing natural beauty and oceans around. There are a number of volcanoes (火山). It has a short summer which lasts from June to August.”可知，冰岛是一个北欧国家，拥有令人惊叹的自然美景和海洋。这里有许多火山。它的夏天很短，从六月持续到八月。此处It指的是“冰岛”，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When do visitors usually go to enjoy the whale-seeing?
questions.analysis: 43．细节理解题。根据“Summer in Iceland is a golden season for tourists. Every year, people from all over the world come here to see the beautiful sights and enjoy the exciting whale-seeing.”可知，冰岛的夏天是游客的黄金季节。每年，来自世界各地的人们来到这里欣赏美丽的景色，享受令人兴奋的观鲸活动。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of Paragraph 3?
options: A. What is the first choice to relax after the fun.
B. How people in Iceland finish their daily work.
C. What stories are the most popular in Iceland.
D. How people in Iceland spend the long dark night.
questions.analysis: 44．段落大意题。根据第三段内容，尤其是“In winter, when people in Iceland finish their daily work, they will have different special activities to spend the long dark night.”可知，本段主要介绍冰岛人如何度过漫长的黑夜。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why does Iceland have a short growing season?
options: A. Because there are oceans around.
B. Because there is a long hot summer.
C. Because there is a long cold winter.
D. Because there are a number of volcanoes.
questions.analysis: 45．细节理解题。根据“Because of a long cold winter, Iceland has a short growing season.”可知，由于漫长寒冷的冬天，冰岛的生长期很短。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can be the best title of the passage?
questions.analysis: 46．最佳标题题。本文主要介绍了冰岛的相关情况，选项D“冰岛，一个神奇的国家”符合主题，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what is a possible result of food waste?
options: A. The problem of worldwide hunger.
B. A big increase in food production.
C. The speed-up of climate change.
D. A sudden drop in population.
questions.analysis: 51．细节理解题。根据“In addition, the wasted food produces over three billion tons of carbon dioxide (CO2), which speeds up climate change.”可知食物浪费可能造成的一个结果是气候变化的加速。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From Paragraph l we know that ________.
options: A. albatross is a kind of bird
B. all albatrosses have black feet
C. there are many kinds of albatrosses
D. the wings of all albatrosses are 1.5 metres long
questions.analysis: 54．细节理解题。根据“There are at least 12 different kinds of albatrosses”可知，信天翁至少有12种不同的种类，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does Paragraph 2 mainly tell us about albatrosses?
options: B. Their habit of eating rubbish.
C. Their ability to catch their “seafood”.
D. Their skills of following ships.
questions.analysis: 55．段落大意题。分析第二段内容可知，主要介绍了信天翁的饮食，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Albatrosses ________ for most of their lives.
options: C. stay on the seaside rocks
questions.analysis: 56．细节理解题。根据“Albatrosses spend most of their lives flying and can reach faraway places.”可知，信天翁一生中大部分时间都在飞行，可以飞到很远的地方。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The mother albatross can do all the following things EXCEPT ________.
options: C. stay in air in windy weather
D. give birth to one baby every year
questions.analysis: 57．细节理解题。根据“The mother albatross lays one egg every two years.”可知，信天翁妈妈每两年产一枚蛋，而不是每年产蛋，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT true?
options: A. There are a lot of albatrosses in China.
B. Some albatrosses can dive 12.5 metres.
C. Both the parents take care of their egg in turn.
D. Albatrosses can probably be found in Fujian Province.
questions.analysis: 58．细节理解题。根据“One kind of albatross can dive as deep as 12.5 metres. ”可知，一种信天翁可以下潜至12.5米深。而不是一些信天翁，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, people in Bacha have become rich with the development of the _________.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

D. The gifts made by her are expensive.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: We can read this passage in the _________ part of the newspaper.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the last paragraph, we know that ________.

questions.analysis: 68．推理判断题。根据“Thanks to the good policies of the government, villagers get more ways to make money.…People in China have a sense of happiness from the bottom of their hearts.”可知，中国人现在有了更多致富途径，有发自内心的幸福感，故推知现在中国人民过着幸福生活。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In 2070, heartbeat passports will be used because _________.
options: A. paper passports are a waste of paper
B. the data of everyone’s heartbeat will tell who they are
C. they can be made at a lower price
D. experts don’t allow people to use paper passports
questions.analysis: 69．细节理解题。根据“According to experts, everyone’s heartbeat is different. So the data(数据) will be used to tell who you are.”可知，专家表示，每个人的心跳都不一样，所以这些数据将被用来告诉你是谁。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

D. scan your body and your clothes will be ready
questions.analysis: 71．细节理解题。根据“Before you fly, you will have a body scan(扫描). When you arrive, you’ll find a wardrobe(衣橱) filled with 3D-printed clothes in your size.”可知，在你登机前，你要进行全身扫描，当你到达时，你会发现衣柜里堆满了3D打印的衣服。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What might you see with a headset if you visit the Palace Museum in 2070?
options: A. People are watching the Olympic Games.
B. The emperor is talking with the ministers.
C. Some people are building the Great Wall.
D. Some students are having a sports meeting.
questions.analysis: 72．推理判断题。根据“Wearing a headset(头戴式耳机), you can see what happened there, such as a famous war.”可知，戴上头戴式耳机，你可以看到那里发生了什么，比如一场著名的战争。结合地点故宫可知，可能会看到皇帝正在和大臣们谈话。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What will be the best title of the passage?
options: A. Good ideas for future travel
B. Better lifestyles in the future
C. Future devices on the plane
questions.analysis: 73．最佳标题题。根据“European airline(航空公司) easyJet has made some predictions and released(发布) easyJet 2070—The Future Travel Report. Let’s take a look at some cool ideas.”可知，欧洲易捷航空公司做出了一些预测，并发布了易捷2070——未来旅行报告，介绍其中一些很酷的想法。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why do people cook toon shoots with eggs according to the passage?

C. To balance the strong taste.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do toon shoots and Indian aster have in common (有共同点) according to the passage?

D. Both of them can deal with high blood pressure.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following dishes might improve people’s eyesight?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we infer (推断) according to the tips in the passage?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: People usually eat niangao during ________ according to the passage.
questions.analysis: 82．细节理解题。根据“Niangao, a kind of Chinese New Year’s Rice Cake, is made from glutinous rice (糯米). It is very popular during the Spring Festival.”可知，年糕在春节期间很受欢迎。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From Paragraph 3, we can know the ________ of niangao.
questions.analysis: 83．段落大意题。根据“The pronunciation of niangao sounds like year and high, which means higher income (收入), better jobs, higher marks, the growth of children, and generally the promise of a better year.”可知，“年糕”意味着更高的收入、更好的工作、更高的分数、孩子的成长，通常意味着更好的一年的到来。所以本段介绍年糕的意义，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: People in the ________ of China like to have salty niangao.
questions.analysis: 84．细节理解题。根据“The tastes can be divided into two main kinds: sweet niangao in northern China, while sweet or salty niangao in the south.”可知，南方吃咸年糕。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following sentences can be put in the “ ▲ ” in Paragraph 5?
options: A. Niangao is the most delicious traditional food.
B. Niangao is popular with all the young people.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Niangao with ________ is necessary on Chinese New Year’s Eve from the passage.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we know about Mount Taishan according to the text?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the text, if Betty wants to enjoy the sea of clouds in Mount Huashan, she should go to ________.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is the best to fill in the blank “_________”?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why does the writer write the text?

B. To introduce the great mountains in China.
C. To offer ways to research mountains in China.
D. To advise people to protect the great mountains.
questions.analysis: 90．主旨大意题。根据“The mountains listed below are either among the most famous or the most beautiful.”及全文的内容可知，作者是为了介绍中国的三座山脉，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How does the writer start the article?
questions.analysis: 91．推理判断题。根据第一段可知，作者是通过结合自身做苹果派的例子来引出本文主题，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do the underlined words “concentrate on” mean in Paragraph 2?
questions.analysis: 92．词义猜测题。根据“If we just concentrate on the result and do not enjoy the process, we will be more likely to feel disappointed and want to give up.”可知，如果只关注结果而不享受过程，更有可能感到失望，想要放弃，所以划线单词表示“关注”，与“Pay attention to”词义接近，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which could be the best title for the text?
options: B. What does success mean to us?
D. How can we achieve good results?
questions.analysis: 94．最佳标题题。本文主要是作者通过讲述自己做苹果派的经历告诉我们，做任何事情不要看重结果，要享受这个过程，并就如何享受过程提出了几点建议，文章整体以“享受过程”为线索展开介绍，所以最适合本文的标题是：享受过程，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the “golden period” according to the passage?
options: A. The first four minutes after CPR.
B. The first four minutes before CPR.
C. The first four minutes of a heart attack.
D. The first four minutes before a heart attack.
questions.analysis: 95．细节理解题。根据“there is a ‘golden period’ — the first four minutes of a heart attack”可知，心脏病发作的前四分钟是急救的黄金期，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “grasp” in the passage probably mean?
questions.analysis: 96．词义猜测题。根据“All that one needs to know is how to watch and decide if a person has a heart attack, where to press on the patient’s chest (胸), and how to blow air through the mouth and into the lungs”可知，划线部分之后是在介绍如何完全掌握心肺复苏的方法，所以grasp表示“理解，领会”，与B选项的词义接近，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why was more professional CPR training necessary according to Zhao Shengyu?
options: A. Because most students had never heard of CPR.
B. Because lots of countries provided CPR training.
C. Because her first CPR learnings had lots of mistakes.
D. Because experts advised students to master the skill of CPR.
questions.analysis: 97．细节理解题。根据“I realized the acts I had been taught had lots of mistakes after I was trained another time in a medical school”可知，因为第一次所学的心肺复苏有很多错误，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the passage mainly talk about?
options: A. The steps of performing CPR.
B. The people saved by CPR in China.
C. The recent situation of CPR courses in China.
D. The development of CPR training around the world.
questions.analysis: 99．主旨大意题。根据“In August, 2020, all public schools nationwide were asked to provide CPR courses in China…Unluckily, less than one percent of Chinese adults have mastered the skill of CPR, while many have never heard of it”可知，本文主要介绍了目前中国学校在传授心肺复苏这门课程以及学生掌握程度的情况，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The surveys are mainly about ________.
questions.analysis: 100．主旨大意题。根据“Electronic waste (电子垃圾), also known as ‘E-waste’, is used to describe the waste from useless electronics such as computers, phones, fridges, washing machines, TVs and so on.”并通读全文可知本文主要介绍的是电子垃圾。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to Diagram I, ________ of the e-waste is from computers each year.
questions.analysis: 101．细节理解题。根据图表一可知每年来自电脑的电子垃圾占13%。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to Diagram II, 15% of the residents deal with e-waste ________.
options: D. by collecting and recycling it
questions.analysis: 102．细节理解题。根据图表二中“Residents who collect and recycle e-waste 15%”可知15%的居民通过收集和回收来处理电子垃圾。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: E-waste ________ according to the passage.
options: B. is useless rubbish in the community
C. grows fastest of all kinds in the world
D. is used to describe the waste from factories
questions.analysis: 103．细节理解题。根据“E-waste is the world’s fastest-growing kind of waste, and only a small part of it is collected and recycled.”可知电子垃圾在世界上所有种类中增长速度最快。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the passage, we can know ________.
options: A. people will give away their electronics if they are broken
B. now some people are trying to deal with e-waste properly
C. e-waste will become the most useful in the residents’ homes
D. most people are ready to collect and recycle e-waste nowadays
questions.analysis: 104．推理判断题。根据“Some residents think they should recycle e-waste, because e-waste includes many valuable metals, such as gold, silver and so on. They say they try to repair some electronics rather than buy new ones. They also give away their electronics which they don’t like any more to people in need.”可知现在人们认为应该回收电子垃圾，修理电子产品而不买新的，把不用的电子产品送给需要的人，由此推出现在有些人正试图妥善处理电子垃圾。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which can replace the underlined part in Paragraph 1?

questions.analysis: 105．句意猜测题。根据“taken the internet by storm, winning 100 million users since it came out in November 2022.”可知，ChatGPT自2022年11月推出以来，已经席卷了互联网，赢得了1亿用户，也就是说在网络上获得了巨大的成功，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the last paragraph?
options: B. Anybody may give false information.
D. ChatGPT can’t get on well with humans.
questions.analysis: 107．细节理解题。根据“But one big problem with ChatGPT is that it makes mistakes or even gives false information.... These are all things that need to be dealt with.”可知，ChatGPT还存在一个大问题需要去解决，也就是说还需要完善，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What might be the best title of the text?
options: B. ChatGPT is Catching the World’s Eyes!
C. Can ChatGPT Take the Place of Humans?
D. Can ChatGPT Avoid Biases Properly?
questions.analysis: 108．最佳标题题。本文主要介绍了聊天机器人ChatGPT自推出以来，已经席卷了互联网，赢得了1亿用户，还介绍了它的功能和存在的问题。B项“ChatGPT正在吸引全世界的目光”最符合文意，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which kind of injuries may happen slowly?
options: A. You use your computer correctly.
B. You fall off a bicycle and break your arm.
C. You sit in a wrong way for many hours in front of a computer.
questions.analysis: 109．细节理解题。根据“But computer injuries happen slowly.”可知，电脑伤害发生得很慢。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How far should you keep your eyes from the screen?
questions.analysis: 110．细节理解题。根据“Your eyes should be at least 50 centimeters from the screen.”可知，你的眼睛应该离屏幕至少50厘米。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which can best be for “________”?
questions.analysis: 111．推理判断题。根据“Hand and wrist (手腕) injuries can happen because the hands and wrists are moved in the same way hundreds of times.”可知，此处介绍手和手腕可能会受伤，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the writer tell us in the passage?
options: A. You’d better not use the computer.
B. Enjoy your computer, but use it safely.
C. Keep away from the computer to be safe.
questions.analysis: 112．主旨大意题。本文主要介绍了电脑对我们的身体会有一定的伤害，我们应该通过正确的方式来养成合理使用电脑的习惯。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why do you sometimes feel sleepy in the early afternoon?
options: A. It’s very hot in summer.
B. You eat too much for lunch.
C. Your body temperature goes down at that time.
questions.analysis: 113．细节理解题。根据“At that time, about eight hours after you wake up, your body temperature goes down. This is what makes you slow down and feel sleepy.”可知，大约在你醒来8小时后，你的体温会下降，这就是让你慢下来并感到困倦的原因。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “This” mean in the second paragraph?
options: A. The heat makes work difficult in the early afternoon.
B. Naps are good for everyone in any weather.
C. People take naps in the middle of the day.
questions.analysis: 114．代词指代题。分析“In many parts of the world, people take naps (打盹) in the middle of the day. This is especially true in warmer weather, in which the heat makes work difficult in the early afternoon.”可知，在世界上许多地方，人们在中午打盹。在温暖的天气里尤其如此，炎热的天气使下午早些时候的工作变得困难。此处“This”指的是“人们在中午打盹”，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what’s the best time to take a nap if you get up at 6 a. m.?
questions.analysis: 115．推理判断题。根据“Remember that the best time to take a nap is about eight hours after you get up.”可知，小睡的最佳时间是起床后8小时左右。所以如果早上6点起床，那么下午2点是小睡的最佳时间，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What would be the best title for the passage?
questions.analysis: 116．最佳标题题。本文主要介绍为什么人们在午后容易打瞌睡，建议大家适当休息一下，有益于身体健康。选项A“都需要小睡一下”符合主题，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “passages” in Paragraph 2 mean?
questions.analysis: 117．词句猜测题。分析“They also act as passages for nature, allowing wildlife to move from one place to the next.”可知，它们允许野生动物从一个地方移动到另一个地方，所以是自然的通道。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following can be put in the “________”?
options: A. It is friendly to them.
B. It’s also great for your health.
C. It makes a big difference to our life.
questions.analysis: 118．推理判断题。根据“One study found that gardening for 30 minutes can be compared with playing badminton, volleyball or practicing yoga.”可知，一项研究发现，30分钟的园艺活动可以与打羽毛球、排球或练习瑜伽相提并论。选项B“这对你的健康也有好处”符合语境，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the study, how do people feel when they garden 2-3 times a week?
questions.analysis: 119．细节理解题。根据“According to a study, people who garden 2-3 times a week have a 6.6% higher happiness score and 4.2% lower stress level compared to people who don’t garden at all.”可知，根据一项研究，每周园艺2-3次的人比那些根本不园艺的人幸福指数高6.6%，压力水平低4.2%。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How can you easily connect with your neighbors when you are new to a place?
options: A. By sharing fruit or vegetables you grow.
B. By inviting them to join a club.
questions.analysis: 120．细节理解题。根据“When you are new to a place, you can get to know your neighbors by sharing fruit or vegetables you grow with them.”可知，当你刚到一个地方时，你可以通过与邻居分享你种植的水果或蔬菜来了解他们。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why do some adults work in locked rooms when they think up new toys?
options: A. To keep their ideas from being stolen.
questions.analysis: 121．细节理解题。根据“Sometimes they even work in locked rooms so no one can steal their ideas!”可知大型玩具公司的工人有时会在锁着的房间里工作，以确保他们的想法不会被窃取。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is Casey’s golf tee made out of?
questions.analysis: 122．细节理解题。根据“Most golf tees are made from wood, but Casey’s tee is made out of recycled paper.”可知，大多数高尔夫球座是用木头做的，但凯西的球座是用再生纸做的。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How old was Jessica when she invented the new kind of jump rope?
questions.analysis: 123．细节理解题。根据“Jessica invented a toy when she was only eight.”可知，杰西卡八岁时发明了一个玩具。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Whom may the writer call on to try ideas for new inventions?
questions.analysis: 124．推理判断题。根据“ Some of the best inventions are made by kids.”和“Do you have a great idea for a new invention? Give your idea a try. It may become the next Bio tee or latest jump ropes.”可知，文章是鼓励孩子们进行发明创造，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When is Longtaitou Festival this year?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why was this festival important in ancient China?
options: A. Because it was time to begin to farm.
B. Because it was a symbol of good luck.
C. Because people could eat different foods.
D. Because people could have a haircut.
questions.analysis: 126．细节理解题。根据“This festival was important in ancient China. People believed after this day the rain would increase because the rain-bringing Dragon King woke up from his winter sleep. So it marked the start of spring and farming.”可知古代中国这个节日很重要，因为人们相信在这一天之后雨水会增加，因为带来雨水的龙王从冬天的睡眠中醒来。所以它标志着春天和农业的开始。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “pray” mean in Chinese?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What are called dragons’ ears on this festival?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the primary school provide for the students?
questions.analysis: 129．细节理解题。根据“ In this school students and teachers can have free meals. ”可知这所学校的学生和老师可以免费吃饭。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How often do the students do farm work?
questions.analysis: 130．细节理解题。根据“ Students do farm work twice a week with the help of teachers.”可知学生们一周做两次农活。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the purpose of setting up a greenhouse?
options: A. To help students learn about nature.
B. To take the place of all the teachers.
C. To provide students with enough food.
D. To help students to get on with animals.
questions.analysis: 131．细节理解题。根据“The school has set up a greenhouse (温室) with fruit trees for students to learn about nature, instead of just listening to teachers in the classroom.”可知建立温室的目的是让学生们了解自然。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the best title for the text?
questions.analysis: 132．最佳标题题。根据最后一段校长的话“Children who have not kissed the land will not have a complete childhood.”可知学校的目的是让学生们亲近土地，有个完整的童年，所以“亲吻土地”适合作标题。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn about the writer?
options: A. The writer is a middle school teacher.
B. The writer is a dentist from a hospital.
C. The writer is an expert making robots.
D. The writer is an expert making medicine.
questions.analysis: 133．细节理解题。根据“In my laboratory, I’m just trying to build such intelligent, or smart, tiny robots.”以及“As an expert making robots, I think it is great to make tiny robots that can do the same thing.”可知，作者是一名制造机器人的专家，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the writer think of the catheters today?
options: A. They will be widely used by doctors in the future.
B. They are not able to get to tinier areas in the body.
C. They will be smarter than tiny robots in the future.
D. They can help doctors take care of patients on time.
questions.analysis: 135．推理判断题。根据“We’re already using smaller and smaller medical tools, like catheters (导管) that can travel deep into your brain to treat a blood clot (血块)...can’t be reached with the catheters we are using today”可知，现在医疗界已经在使用越来越小的医疗工具，比如导管，那么随着科技的发展，在未来导管将被医生更加广泛地使用，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the last paragraph mainly about?
options: A. AI plays an important role in developing tiny robots.
B. Tiny robots can run fast and treat a blood clot easily.
C. Tiny robots with a low degree of intelligence are still useful.
D. We still need very powerful artificial intelligence to treat illness.
questions.analysis: 136．段落大意题。根据“We may not actually need something as powerful as artificial intelligence (AI) in these cases...It might only have the intelligence of bacteria but could still work.”可知，本段主要是说智能程度低的微型机器人还是有用的，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the new study, dog owners ________.
options: A. must offer dry food to their dogs
B. can feed dogs on “people food”
C. had better buy more processed food
D. shouldn’t make food by themselves
questions.analysis: 137．细节理解题。根据“A new study suggests that by sharing “people food”, you might actually be helping to keep your pet healthy.”可知，一项新的研究表明，通过分享“人类食物”，你实际上可能有助于保持你的宠物健康。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Paragraph 3 mainly explains why ________.
options: A. dogs need different kinds of foods
B. little living things stay in human bodies
C. scientists study dry processed food
D. people should keep dogs at home
questions.analysis: 138．段落大意题。根据“This is because having different kinds of foods leads to more variety (多样性) in microbes”以及本段内容可知本段主要解释了为什么狗需要不同种类的食物。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How does the writer describe the study in Paragraph 4 to make it believable?
questions.analysis: 139．细节理解题。根据“When the dogs reached adulthood, their owners reported that about 20% of the dogs...”可知，本段主要通过列数字使研究可信，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which part of a magazine is the passage probably taken from?
questions.analysis: 140．推理判断题。本文主要科普通过分享“人类食物”，实际上可能有助于保持宠物健康。由此推知，可能在科学版块看到这篇文章，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we infer (推断) about Li Hong from the second paragraph?
options: A. There is no other furniture in her house but books.
B. Her mother teaches Chinese in a junior high school.
C. She has probably read the book Journey to the West.
D. She has changed her dream because of the campaign.
questions.analysis: 141．推理判断题。根据“I know a lot about Chinese classic works.”可知李红对中国古典名著了解很多，由此推出她可能读过经典名著《西游记》。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following probably belongs to survey reading?
options: A. Learning a long poem at a relaxed speed.
B. Reading a novel carefully to write a report.
C. Enjoying interesting comic strips as you like.
D. Searching newspapers quickly for something.
questions.analysis: 142．推理判断题。根据“Survey reading is a way of reading fast to get the main idea or find the information you need.”可知概括性阅读是一种快速阅读的方式，以获得主要思想或找到你需要的信息，由此推出在报纸上快速搜索属于概括性阅读。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What kind of books should we read according to Emerson?
options: A. Books that are well known.
B. Books that cost a lot of money.
C. Books that are about rules.
D. Books that come out within a year.
questions.analysis: 143．细节理解题。根据“Emerson, a great writer and thinker, had three rules: never read a book that is not a year old; never read any but famous books; never read a book you don’t like.”可知爱默生认为永远不要读一本未满一年的书、只读名著、永远不要读你不喜欢的书。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of writing this text?
options: A. To introduce a reading campaign.
B. To advise us to build bookhouses.
C. To encourage people to read books.
D. To tell us about some classic works.
questions.analysis: 144．主旨大意题。本文主要介绍了读书在全国成为一种趋势，并谈论了如何读书和读什么书，鼓励人们读书。结合“Try to be a best reader. If you are getting the most out of a book, you will do things more confidently. Reading is rewarding!”可知写这篇文章是为了鼓励人们读书。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In which part of a magazine can we probably find the text?
questions.analysis: 148．推理判断题。根据“Have you ever heard of Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park?”及全文可知，本文主要介绍了海南热带雨林国家公园的动植物及风土人情，属于旅游范畴，故可以在杂志中的“旅游”版块读到此文章。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we know about the Sun?
options: A. The Sun rules the Moon.
B. The Sun shines during both day and night.
C. The Sun lights up all the sides of the Moon.
D. The Sun shines everywhere on the Earth at the same time.
questions.analysis: 153．细节理解题。根据“The Sun shines all the time. It shines during the day when we see it, and even at night when we don’t.”可知太阳白天黑夜都照耀着。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does Paragraph 5 mainly talk about?
options: A. How the Moon makes its light.
B. Why there is day and night on the Earth.
C. Why the Moon can be seen during the day.
D. What the difference is between Full Moon and New Moon.
questions.analysis: 155．段落大意题。根据“During Full Moon, the Moon rises around sunset, shines all night, and sets around sunrise. Since he moonlight is so bright, you can sometimes see it during the day, too.”（满月时，月亮在日落时升起，整夜闪耀，在日出时落下。由于月光如此明亮，你有时在白天也能看到它。）可知第五段主要讲述了为什么在白天可以看到月亮，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the theme(主题) of the text?
questions.analysis: 157．主旨大意题。根据全文可知，本文主要科普了一些关于太阳、月球和地球之间的知识，所以本文主题为科学，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of mentioning Jay in paragraph 1?
options: A. To introduce the topic of the passage.
B. To compare human society with animal society.
C. To give information of Call Ducks.
D. To describe an interesting story of animals.
questions.analysis: 158．推理判断题。根据“Jay, a 23-year-old man wearing an animal costume（戏服）, was giving out advertisement cards on the street. Jay was working so hard to make more people visit his store. Not only human society, but animal society also has such a group of animal ‘workers’.”可知，不仅人类社会有“动物”工作者，动物社会也有这样的一群动物“工作者”，由此可知，第1段提及Jay是为了引出文章的话题。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How do the writer talk about animals cafes?
questions.analysis: 159．推理判断题。根据“For example, the Call Duck Café（柯尔鸭咖啡厅）draws the attention of a large number of tourists with Call Ducks’ cute appearance.”和“Owl（猫头鹰）Cafes have become popular in Japan in recent years.”可知，作者通过举例子谈论动物咖啡馆的话题。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following words has the same meaning as the underlined word?
questions.analysis: 160．词句猜测题。根据“The aim of Animal Cafes is certainly to bring in more money but they should consider the well-being of these lovely animals.”可知，动物咖啡馆的目的当然是为了赚更多的钱，但他们应该考虑到这些可爱动物的健康。由此可知，well-being意为“健康”，与health同义。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the writer’s opinion about animal “workers”?
options: B. He believes they are useless.
C. He worries about their health.
D. He thinks they should work harder.
questions.analysis: 161．观点态度题。根据“The aim of Animal Cafes is certainly to bring in more money but they should consider the well-being of these lovely animals.”可知，动物咖啡馆的目的当然是为了赚更多的钱，但他们应该考虑到这些可爱动物的健康。由此可知，作者担心他们的健康。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the writer think of “learning cooking” in primary schools?
options: B. It’s just a useful skill for students.
C. It’s really a waste of time.
D. It must be canceled as a show.
questions.analysis: 162．推理判断题。根据“Some think that it is a useful skill for students, while others think it’s a waste of time, some even think it’s just a show. But do they really understand cooking?”和“It’s been said that good cooking is an art form. The truth is that it’s much more than that.”可知，作者认为烹饪远远不止是一种技能、不是浪费时间以及不是一种表演，事实远不止这些。所以作者认为学习烹饪需要更好的理解。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the writer think of failure in cooking?
options: A. Cooking can help people avoid failure.
B. There is no failure without success.
C. Failure is as important as success.
D. Cooking is sure to be failure at last.
questions.analysis: 164．细节理解题。根据“The importance of failures in making food is as much as successes.”可知，在制作食物的过程中，失败和成功同样重要。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why does the writer mention the change of Xiao Lei?
options: A. To show us carrots are good for our health.
B. To encourage kids to work with others.
C. To educate kids to be open to different foods.
D. To teach us how to make a salad with carrots.
questions.analysis: 165．细节理解题。根据“It also encourages them to be open to foods they might not have tried. Though being good to our health, carrots were hated by 12-year-old Xiao Lei. But he started to love them after he made a salad with them.”可知，烹饪鼓励学生们对自己可能没有尝试过的食物持开放态度。虽然胡萝卜对我们的健康有好处，但12岁的小雷却讨厌胡萝卜。但在用它们做沙拉后，他开始喜欢上了它们。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word vital in the last paragraph mean?
questions.analysis: 166．词句猜测题。分析“As a part of labor education, cooking is a way to teach kids vital 21st century skills, such as creativity, teamwork and so on.”可知，作为劳动教育的一部分，烹饪是教给孩子们21世纪重要技能的一种方式，比如创造力、团队合作等等。此处vital的意思是“重要的”，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How long do teenagers need to sleep at least every day?
questions.analysis: 167．细节理解题。根据“Teenagers 8-10”可知，青少年需要8-10小时的睡眠，所以是至少8小时。故选B。

questions.prompt: The writer proves a lack of sleep plays a role in accidents by ________.

questions.prompt: Which of the following can be put in ______ ▲ ?

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “They” in Paragraph 3 refer to?
questions.analysis: 171．代词指代题。分析“Self-driving cars bring us many benefits. They use computers to sense the things around them and make better use of space.”可知，自动驾驶汽车给我们带来了许多好处。它们用电脑来感知周围的事物，更好地利用空间。此处they指的是自动驾驶汽车，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do we know about self-driving cars?
options: A. They cannot make good use of space.
B. They always react faster than humans.
C. They do not lose focus like humans do.
questions.analysis: 172．细节理解题。根据“By using computers, self-driving cars don’t make poor decisions or lose focus like humans do.”可知，通过使用计算机，自动驾驶汽车不会像人类那样做出糟糕的决定或注意力分散。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: We can infer(推断) that China ________ in self-driving technology.
options: C. is going to cut its total costs
questions.analysis: 173．推理判断题。根据“It’s clear that there is still a long way to go to make self-driving cars a common and safe sight(景象) on our roads. And China is taking the lead in making this happen”可知，要让自动驾驶汽车成为我们道路上常见而安全的景象，还有很长的路要走，中国正在率先实现这一目标，由此可知，中国将在自动驾驶技术方面取得更大的进步。故选A。

B. tell people several advantages of self-driving cars
C. introduce the present situation of self-driving cars
questions.analysis: 174．主旨大意题。本文主要介绍自动驾驶汽车的现状，包括自动驾驶汽车的优势和劣势，故选C。

questions.prompt: The writer would most probably talk about _________ after Paragraph 5.
options: A. how we can know the Beijing hutongs better
B. what we can do to protect the Beijing hutongs
C. why many new buildings were built in Beijing

questions.prompt: To begin your trip, you have to ________.
options: A. download the Treasure Find app
questions.analysis: 184．细节理解题。根据“To begin your trip, you must download the Treasure Find app.（要开始你的旅程，你必须下载寻宝应用程序。）”可知要开始你的旅程，你必须下载寻宝应用程序。故选A。

questions.prompt: How do you know where to go?
options: B. By asking people on streets.
C. By calling the Treasure Find team.
D. By following the directions from the app.
questions.analysis: 185．细节理解题。根据“Then touch ‘start’ and the app will give you directions to your first place. Follow the directions to that place.（然后点击“开始”， 应用程序会为你提供前往第一个地方的指示。按照指示前往那个地方。）”可知，按照应用程序的指示从而知道去哪里。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: If you do badly on the test, what will happen?
options: A. You will not get directions to the next place.
B. You will have to start your trip again.
C. You may get difficult directions to the next place.
D. You may have to take the test again.
questions.analysis: 186．细节理解题。根据“You only have 30 seconds to study the information, and then you’ll get a test. If you pass the test, you can get easy directions to the next place. If not, the directions can be difficult.（你只有30秒的时间来研究这些信息，然后你会得到一个测试。如果你通过了测试，你可以得到去下一个地方的简单路线。如果不通过，路线可能会很难。）”可知，如果测试没通过，你可能会遇到很难的路线。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “it” refer to?
questions.analysis: 187．词义猜测题。根据“Once you get to the last place, there is a Treasure Find sign. Stand next to it and take a photo.（一旦你到达最后一个地方，就会有一个寻宝标志。站在它旁边拍照。）”可知，it指的是寻宝标志。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the text?
questions.analysis: 188．推理判断题。根据“These days, a game called Treasure Find is getting popular among young people in some western countries.Would you like to have a try?（最近，一款名为寻宝的游戏在一些西方国家的年轻人中流行起来。你想试试吗）”结合全文内容，主要介绍了寻宝游戏的玩法。可知，本文是一篇介绍。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why is ChatGPT banned in some schools?
options: A. It can offer help quickly.
B. Students may chat on it.
C. It can pass a test in seconds.
D. Students may cheat in exams.
questions.analysis: 189．细节理解题。根据“Some schools have banned（禁止）it The New York City’s Department of Education, for example, banned ChatGPT from its public school networks, and some people are warning that it could encourage more students to cheat, especially in exams.”可知是因为学生可能在考试中作弊。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In what way can AI help students?
options: A. It offers students a number of jobs.
B. It suits students’ personal learning.
C. It frees students from boring work.
D. It allows students to focus on learning.
questions.analysis: 190．细节理解题。根据“AI powered education technologies can be used to make the learning experience more suitable for each student.”可知人工智能可以帮助适合学生的个人学习。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the writer’s attitude（态度）towards ChatGPT?
questions.analysis: 191．观点态度题。根据“Since we cannot avoid ChatGPT and other AI powered apps from entering the field of education, we should make efforts to make sure they have a positive impact（积极影响）on society and the future of education. AI helps to make learning much more interesting and enjoyable, but humans need to work very hard to win the race with technology.”（既然我们无法避免ChatGPT和其他人工智能应用进入教育领域，我们应该努力确保它们对社会和教育的未来产生积极的影响。人工智能有助于使学习变得更加有趣和愉快，但人类需要非常努力地工作才能赢得与技术的竞争。）可知作者持支持态度，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can be inferred from the last paragraph?
options: A. AI apps still have a long way to go.
B. Humans will be left behind by technology.
C. The future of education depends on AI apps.
D. AI must be made good use of in education.
questions.analysis: 192．推理判断题。根据“Since we cannot avoid ChatGPT and other AI powered apps from entering the field of education, we should make efforts to make sure they have a positive impact（积极影响）on society and the future of education.”（既然我们无法避免ChatGPT和其他人工智能应用进入教育领域，我们应该努力确保它们对社会和教育的未来产生积极的影响。）可知人工智能必须在教育中得到很好的利用。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where can you listen to an interesting speech?
questions.analysis: 193．细节理解题。根据“Hyde Park first opened to the people of London in the seventeenth century...There are usually a lot of people at Speakers’ Corner.”可知在海德公园可以听一场有趣的演说，故选A。

questions.prompt: What can you do in Regent’s Park?
options: A. See a statue of Peter Pan.
C. Go boating on the lake.
D. Watch birds on the playground.
questions.analysis: 194．细节理解题。根据“There is also a theatre in the park. On a summer’s evening, you can sit out and watch a play by Shakespeare...In the summer, you can listen to music in the park.”可知在摄政公园你可以欣赏戏剧或音乐。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do we know about St James’s Park?
options: A. It’s a very old royal park.
B. It’s far away from the Mall.
C. It was built in the 17th century.
D. It has a lake called the Serpentine.
questions.analysis: 195．细节理解题。根据“St James’s Park is next to the Mall. It is a small park, but very beautiful, and it is the oldest of the royal（皇家）parks.”可知圣詹姆斯公园是一个非常古老的皇家公园。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: People would move to Mars because________.
options: A. the earth is crowded and polluted
B. they want to challenge themselves
C. flying to Mars would be fun
D. plants could grow better there
questions.analysis: 196．细节理解题。根据第1段“Our own planet, the Earth, is becoming more and more crowded and polluted.”可知，因为我们自己的星球，地球正变得越来越拥挤和污染，所以才决定去火星，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined word “spacecraft” means________.
questions.analysis: 197．词义猜测题。根据“At present, our spacecraft are too slow to carry large numbers of passengers to Mars” （现在，我们的宇宙飞船太慢以至于不能带大量的人去火星）可知带人们去火星的应该是宇宙飞船，spacecraft应该是“宇宙飞船” 的意思，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What would the flight to Mars be like by the year 2100?
questions.analysis: 198．细节理解题。根据第2段“However, the spacecraft would travel really fast, so the journey to Mars might be quite uncomfortable.”（然而，宇宙飞船的速度非常快，所以前往火星的旅程可能会非常不舒服。）可知去火星的飞行很快但不舒服，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the passage?
options: A. There would be enough water and air on Mars for people.
B. Food on Mars would be more delicious than that on the earth.
C. People would be busy with work on Mars.
D. The writer thinks living on Mars would be full of challenges.
questions.analysis: 199．细节理解题。根据倒数第2段“Life on Mars would be interesting and challenging.”可知，火星上的生活将是有趣而富有挑战性的。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the best title for the passage?
questions.analysis: 200．标题归纳题。根据整篇文章和第1段“It is hoped that people could start all over again and build a better world on Mars, Here is what life there could be like.”（人们希望人类可以重新开始，在火星上建立一个更美好的世界，那里的生活可以是这样的。）可知，文章是想象人们搬到火星上的生活。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is mentioned in the passage?
options: A. Scientists can use human cells to kill damaged parts of human bodies.
B. All people will be able to live to be one hundred years old in forty years.
C. In the future, humans may be able to communicate with dogs and aliens.
D. The sensors will turn off the lights after you leave the living room in the future.
questions.analysis: 201．细节理解题。根据“In the future, we will be able to ‘talk’ to animals.”以及“We may find aliens in space and talk with them.”可知，在未来，人类或许能够与狗以及外星人交流。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which scientist believes we will find aliens?
questions.analysis: 202．细节理解题。根据“NASA scientist Chris Mckay says, ‘We may find aliens in space and talk with them.’ ”可知，美国国家航空航天局科学家Chris Mckay认为我们能够发现外星人。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The writer wrote the passage in a tone (语气) of ________.
questions.analysis: 204．推理判断题。根据“They said that in the near future, our lives would change beyond our wildest dreams.”以及“What an amazing world it will be! Does life in the future sound cool to you?”可知，未来生活的改变将超出我们的想象，是令人惊讶的，所以作者以惊叹的语气写出了这篇文章，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the best title for the passage?
options: C. What Humans Will Be Like
D. How We Can Live Longer
questions.analysis: 205．最佳标题题。通读全文，主要结合首尾段可知，文章主要谈论了人们未来的生活可能发生的神奇改变，A项最适合做标题。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: After the coming-of-age ceremony, the young people could get married and had to ________ in ancient China.
options: C. be responsible for their families
questions.analysis: 206．细节理解题。根据“it was the symbol of their right (权利) to get married and their duty (义务) to share family responsibilities.”可知，成人礼是他们结婚的权利和分担家庭责任的义务的象征。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined word “ kneel” in Paragraph 3 means “________” .
options: B. go down on one’s knees
C. lie down on one’s back
questions.analysis: 207．词义猜测题。根据“...on the ground and listen to his or her parents’ expectations and words used to educate the child.”及常识可知，应是跪在地上听父母的教诲，所以划线单词表示“跪”，与B项同义，故选B。

questions.prompt: Who would do the guan li or ji li at the coming-of-age ceremony in ancient China?
questions.analysis: 208．细节理解题。根据“A respected (受尊敬的) elder that was chosen to hold this ceremony would wash hands and do the guan li or ji li in several steps.”可知，一位受人尊敬的长者被选来主持这个仪式，他会洗手，并分几个步骤进行冠礼或笄礼。故选A。

source.sourceSection: （2023·黑龙江牡丹江·统考中考真题）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What may some young people do at the ceremony in modern China?
questions.analysis: 209．细节理解题。根据“Besides a traditional ceremony mentioned above, some young people may wear traditional Chinese clothing or modem clothing and take professional photos to record this special event.”可知，一些年轻人可能会穿着中国传统服装或现代服装，并拍摄专业照片来记录这个特殊的时刻，故选A。

source.sourceSection: （2023·黑龙江牡丹江·统考中考真题）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The passage is mainly about ________.
questions.analysis: 210．主旨大意题。本文主要介绍了中国孩子18岁的成人礼。故选C。

source.sourceSection: （2023·黑龙江牡丹江·统考中考真题）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Dogs were ________ thousands of years ago.
questions.analysis: 211．细节理解题。根据“Thousands of years ago, you couldn’t find dogs. You could find wolves (狼). ”可知几千年前狗就是狼，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Since some wolves ________, we have been friends with them.
options: C. started to be guard dogs
questions.analysis: 212．细节理解题。根据“As time went by, these wolves started to be guard dogs and help to drive away dangerous animals. Since then, we have been friends with dogs.”可知自从一些狼开始成为看门狗以来，我们就和它们成为了朋友。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When a dog is happy, it will ________ according to the third paragraph (段落).
options: C. stand its tail straight up
questions.analysis: 213．细节理解题。根据“It might bark (吠) with excitement, give you a lick (舔) or wag (摆动) its tail to show its happiness.”可知当狗高兴时，它会兴奋地吠叫，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following sentences may be put in the “________” in Paragraph 4?
options: A. What can a dog do?
B. Are you afraid of dogs?
C. Why do people like dogs?
D. Do you want to keep a dog?
questions.analysis: 214．推理判断题。根据“If you want to keep a dog as a pet, make sure your family has enough space, money and the time that you need to care for a dog.”（如果你想养一只狗作为宠物，确保你的家庭有足够的空间、金钱和时间来照顾狗。）结合选项可知，应该问“你是否想养狗”，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the passage?
options: A. Every family must keep a dog.
B. Keeping a dog is good for health.
C. Healthier people can keep more dogs.
D. Dogs can bring many friends to the family.
questions.analysis: 215．细节理解题。根据“Scientists have found that keeping a dog can make people healthier and people can have a higher level of physical activity.”可知科学家发现，养狗可以让人更健康，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the goldfish experiment?
options: A. To see if goldfish could tell different colors.
B. To see if goldfish could find food and living places.
C. To see if goldfish could navigate in a different environment.
D. To see if goldfish could ride a bike or drive a car like humans.
questions.analysis: 216．推理判断题。根据“Recently, researchers in Israel have done an experiment and found that goldfish are able to navigate on land”可知，金鱼在陆地上也具有导航能力，进而可以推出研究人员开展金鱼实验的目的是为了检验金鱼在不同的环境中是否仍具备导航能力。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can be learned about the FOV?
options: A. It was placed inside a water box.
B. It could follow the fish’s movements.
C. It was driven by a camera system.
D. It could control the fish’s directions.
questions.analysis: 217．细节理解题。根据“the FOV recorded the fish’s movements and swimming directions, and then moved in the same direction”可知，鱼驱动车可以按鱼移动轨迹前进。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The goldfish would get food as long as the car ________.
options: B. moved in the small room freely
D. touched the targets of other colors
questions.analysis: 218．细节理解题。根据“The fish would get food when the car touched the target.”可知，当车触碰到粉色目标的时候可以得到食物。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from Shachar Givon’s words?
options: A. It was important for the goldfish to drive a car.
B. It was impossible for the goldfish to navigate.
C. It was meaningless for the goldfish to be trained at first.
D. It was hard for the goldfish to reach the target at the start.
questions.analysis: 219．推理判断题。根据“As anyone who has tried to learn how to ride a bike or to drive a car knows, it is challenging at first.”可知，任何试图学习如何骑自行车或开车的人都知道，一开始是很有挑战性的。由此可知，Shachar Givon想表达的是金鱼很难在一开始就到达目标。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which can be the best title for the passage?
options: A. Good Use of a Robotic Car
C. Goldfish’s Ability to Navigate on Land
D. Goldfish’s Skills to Drive a Car on Land
questions.analysis: 220．最佳标题题。通读全文，本文主要讲述科研人员通过金鱼实验证实动物导航系统的可行性，选项C“金鱼在陆地上的导航能力”最符合本文。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The numbers in Paragraph 2 show that ________.
options: A. marathons are getting big in China
B. our physical fitness is getting better
C. more and more young people love running
D. China is holding too many marathons this year
questions.analysis: 221．推理判断题。第二段中的数据表明今年上半年，全国共有133场马拉松比赛注册。据《中国日报》报道，3月26日，全国共有超过30万名选手参加了26场马拉松比赛。由此推出这是为了显示马拉松在中国越来越流行。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What information can we learn about Xu Qian?
options: A. He was no longer a teenager.
B. He did much training and preparation.
C. He got first place in local stadiums.
D. He didn’t feel tired in the marathon.
questions.analysis: 222．细节理解题。根据“For Xu, the race meant months of training and preparation. He ran about 30 to 40 kilometers in local stadiums each week ahead of the run.”可知徐谦做了大量的训练和准备。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “opponent” in Paragraph 5 mean?
options: A. Someone who always controls you.
B. Someone who never refuses you.
C. Someone who competes against you.
D. Someone who often cheers you on.
questions.analysis: 223．词义猜测题。根据“you have to beat”可知要打败的是对手故，opponent意为“对手”。选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did Li Zhouzi think of the crowds’ cheering?
options: A. It made her lose focus.
B. It made her feel bored.
C. It didn’t matter a great deal to her.
D. It made her hold on.
questions.analysis: 224．细节理解题。根据“The cheers from the people along the course really encouraged her.”可知李舟子认为人群的欢呼声能够鼓舞她，使她坚持跑下去。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is Li Zhouzi’s attitude toward life?
options: A. All the pain and tears are life’s gifts.
B. Pain and suffering are not important at all in our life.
C. The suffering is more important than the final result.
D. Center on the goal and don’t be afraid of the difficulties.
questions.analysis: 225．观点态度题。根据“She believes that running a marathon is about focusing on the final goal, not the suffering along the way. ‘Similarly, our life is also a marathon,’ Li said.”可知李舟子认为生活也是一场马拉松，要以目标为中心，不要害怕困难。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who uses tie-dye to dye clothes most?
questions.analysis: 226．细节理解题。根据“The Bai people use a very old way, tie-dye (扎染), to dye clothes.”可知，白族人用一种非常古老的方法——扎染来给衣服染色。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the Mongolian yurt?
questions.analysis: 227．细节理解题。根据“They are the traditional homes of the Mongolian people.”可知，蒙古包是蒙古人民的传统家园，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “thrilling” mean in Paragraph 4?
questions.analysis: 228．词句猜测题。分析“It is thrilling and wonderful. Men and women singers sing in pairs.”可知，是很棒的，男女歌手成对演唱。所以是一个近似的词汇，选项C“令人兴奋的”与之相符，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How do people celebrate Manghao Festival?
options: A. By choosing tie-dyed clothes as gifts.
D. By dressing up and touching others.
questions.analysis: 229．细节理解题。根据“At the festival, young men dress up like Manghao and touch others to send good wishes.”可知，在这个节日里，年轻人打扮成芒蒿的样子，用手触摸别人来传递美好的祝愿。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The writer starts the passage by _______.
questions.analysis: 231．推理判断题。根据“So how do they sleep while they’re in the ocean?”（那么它们在海里是怎么睡觉的呢？）可知，作者以一个问题开始这篇文章。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does Paragraph 2 mainly tell us?
options: A. How elephant seals sleep in the ocean.
B. Why elephant seals dive deep underwater.
C. How elephant seals dive deep underwater.
questions.analysis: 232．段落大意题。根据“Near the surface, some dangerous animals like sharks might attack(攻击) them. So elephant seals spend most of their time diving(下潜) deep underwater, looking for food.”（在水面附近，一些像鲨鱼这样的危险动物可能会攻击它们。因此，象海豹大部分时间都在水下深处潜水寻找食物。）可知，第二段主要讲述了为什么象海豹会潜入深海，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The special caps are used to _______.
options: A. help the elephant seals to dive more deeply
B. keep the elephant seals away from being attacked by sharks
C. collect the information about the elephant seals when they are in the ocean

questions.prompt: Why do Western people accept the Chinese Rabbit easily?

questions.analysis: 248．细节理解题。根据“The worldwide popularity of the Chinese Rabbit might have something to do with Western culture. For people in Europe, rabbits mean new life and prosperity(繁荣) as they can give birth to many young ones. So the image of a rabbit is easily accepted by people in the West.(中国兔子在世界范围内的流行可能与西方文化有关。对欧洲人来说，兔子意味着新的生活和繁荣，因为它们可以生很多小兔子。所以兔子的形象很容易被西方人接受。)”可知西方人易于接受中国兔子，是因为兔子在西方文化中也有美好的寓意，即兔子在中西方文化中有联系。故选B。
