questions.prompt: How many countries do the students at TUS visit every year?
questions.analysis: 274．细节理解题。根据“The students live and learn in four different countries each year.”可知，学生们每年在四个不同的国家生活和学习。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What would the students at TUS do while visiting the Pyramids of Egypt?
options: A. Watch a video about the school.
B. Listen to a story about the great buildings.
C. Read something about Xu Xiake’s travels.
questions.analysis: 275．细节理解题。根据“or listening to a story about the Pyramids of Egypt while visiting the great buildings”可知，在参观伟大的建筑时听一个关于埃及金字塔的故事。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does TUS aim to do?
options: B. Get students to be off the real world.
C. Make students travel and learn online.
questions.analysis: 276．细节理解题。根据“We aim to help you become a well-rounded person.”可知，我们的目标是帮助你成为一个全面发展的人。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why do many people use simple passwords in their daily life?
options: B. To make life easy for themselves.
C. To help hackers get information quickly.
questions.analysis: 277．细节理解题。根据“These people are trying to make life easy for themselves.”可知，这些人使用简单的密码是试图让自己的生活更轻松。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How often should we change the passwords according to the text?
questions.analysis: 278．细节理解题。根据“Change the passwords every three months.”可知，每三个月更换一次密码。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: People search for ________ to meet their needs according to the passage.
questions.analysis: 279．细节理解题。根据“There is a great need to search for clean and renewable(可再生的) energy to meet our needs.”可知，人们在搜索干净的和可再生的能源来满足他们的需求。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many advantages of wind energy are talked about in the passage?
questions.analysis: 280．细节理解题。根据“The first advantage of wind energy is that it truly is a renewable resource.”；“Second, wind energy is a clean source of energy, which means it produces environment-friendly electricity. ”；“What’s more, the large towers,which provide the base for the wind turbines(涡轮机), don’t take up lots of space.”可知一共是3个优势，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “They” refer to in Paragraph 2?
questions.analysis: 281．词义猜测题。根据“What’s more, the large towers,which provide the base for the wind turbines(涡轮机), don’t take up lots of space. They can share land with farms.”可知本句说的话题是“large towers”，它们不占空间，可以和农业共用陆地。故“They”指的是“large towers”。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the main idea of Paragraph 3?
options: A. Wind energy also has some disadvantages
B. Wind can't provide energy without stopping
C. The blades of wind turbines can be very dangerous
D. The turbines cause noise pollution while working
questions.analysis: 282．段落大意题。根据“However, each coin has two sides. That is to say wind energy does have some disadvantages.”可知本段主要讲风能也有劣势。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, we know that ________.
options: A. wind energy is a non-renewable resource
B. the greatest advantage of wind energy is renewable
C. the windiest areas never have periods of clam
D. wind turbines can't be dangerous for birds and bats
questions.analysis: 283．细节理解题。根据“This is its greatest advantage compared with non-renewable resources like coal or oil.”可知可再生是风能相比其他不可再生能源最大的优势。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How does the writer lead into the topic “bicycle-powered energy” in Paragraph 2?
options: C. By using an old saying.
questions.analysis: 284．细节理解题。根据“But do you know that energy can come from people, too? When you pedal a bike, you produce energy. You use your legs to push the pedals. Your energy is transferred (转移) to the bike.”可知，作者是通过问问题来引出“自行车动力能源”的，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “spins” mean in the text?
options: C. Moves up and down slowly.
D. Turns round and round quickly.
questions.analysis: 285．词义猜测题。根据“When a student pedals the bike, the back wheel spins.”可及常识可知，当踩自行车时，后轮会转动，所以划线单词表示“转动”，D项符合，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is Paragraph 5 mainly about?
options: A. The future of new energy.
B. The forms of world’s energy.
questions.analysis: 286．段落大意题。根据“People use bicycle-powered energy to run small devices (设备) such as small televisions and fans. ”可知，本段主要讲的是“自行车动力能源”的使用，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do we know about bicycle-powered energy?
options: A. It can’t be seen in schools.
B. It comes from wind and water.
C. It can be stored and used later.
D. It’s from power lines overhead.
questions.analysis: 287．细节理解题。根据“This energy can also be stored and used later.”可知，这种能源可以储存起来以后使用，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In which unit of a textbook can the text be found?
options: B. Unit 2 Dream of the Stars
C. Unit 3 The Value of Money
D. Unit 4 The World of Science
questions.analysis: 288．推理判断题。本文主要讲述了“自行车动力能源”相关知识，与科学相关，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which sport is an indoor game?
questions.analysis: 289．细节理解题。根据“Bowling: It is an indoor game.”可知，保龄球是一项室内运动。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many holes are there in a mini golf course?
questions.analysis: 290．细节理解题。根据“There are 18 holes in a mini golf course.”可知，迷你高尔夫球场有18个洞。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where is a beach volleyball game held?
questions.analysis: 291．细节理解题。根据“ The game is held on the sand.”可知，比赛在沙滩上进行，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the most exciting moment in a baseball match?
questions.analysis: 292．细节理解题。根据“Hitting a “home run” (本垒打) is the most exciting moment in a match.”可知，打出“本垒打”是比赛中最激动人心的时刻，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the text mainly about?
questions.analysis: 293．主旨大意题。本文主要介绍了四种运动。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why do some people like reading e-books?
options: B. E-books are convenient and easy to carry.
C. E-books increase printing costs and paper use.
D. E-books benefit people with reading difficulties.
questions.analysis: 294．细节理解题。根据“Many people like reading e-books because they are convenient and easy to carry.”可知，一些人喜欢电子书是因为电子书便利且方便携带。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we know from paragraph 3?
options: A. People are too busy to read a real book.
B. Children are into reading e-books nowadays.
C. It is enjoyable to read real books in a library.
D. All the real books can be translated well to digital.
questions.analysis: 295．细节理解题。根据“There is nothing better than the feel of a real book…It’s part of the experience of reading—just like going to a library or bookstore and turning the pages of a book freely.”和“when reading a real book, you can feel a pleasure of the mind”可知，在图书馆里读真正的书是令人愉快的。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the purpose of listing numbers in the last paragraph?
options: A. To stress the importance of reading books.
B. To show the popularity of reading real books.
C. To give examples of American best-selling books.
D. To compare the differences of the two reading habits.
questions.analysis: 296．推理判断题。通读最后一段可知，实体书的销量远高于电子书，而且大多数人仍然喜欢读实体书，本段列出的数字是为了说明阅读实体书的受欢迎程度。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the main idea of the text?
options: B. Reading books is a good habit
C. Real books benefit us in many ways
D. Nothing compares to reading an e-book
questions.analysis: 297．主旨大意题。通读全文，结合“However, a real book can never be replaced.”可知，本文主要介绍了与电子书相比，实体书的好处有哪些。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Cloud Music app was founded ________ than Douyin app.
questions.analysis: 298．细节理解题。根据“Founding Time”可知云音乐创建时间是2013年4月，抖音创建时间是2016年9月，云音乐比抖音早三年。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: If you want to know what’s going on in our country, ________ can help you.
questions.analysis: 299．细节理解题。根据“Find what’s going on in our country and watch some videos.”可知头条可以了解世界发生的事。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: While you have Douyin, you can ________.
options: A. listen to the world’s news
C. make your own interesting videos
questions.analysis: 300．细节理解题。根据“Make fun with personal videos and more funny things.”可知抖音可以制作短视频。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many apps are founded in the same year?
questions.analysis: 301．细节理解题。根据“Founding Time”可知云音乐创建时间是2013年4月，抖音创建时间是2016年9月，头条创建时间是2013年3月，两个app创建于同一时间。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE according to the form above?
options: A. Toutiao is a new app to make fun with personal videos and more funny things.
B. You can use Toutiao through two languages.
C. Cloud Music is a music app for you to learn English.
questions.analysis: 302．细节理解题。根据“Chinese, English”可知头条有两种语言。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the advantage of social media according to the passage?
options: A. It helps teenagers make more friends.
B. It enables teenagers to do more exercise.
C. It makes teenagers focus on their schoolwork.
D. It offers teenagers chances to stay with families.
questions.analysis: 303．细节理解题。根据“Many teenagers agree that social media helps them stay connected to their friends and make new friends from around the world.”可知，社交媒体可以帮助青少年交到更多的朋友。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “appealing” in paragraph 3 probably mean?
questions.analysis: 304．词义猜测题。根据“and that their kids can’t take their eyes off the screen.”（他们的孩子目不转睛地盯着屏幕）可知，此处应该表示网络上的东西看起来很有趣，很吸引人，所以appealing和Interesting意思相近，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What should teenagers do when faced with cyberbullying?
options: A. Believe it’s not a big deal.
B. Keep the problem a secret.
C. Never surf the Internet again.
D. Tell a trusted adult what happened.
questions.analysis: 305．细节理解题。根据“The first thing to do is to tell a trusted adult about what is going on.”可知，面对网络欺凌，青少年应该首先告诉一个值得信任的成年人发生了什么。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which statement would the author most probably agree with?
options: A. Teenagers are too shy to share their opinions online.
B. All the teenagers have learned the rules of being safe online.
C. Teenagers should be responsible for their words and actions online.
D. It’s wise to keep silent when you find your friend is being bullied online.
questions.analysis: 306．推理判断题。根据“If you have shared something you shouldn’t have, it’s never too late to say sorry and fix the situation—such as taking the post down”（如果你分享了一些你不该分享的东西，道歉和补救永远都不晚——比如把帖子撤下）可推断，C选项“青少年应该对自己在网上的言行负责。”是作者同意的，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which is the best way to keep cool according to paragraph 1?
options: D. Staying at a cool place.
questions.analysis: 307．细节理解题。根据“We can put on hats, wear light clothing, or stay at a cool place. However, nothing can beat a good fan.”可知天热想保持凉爽的最佳方式就是使用一把好扇子。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why is quality paper a good choice to make a fan?
questions.analysis: 308．细节理解题。根据“All paper will work, but your DIY fan can be used for a long time with quality (优质的) paper.”可知是因为可以长时间使用。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the second step of making a paper fan?
options: B. Drawing pictures on the paper.
D. Gluing the sticks onto the folded paper.
questions.analysis: 309．细节理解题。根据“The next step is to fold up (折叠) the paper.”可知第二个步骤是把纸折叠起来。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the last paragraph, we can tell that making a paper fan is ________.
questions.analysis: 310．推理判断题。根据“If you look at your watch, you will be surprised: it takes less than 15 minutes to make a good paper fan.(如果你看看你的手表，你会感到惊讶:制作一个好的纸扇只需要不到15分钟。)”可推知制作纸扇是非常快的。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of this passage?
options: B. To show how to save time.
C. To share a fun story.
D. To teach how to make paper fans.
questions.analysis: 311．推理判断题。本文介绍了纸扇可以保持凉爽，以及制作纸扇的步骤，即教我们如何制作纸扇。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to studies, what will happen to your body if an alarm wakes you up suddenly?
options: A. Your heart will beat faster.
B. You may breathe more slowly.
C. Your body temperature will go up.
D. You will have lower blood pressure.
questions.analysis: 317．细节理解题。根据“Studies show that when you get shocked by the alarm, your breathing will go up, your heart will have more beats and your blood pressure will rise.”可知如果闹钟突然把人叫醒，我们心脏会跳地更快。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following does Whitney Roban agree?
options: A. Trying to use an alarm with louder sounds.
B. Going back to sleep again after waking up.
C. Reading magazines online before going to bed.
D. Following the body’s natural sleep—wake cycle.
questions.analysis: 318．细节理解题。根据“It’s important to follow your body’s natural sleep—wake cycle (循环).”可知睡眠科学家Whitney Roban认为：我们要遵循身体的自然睡眠——觉醒周期。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the last paragraph?
options: A. It is necessary for people to oversleep.
B. Heavy work can lead to oversleeping.
C. It is hard to change people’s sleeping habits.
D. Oversleeping sometimes makes us more tired.
questions.analysis: 319．细节理解题。根据“If we wake up too late, our bodies might feel stuck between sleep and being awake. That’s why sometimes we feel even more tired after oversleeping.(如果我们醒得太晚，我们的身体可能会感到困在睡眠和清醒之间。这就是为什么有时我们在睡过头后会感到更累。)”可知本段告诉我们睡过头会让我们更累。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A. Why people need to sleep.
B. Why people have sleeping problems.
C. How to have healthy sleep.
D. How to wake up in a natural way.
questions.analysis: 320．主旨大意题。本文就如何拥有健康的睡眠给出了一些建议。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do we know about Pei Haozheng’s work, Deer with 100 Flowers?
options: A. He used glue and scissors to finish it.
B. He used 100 flowers to make a deer with his parents.
C. It shows good wishes for Chinese young people and the country.
D. It is made of some pieces of paper with the lengths of 2.22 meters.
questions.analysis: 321．细节理解题。根据“As for the idea for the work, Pei said it came from a Chinese saying. It not only shows the wishes for Chinese young people to have a bright future, but also the deep love for our country.”可知这幅作品不仅表达了对中国年轻人美好未来的祝愿，也表达了对祖国的深情厚爱。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is Paragraph 4 mainly about?
options: A. How to learn math well.
B. How to be a creative artist.
C. What is less important for folding.
D. What skills are needed for his work.
questions.analysis: 322．段落大意题。根据“For Pei, folding is an art that needs many skills. For example, it needs knowledge of math to make sure everything is in the right place, such as the different angles(角度) and the lengths of the creases(折痕). However, Pei thinks artistic beauty and exact folding are both important. Going too far with either won’t make good work.”可知本段介绍了折纸需要的技巧。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did Pei Haozheng say about paper folding?
options: A. He used it to spread Chinese culture.
B. It helped much to learn it earlier.
C. He wanted to teach people the skills.
D. It made him famous all over the world.
questions.analysis: 323．细节理解题。根据“As an artist, Pei wants to tell the Chinese story through paper. ‘For me, paper folding is not just a special skill, but an art that can pass culture and last forever,’ said Pei.(作为一名艺术家，裴浩正想通过纸来讲述中国的故事。裴浩正说：“对我来说，折纸不仅仅是一种特殊的技能，而是一种可以传递文化、永存的艺术。”)”可知裴浩正想借助折纸艺术来传递中国文化。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of writing the passage?
options: A. To explain why Pei’s work is so popular.
B. To introduce a Chinese artist Pei Haozheng.
C. To describe the development of paper folding.
D. To express the writer’s love for Chinese tradition.
questions.analysis: 324．主旨大意题。本文介绍了折纸艺术家裴浩正，以及他的折纸作品。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What was the relationship between Nicole and the writer before their recent meet?
options: B. They didn’t know each other well.
C. They used to work in the same office.
D. They often went to the bar together.
questions.analysis: 325．细节理解题。根据“I didn’t actually know her well as we had only met once at a meeting.”可知，他们彼此不太了解，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did Nicole feel after the writer had read her friends in the bar?
questions.analysis: 326．细节理解题。根据“‘Wow!’ She was shocked.”可知，当作者辨别了她在酒吧里的朋友们后，Nicole感觉很震惊，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the article, how does the writer “read” people?
options: A. By playing a clever trick on them.
B. By surveying some of their friends.
C. By having a short conversation with them.
D. By studying their clothes, expressions and so on.
questions.analysis: 327．细节理解题。根据“I judged(判断) their personalities simply by reading their body language, facial expressions, dress, and the way they talked with one another.”可知，作者通过他们的肢体语言、面部表情、衣着以及他们彼此交谈的方式来判断，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “non-verbal” mean?
questions.analysis: 328．词义猜测题。根据“Non-verbal communication became very important. Whenever words failed, I depended on people’s facial expressions.”可知，每当言语无法表达时，我就依靠人们的面部表情，所以前面说的是“非语言性的表达很重要”，单词“non-verbal”指的是“非语言的”，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Is there only sand in the desert of the world?
questions.analysis: 329．细节理解题。根据“You may think there is only sand in the desert of the world, but it is not true. In the desert, there is a little rain”可知沙漠里不只是有沙子，还有一点雨。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following sentence is true in the passage?
options: A. There is a little rain and some plants in the desert.
B. There is much water in the desert.
C. There is much rain and many plants in the desert
questions.analysis: 330．细节理解题。根据“In the desert, there is a little rain”以及“People grow all kinds of crops in the fields there”可知在沙漠里有一点雨以及各种植物。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What place do the desert people live in?
options: A. They only live in the oases.
B. They live on camels’ backs.
C. They live in and outside the oases.
questions.analysis: 331．细节理解题。根据“In the oases, there are villages and towns...People also lie outside the oases”可知人们住在绿洲里，也住在绿洲外。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: To carry water, food, tents and something else, the desert people use ________.
questions.analysis: 332．细节理解题。根据“They use the camels for carrying water, food, tents and something else.”可知他们用骆驼运送水、食物、帐篷和其他东西。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why do the people have to keep moving from place to place?
options: A. Because they must look for food for their animals.
C. Because the other desert people aren’t friendly.
questions.analysis: 333．细节理解题。根据“The desert people have to keep moving from place to place. They must always look for grass or desert plants for the animals.”可知沙漠中的人们不得不不断地从一个地方迁移到另一个地方，因为他们必须经常为动物寻找食物。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where does the special robot work indoors?
questions.analysis: 334．细节理解题。根据“One special robot can help in fast food restaurants.”可知，一种特殊的机器人可以在快餐店提供帮助。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What food can the special robot make at first?
questions.analysis: 335．细节理解题。根据“At first, the robot only made burgers.”可知，起初，机器人只做汉堡。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can make workers in danger when they fix railway lines?
questions.analysis: 336．细节理解题。根据“It helps workers fix railway lines (维修铁路线路). That’s because electricity can make some workers in danger and even fall sometimes.”可知，它帮助工人修理铁路线，这是因为电力会使一些工人处于危险之中，有时甚至会摔倒。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: We can infer (推断) that ______ from the 4th paragraph.
options: A. There will be fewer robots in our homes to do good jobs.
B. These special robots can’t work without people’s help.
C. There are four ways to order the robots to do all things.
questions.analysis: 337．推理判断题。根据“These unusual robots seem to be doing good jobs, but they still need help from people.”可知，这些不寻常的机器人似乎做得很好，但它们仍然需要人们的帮助。由此可知，这些特殊的机器人没有人的帮助就不能工作。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the best title of the passage?
questions.analysis: 338．最佳标题题。本文主要介绍一些特殊的机器人，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE about the Tang Paradise?
options: A. It’s in the north of Xi’an
B. It’s a large cultural theme park.
C. It shows the lifestyle of the Qin Dynasty.
questions.analysis: 339．细节理解题。根据“Tang Paradise, located in the south of Xi’an, is a large cultural theme park showing the lifestyle of the Tang Dynasty.”可知，大唐芙蓉园位于西安市南部，是一座展示唐代生活方式的大型文化主题公园。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Qinqiang Opera came from ________.
options: A. the ancient folk songs and dances
B. pop music and Western music
questions.analysis: 340．细节理解题。根据“Qinqiang Opera, which came from the ancient folk songs and dances of the people in Shaanxi and Gansu province”可知，秦腔源于陕甘两省古老的民间歌舞，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Qinqiang Opera was deeply influenced by the development of pop and Western music ________.
questions.analysis: 341．细节理解题。根据“However, the development of pop and Western music influenced Qinqiang Opera deep in the 1990s.”可知，20世纪90年代，流行音乐和西方音乐的发展对秦腔产生了深远的影响。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT TRUE about Qinqiang Opera?
options: A. Qinqiang Opera is one of the longest-live forms of opera in China.
B. Qinqaing Opera was listed as a national-level intangible cultural heritage in 2023.
C. Now Qinqiang Opera performances are welcomed by lots of young audiences.
questions.analysis: 342．细节理解题。根据“Qinqiang Opera was listed as a national-level intangible cultural heritage in 2006.”可知，2006年，秦腔被列为国家级非物质文化遗产。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The passage mainly talks about ________.
questions.analysis: 343．主旨大意题。本文主要介绍秦腔，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many people live in houseboats on the waters in Britain?
questions.analysis: 344．细节理解题。根据“Britain has many kilometers of rivers and canals (运河) —and around 30, 000 people live on these waters in houseboats.”可知大约有3万人住在海上的船屋。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined words “getting rid of” in paragraph 3 mean?
questions.analysis: 345．词义猜测题。根据“There are many jobs to do every day”可知是指要做的工作，结合“dirty water from the toilet,”可知应该是把厕所中的脏水倒掉，划线词汇表示“倒掉”。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE according to the story?
options: A. Houseboats have very big bedrooms to live.
B. Living on houseboats is the most comfortable.
C. Living on houseboats is very cold during winter.
questions.analysis: 346．细节理解题。根据“During winter, living on a boat can be very cold.”可知冬天住在船屋里很冷。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why do many people choose to live on houseboats?
options: A. Because it is much cheaper to rent a houseboat than a flat.
B. Because they are looking for something special.
C. Because they are tired of living in flats.
questions.analysis: 347．细节理解题。根据“More families and young people are choosing to live on houseboats because it is much cheaper to buy or rent (租) a boat than a flat or a house.”可知因为购买或租赁船比公寓或房子便宜得多。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the last paragraph?
options: A. People living in houses like to tell stories.
B. People living in flats are not friendly.
C. People living on houseboats are kind.
questions.analysis: 348．推理判断题。根据“Another good thing about living on the water is the friendly neighbors. People who live on houseboats always help each other and usually become good friends.”（生活在水上的另一个好处是有友好的邻居。住在船屋上的人总是互相帮助，通常会成为好朋友。）可推知住在船屋里的人都很善良。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which one is not mentioned about learning English in paragraph 1?
options: A. Looking up new words in the dictionary.
B. Doing lots of English exercises.
questions.analysis: 349．细节理解题。根据“They have to read many passages, look up new words in the dictionary and do lots of exercises. ”可知D选项“写更多的短文”不包括在内，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What was Deng Qingming always doing after he was chosen as an astronaut trainee?
questions.analysis: 350．细节理解题。根据“Since that day, he had spent almost all of his time training hard to become an astronaut.”可知邓清明被选为宇航员实习生后一直在努力训练，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did Deng Qingming feel when he was always a backup?
questions.analysis: 351．细节理解题。根据“However, he was always a backup (后备人员) . He often felt sad. Sometimes, he even cried.”可知他很伤心，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many astronauts boarded the Shenzhou 15 spaceship and flew into space?
questions.analysis: 352．细节理解题。根据“he and two other astronauts boarded the Shenzhou 15 spaceship and flew into space.”可知他和另外两名航天员登上神舟十五号宇宙飞船，飞向太空，一共三个人，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the writer want to show by telling the story of Deng Qingming?
options: A. Don’t complain when you meet difficulties.
B. Don’t give up and keep going, you will succeed.
C. You’ll get good scores on tests if you work hard.
D. You’ll have to wait 24 years if you want to succeed.
questions.analysis: 353．推理判断题。根据“So, if you want to give up learning English (or something else), think about Deng’s story. Your efforts might not pay off immediately. Be patient, though. Try to improve your methods and keep going.”（所以，如果你想放弃学习英语(或其他东西)，想想邓的故事。你的努力可能不会立即得到回报。不过，要有耐心。试着改进你的方法并坚持下去。）可知作者通过讲述邓清明的故事告诉我们不要放弃，继续前进，最后一定会成功的。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Plants use ________ to communicate with animals all the time according to the study.
questions.analysis: 354．细节理解题。根据“Plants use sound to communicate with animals all the time”可知，植物一直用声音与动物交流，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “soundproof” mean?
questions.analysis: 355．词义猜测题。根据“They put sweet-pepper and tomato plants in soundproof boxes to shut off the noise in the environment”可知，把这两种植物放在能隔绝环境中的噪音的盒子里，由此可推断这个盒子是隔音的，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: A human adult’s ear can hear about ________.
questions.analysis: 356．细节理解题。根据“A human adult’s ear can hear about 16 kilohertz”可知，成年人的耳朵可以听到大约16千赫兹的声音，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the study, the untouched group of the plants produced the popping sound around ________.
questions.analysis: 357．细节理解题。根据“while the untouched group only produced around once per hour”可知，而未接触的那组每小时只产生一次，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: B. How to take care of your plants.
C. The team made machine-learning applications.
questions.analysis: 358．主旨大意题。根据“Plants can make sounds when they are stressed, according to a recent study”及全文的内容可知，本文主要介绍了根据研究证明，植物在受到压力时可以发出声音，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where do southern white rhinos mainly live?
questions.analysis: 359．细节理解题。根据“Southern white rhinos (犀牛) mainly live in Africa.”可知，南方白犀牛主要生活在非洲。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What colour are southern white rhinos?
questions.analysis: 360．细节理解题。根据“Southern white rhinos are not really white. They are grey in colour.”可知，南方白犀牛是灰色的。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “sensitive” probably mean in Paragraph 2?
questions.analysis: 361．词句猜测题。分析“Their skin (皮肤) is nearly 5 cm thick but is very sensitive. During the day, they try to find a cool place to avoid sunburn.”可知，南方白犀牛白天试图找一个凉爽的地方避免晒伤，它们的皮肤非常敏感，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why do your eyes make tears when you cut onions?

questions.analysis: 370．细节理解题。根据“When you cut into an onion, irritating (刺激性的) chemicals inside the onion will get into the air. They touch your whole eyes and cause pain. Your eyes make tears to wash away the chemicals and protect your eyes.”可知，当你切洋葱时，洋葱内部的刺激性化学物质会进入空气中。它们会触摸你的整个眼睛，引起疼痛。你的眼睛会分泌眼泪来洗掉化学物质，保护你的眼睛。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did Zhan understand other people before he was four?
options: A. By reading other people’s lips.
B. By learning at a training center.

D. By getting help from his parents.
questions.analysis: 6．细节理解题。根据“When he was 2, his parents took him to some training courses, and he learned to understand people by reading lips.”及“Zhan had an artificial cochlea implanted when he was 4 years old.”可知四岁才使用人工耳蜗，四岁之前是通过唇语来理解别人的。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What made him decide to learn to dance?
options: B. Taking part in the Olympics.
C. Getting help from his teachers.
D. Watching a dance show on TV.
questions.analysis: 7．细节理解题。根据“In the summer of 2008, Zhan watched a dance show of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva by the China Disabled People’s Performing Art Troupe at the closing ceremony of the Beijing 2008 Paralympic Games on TV. Deeply moved by their excellent skill and energy, he began to watch videos of performances and competitions, learned to copy the movements and dreamed of becoming a dancer like them.”可知他决定学习舞蹈是因为在电视上看了一场舞蹈表演。故选D。

questions.prompt: What can we inter (推断) from Paragraph Four?
options: A. What the feelings of the dancer were.
B. Why the teacher taught Zhan to dance.

D. More people will become interested in dancing.
questions.analysis: 8．推理判断题。根据“To help him keep up, his teacher repeatedly played the drum and told him where the beats and rhythm points were. Then, the teacher also guided him by using sign language. What’s more, as his artificial cochlea could easily fall out, he had to wear a headband to help keep it in.”可知为了帮助他跟上节奏，他的老师反复敲鼓，并告诉他节拍和节奏点在哪里。然后，老师还用手语指导他。更重要的是，由于他的人工耳蜗很容易脱落，他不得不戴上发带来帮助固定它。由此推出学跳舞对詹来说很难。故选C。

D. jumps into the sea from the pier

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do you think Aron is probably learning at his school?
options: A. Everyone is different and that’s a good thing.
B. Teamwork is important to achieve things in life.
C. It is important to know how to spend time alone.
D. It’s good to learn how to get on with people of different ages.
questions.analysis: 29．推理判断题。根据“But his mother is worried that Aron might get lonely.”及“That’s why there are so few children on the islands and why Aron has found himself being known as the loneliest schoolboy in Britain.”可知，艾伦是学校唯一一个学生，所以会感到孤单，所以他可能在学校要学着如何独处，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A. The smallest school in Britain.
B. The loneliest schoolboy in Britain.
C. Aron’s colorful life on the islands.
D. Mom’s worries about Aron’s future.
questions.analysis: 30．主旨大意题。根据“That’s why there are so few children on the islands and why Aron has found himself being known as the loneliest schoolboy in Britain.”及全文的描述可知，本文主要讲述了外斯克里群岛只有一个学生的学校，讲述了这种情况的原因，以及这位家长对孩子的担心，“英国最孤独的男生”最能概括本文的主旨大意，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What was the wife always thirsty for before her birthday?
options: C. All of her husband’s possessions.
questions.analysis: 31．细节理解题。根据“For many months, she had liked a beautiful ring, and knowing her husband could afford it, she told him that was all she wanted.”可知在妻子生日之前，她总是渴望一个美丽的戒指，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we infer (推断) from the underlined sentence?
options: A. The lady was satisfied with the dictionary.
B. The lady was thankful to her husband.
C. The lady was moved by what her husband said.
D. The lady felt angry after seeing the dictionary.
questions.analysis: 32．词句猜测题。根据“After that, she left him.”（之后，她离开了他。）结合妻子想要一个戒指而不是字典可知，这位女士看到字典后很生气。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What happened to the lady many years later?
questions.analysis: 33．细节理解题。根据“Many years passed and the lady was very successful in business”可知许多年过去了，这位女士在商业上非常成功。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did the wife want to go back to see her husband?
options: B. She wanted to get back the dictionary.
C. She knew her husband was dying.
D. She thought he was old.
questions.analysis: 34．细节理解题。根据“She realized her husband was very old, so she thought perhaps she should go to visit him.”可知她意识到她的丈夫已经很老了，所以她想去看望他。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we know from the text?
options: A. The husband was too poor to pay for the ring.
B. The husband loved his wife very much.
C. The lady left her husband because of her business.
D. The lady didn’t mind her husband’s death at all.
questions.analysis: 35．推理判断题。根据“With tears in her eyes, she opened it and began to turn the pages. A ring dropped from the dictionary to the floor and a card could be seen. She picked it up and found it was the ring she wanted in those days. And on the card was the date of her birth, and the words ‘LOVE YOU ALWAYS’.（她眼里含着泪水，打开书，开始翻页。一枚戒指从字典里掉到地上，露出一张卡片。她捡起来，发现这就是她当年想要的戒指。卡片上写着她的生日，还有“永远爱你”这几个字。）”可知丈夫很爱自己的妻子，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When did Rosie’s dad tell her stories?
questions.analysis: 36．细节理解题。根据“Her dad always told her stories before she fell asleep.”可知，她爸爸总是在她入睡前给她讲故事。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did Rosie feel sad that night?
options: A. Because her dad was ill.
B. Because her dad fell asleep.
C. Because her dad forgot to tell her stories.
D. Because her dad didn’t want to tell her stories.
questions.analysis: 37．细节理解题。根据“She felt sad. She didn’t want Dad to be sick, and she missed story time with Dad.”可知，她感到悲伤。她不想让爸爸生病，她错过了和爸爸一起讲故事的时间。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the meaning of the underlined word “miss” in Paragraph 4?
questions.analysis: 38．词句猜测题。根据“I’m sorry. I’m going to miss story time tonight.”可知，爸爸生病了不能给罗西讲故事，所以错过了故事时间，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What kind of story did Rosie tell her dad that night?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the last paragraph?

D. Rosie’s father didn’t enjoy story time.
questions.analysis: 40．细节理解题。根据“Dad loved the story and he fell asleep with a smile on his face.”可知，爸爸很喜欢这个故事，他面带微笑睡着了。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did the writer want to do before going abroad?

questions.prompt: The underlined word “option” has the similar meaning to ________.

questions.prompt: What does the writer think of his mom’s idea?

questions.prompt: The folding fans that the writer picked for the boys were made of ________.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: David glued the seashells to the frame to ________.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined phrase “that fact” refer to?
options: A. Many books are very interesting.
B. Many children can’t travel to any place.
C. Many children don’t like reading.
D. Many children have no books to read.
questions.analysis: 53．推理判断题。根据“Unfortunately, many children all over the world don’t have any books to read. Maria Keller, an American girl, wanted to change that fact.”可知，世界各地的许多孩子都没有书读，玛利亚想要改变这个事实，故划线部分指代“很多孩子没有书读”。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who helped Maria when she created Read Indeed?
questions.analysis: 54．细节理解题。根据“With her mother’s help, Maria created Read Indeed.”可知，当玛利亚创建Read Indeed时，妈妈帮助了她。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How old was Maria when she achieved her first goal?
questions.analysis: 55．细节理解题。根据“Maria set the first goal—to collect and give one million books. At the age of 18, she achieved this goal.”可知，玛利亚18岁时实现了第一个目标。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Maria’s new goal is to ________.
options: B. collect and give books to more kids
questions.analysis: 56．细节理解题。根据“She has recently set a new goal—to collect and give books to more kids in need in every state of the USA, and even other countries in the world.”可知，玛利亚的新目标是收集并且捐赠给更多的孩子书籍。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How do you like Maria Keller?
questions.analysis: 57．推理判断题。通读全文可知，本文主要介绍了美国女孩玛利亚成立了一个组织，用来帮助世界上没有书籍阅读的孩子，故可知她是乐于助人的。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In the second paragraph (段落), the two teachers share knowledge by ________.
questions.analysis: 58．细节理解题。根据“Two retired (退休的) teachers are well-known for making short videos. They make them to share knowledge.”可知，两位退休教师以制作短视频而闻名，来分享知识。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined phrase (画线短语) “be curious about” in Paragraph 3 means “________”.
questions.analysis: 59．词句猜测题。分析“She is good at using everyday tools to experience the magical world of science. She wants young people to be curious about daily life. In this way, young people enjoy finding out the knowledge of science hidden in our life.”可知，她善于用日常的工具去体验科学的神奇世界，通过这种方式，年轻人喜欢发现隐藏在我们生活中的科学知识。由此推知，是想让年轻人对日常生活感兴趣，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to Paragraph 3 and Paragraph 4, their videos are about ________.
questions.analysis: 60．细节理解题。根据“In this way, young people enjoy finding out the knowledge of science hidden in our life.”和“During the past two years, he has used his videos to share his knowledge of the sea.”可知，二人分享的视频都是关于科学方面的，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: We can know that the two teachers are both ________ from the passage.
questions.analysis: 61．细节理解题。根据“Wu is more than 70 years old now but still works hard.”和“Wang Pinxian is an 87-year-old marine geologist (海洋地质学家) and teacher at Tongji University.”可知，二人都超过70岁，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The main idea of the passage is that ________.
options: A. short videos can help people relax and kill the time
B. how the two old people create real energy to society
C. lots of old people enjoy the knowledge of science
D. how physics experiments can solve daily problems
questions.analysis: 62．主旨大意题。本文主要介绍两位退休教师制作短视频在网上分享知识，结合“The two gray-haired people have created real energy(能量) to society through their actions.”可知，这两位白发苍苍的老人通过自己的行动为社会创造了实实在在的能量。故选B

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “it” mean in Paragraph 2?
questions.analysis: 63．词义猜测题。根据“He dreamed of being the youngest person to enter university, and he sent letters to famous professors (教授) to see if it was possible.”可知，他梦想成为最年轻的上大学的人，他写信给著名的教授，看看这是否可能，所以it是指代“尽早进入大学”，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do Professor Rosen’s words mean in Paragraph 5?
options: A. It’s good for Tom to share new ideas with his teachers.
B. It’s important for Tom to remember what he’s learnt.
C. It’s necessary for Tom to realise what his problem is.
D. It’s helpful for Tom to know the differences among people.
questions.analysis: 64．推理判断题。根据“It’s filled with people. And you have to remember to be what you are … a boy. Boys need to have fun”可知，教授意识到Tom没有朋友，所以让Tom明白这个世界不只是充满了想法，还有人，了解人与人之间的差异是有帮助的，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did Professor Rosen set the first test for Tom according to the text?
options: A. To improve Tom’s testing skills.

questions.prompt: Which can best take the place of “________” in the third paragraph?

B. He thought the drivers were rich.
C. He was a successful film star.
questions.analysis: 74．推理判断题。根据“He only asked for some change from passing drivers, and then he gave the driver a free copy of the newspaper he bought. Each time he asked for money, he was always smiling and also told jokes to the drivers.”可知，他只是向路过的司机要了些零钱，然后给了司机一份他买的免费报纸。每次要钱的时候，他总是面带微笑，还会给司机讲笑话。所以他的乞讨方式很特殊，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.analysis: 75．细节理解题。根据“The drivers thought him kind and humorous, so they never let him go empty-handed.”可知，他非常友好和幽默。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the passage?

questions.analysis: 76．推理判断题。根据最后一段内容可知，Irwin Corey实际上很富有。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What was the author’s first impression of the short man?

B. He was an experienced driver.
C. He wasn’t good at running.
D. He was too proud of himself.
questions.analysis: 77．细节理解题。根据“One day, a short man came. He didn’t look like much of a runner.”可知作者对这个矮个子男人的第一印象是他不善于跑步。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What happened to the author when he slowed down?

B. His foot didn’t hurt any more.

D. He started to have a pain in his foot.
questions.analysis: 78．细节理解题。根据“After two laps, my foot began to hurt, so I had to slow down and began to run at my usual speed. This time I could breathe again without sounding like I had a lung disease and the pain in my foot went away.”可知放慢速度以后作者的脚不再疼了。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “capacity” probably mean?
questions.analysis: 79．词义猜测题。根据“In life, there will always be those slower and faster. Some have natural talent, and some have trained harder. Don’t judge the capacity of a person by how he or she looks.”可知生活中人们有快有慢，有的有天赋而有的训练更努力，不要以长相来判断一个人的能力，capacity与ability意思相近。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which can be the best title for the text?
questions.analysis: 80．标题归纳题。本文通过作者跑步时的亲身经历告诉我们：我们每个人都有自己的速度。当你应该慢速跑的时候，不要跑得快。当你应该走的时候，不要跑。该跑的时候不要走。用“Enjoy your own speed”做标题最合适。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the beginning of the story tell us about Amy?
options: A. She didn’t want to play the game.
B. She was a new student in her class.
C. She was a member of the Red Team.
D. She didn’t understand the game rules.
questions.analysis: 81．推理判断题。根据“This was her first chance to make new friends, and she was nervous.”以及“So far Amy hadn’t given any useful suggestions—after all, she was totally new to this town.”可推断艾米是班里的新学生。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did Amy smile at the end of the story?
options: A. Her team came in first.
B. She was accepted as a friend.
C. She no longer felt nervous.
D. There would be a game soon.
questions.analysis: 84．推理判断题。根据“‘So…close…’ Tyler made a face, and they all laughed together.”以及“I hope we’ll be on the same team soon.”可知，艾米在故事的结尾笑了是因为她被当作朋友接受了。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What was the writer’s life like before he was seriously ill?

B. He liked reading very much.
C. He used to play football every day.
D. He played basketball with friends.
questions.analysis: 85．细节理解题。根据“I used to play football until dark every day.”可知，过去天天踢足球，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What information can we get from the passage?
options: A. The writer got well slowly.
B. His father is good at telling stories.
C. His mother is strict and never looks after him.
D. The writer didn’t want to stay in the hospital
questions.analysis: 86．细节理解题。根据“My father was a talented storyteller.”可知，爸爸是一个有天赋的讲故事的人，也就是他擅长讲故事，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did the writer’s father give him a book?
options: A. His father didn’t like the book.
B. His father thought he was well then.
C. His father didn’t like telling stories any more.
D. His father wanted to encourage him to read by himself.
questions.analysis: 87．推理判断题。根据“You are already eight and can read by yourself”可知，爸爸给作者一本书是为了鼓励作者自己读书，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following can be the best title of the passage?
questions.analysis: 88．最佳标题题。通读全文可知，本文主要讲述了作者从最开始对足球疯狂热爱到最后转变成一个好奇的读者，介绍了他如何爱上阅读的经历，所以最适合本文标题的是：我与阅读的邂逅，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What first made Wang decide to try knife painting?
questions.analysis: 89．细节理解题。根据“In 1995, Wang got the idea by chance when she cut a piece of red paper using a knife and it left a white line.”可知，在一次偶然的机会中，王静萌生了这个想法，她用刀在一张红纸上划了一道白线，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How can knife painting be done?
options: A. By drawing on paper with a pencil.
B. By creating shapes with brushes.
C. By cutting the paper with a knife.
D. By pressing on the coated paper.
questions.analysis: 90．细节理解题。根据“People usually ‘add’ colors to create paintings, but knife painters use knives to “take away” colors on specially made coated paper. They use different pressure on the paper in different directions (方向) to create different colors.”可知，他们用不同的压力在铜版纸上不同的方向来创造不同的颜色。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can be learned from paragraph 3?
options: A. Wang hadn’t expected knife painting to be popular.
B. Wang continued her work because of her family.
C. Wang’s favorite painting work is 28 meters long.
D. Wang said she might stop her work in the near future.
questions.analysis: 91．细节理解题。根据“Besides, Wang herself was not expecting to make it something big at the beginning”可知，王自己一开始也没有想过要做大，也就是她并没有想过纸上刀绘能这么受欢迎，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following sentences can best describe Wang?
options: A. Kill two birds with one stone.
B. Where there’s a will, there’s a way.
C. Two heads are better than one.
D. When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
questions.analysis: 92．推理判断题。根据“But thanks to her love for the art form, she has kept painting for the past 27 years. So far, she has completed hundreds of paintings, and her favorite is a 2.8-meter-long painting. Wang said she would continue working in the field and make it known across the world”可知，由于她对艺术形式的热爱，她在过去的27年里一直在画画，她将继续在这片土地上工作，让它闻名世界，也就是对艺术的热爱和对这个艺术的执着让她变得成功，“有志者事竟成”最能形容她的精神，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many runners took part in 26 marathon events nationwide on April 26? ________

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did Xu Qian run 30 to 40 kilometers each week ahead of the run? ________
options: A. He wanted to help more runners.
B. He had nothing to do but run.
C. His father wanted him to do so.
D. He trained in preparation for the race.
questions.analysis: 99．细节理解题。根据“For Xu, the race meant months of training and preparation. He ran about 30 to 40 kilometers each week ahead of the run.”可知，他为准备比赛而训练。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following best explains the underlined word “endurance” in Paragraph 2? ________

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the story?
options: A. We shouldn’t be afraid of making friends.

questions.analysis: 112．推理判断题。通读全文可知，本文主要通过讲述公主和青蛙的故事告诉我们信守承诺的重要性，故选D。

questions.prompt: Peng started to learn the guzheng ________.
questions.analysis: 113．推理判断题。根据“Born in 1995, Peng began to learn the guzheng when she was seven years old.”可知，彭静璇出生于1995年，在7岁开始学习古筝，因此是在2002年。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did Peng decide to play the guzheng on the streets in Paris?
options: A. Because she needed to make money for her education.
B. Because she wanted to become famous.
C. Because she found few people there knew about Chinese music.
D. Because she wanted to make videos to post online.
questions.analysis: 114．细节理解题。根据“After arriving in France in late 2017, she saw many people do street performances, but few of them knew about Chinese music. So she decided to play the guzheng on the streets.”可知，她在2017年底到法国后，看到很多人在街头表演，但很少有人了解中国音乐。所以她决定在街上弹古筝。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the book that Peng carries about?
questions.analysis: 116．细节理解题。根据“Peng now carries a book that explains the instrument to foreigners.”可知，彭现在带着一本向外国人解释古筝这种乐器的书。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When Lulu first watched Peking Opera, she found the outfits and movements were ________.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Lulu practices Peking Opera ________ a week in the group.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Lulu had trouble with the way of singing at first because ________.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.analysis: 122．推理判断题。根据“I hope to share my love for Peking Opera with more people outside China.”可知，Lulu将来会把京剧介绍给更多的外国人。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The king was unhappy because he ________ too much.
questions.analysis: 123．细节理解题。根据“Once upon a time, there was a king. He always worried about what might happen in the future.”可知国王很不高兴，因为他太担心自己的未来了。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The king followed the cobbler home to find out ________.
questions.analysis: 124．细节理解题。根据“How could he smile so brightly? The king decided to find out.”可知国王跟着修鞋匠回家，想知道他快乐的原因。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined (画线的) word “permit” means “________”.
questions.analysis: 125．词义猜测题。根据“But he wondered what would happen if the cobbler couldn’t make enough money.”可知国王想知道，如果修鞋匠赚不到足够的钱，会发生什么。所以他不允许任何人来修鞋，permit和allow同义，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The cobbler got the money by ________ when nobody repaired shoes that day.
questions.analysis: 126．细节理解题。根据“When he saw some villagers trying to carry water home, he helped them and got coins from them.”可知那天没人修鞋，修鞋匠通过帮助村民挣到钱。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The passage tells us that we should _________.
questions.analysis: 127．主旨大意题。根据“I have faith (信心). Everything will be fine.”以及通读全文可知，本文通过国王决定找出修鞋匠快乐的答案告诉我们应该对自己有信心，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined word “annoyed” in Paragraph 1 means “_________”.
questions.analysis: 128．词义猜测题。根据“Our neighbors often talked about our faults because sometimes the ball hit the cars or broke the street lights, most of the time we shouted too loudly and made them annoyed.”可知，因为作者他们大声喊叫，使邻居们很恼火，所以单词“annoyed”指的是“恼火的”，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How often did they play together?
questions.analysis: 129．细节理解题。根据“We played every day from about 4 p.m. to 6 p.m..”可知，作者他们每天都在一起玩，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: They stopped playing after some years because _________.
questions.analysis: 130．细节理解题。根据“A few years later, we stopped playing because we grew up.”可知，几年后，我们不再玩了，因为我们长大了，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Jack ________ for the celebration of his school’s 75th birthday.
questions.analysis: 131．细节理解题。根据“When I was in Grade Eight, our school celebrated its 75th birthday. I was asked to make videos for the celebration.”可知，杰克为学校75岁生日的庆祝活动制作了视频。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Lucy’s dancing team won many prizes because of ________.
questions.analysis: 132．细节理解题。根据“Thanks to all our hard work, we have won many prizes.”可知，露西的舞蹈队由于努力工作赢得了许多奖项。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Kate’s class held a charity sale to help ________.
options: B. old people in her city
questions.analysis: 133．细节理解题。根据“Our class needed to buy things and sell them, then give away all the money we made to children in some poor areas.”可知，凯特的班级举行了一场慈善义卖来帮助贫困地区的孩子们。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following sentences is TRUE according to the passage?
options: A. Jack took photos in the evening.
B. Lucy won many prizes in singing.
C. Kate sold soft toys to make money.
D. The three students are in Grade Eight.
questions.analysis: 134．细节理解题。根据“The things we bought were some soft toys and key rings with animal pictures”可知，凯特靠卖毛绒玩具和带有动物图片的钥匙圈赚钱。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the best title (标题) of the passage?
questions.analysis: 135．最佳标题题。根据“During the last three years, what was your highlight (高光时刻) of middle school? Some students in our school were invited to share their stories.”可知，本文介绍了学校的一些学生分享他们高光时刻的故事，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is talked about in Chen Zhou’s speeches?
options: A. His dream of climbing more mountains.
B. His pleasure of singing in the street.
C. His journey visiting cities and climbing mountains.
D. How he made a living by climbing over 100 mountains.
questions.analysis: 136．细节理解题。根据“Chen Zhou gives popular inspirational （激励的） speeches around the world. He talks about his journey visiting over 700 of China’s cities and climbing over 100 mountains.”可知陈州演讲是关于他访问了中国700多个城市，爬了100多座山的旅行的。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did Chen Zhou lose his legs?
options: A. He was born without legs.
B. He lost them in a train accident.
C. He was hurt in a car accident.
D. He lost them because of a disease.
questions.analysis: 137．细节理解题。根据“One day, while riding a train he realized he was going in the wrong direction and jumped of the train. Chen’s legs were cut off.”可知有一天，当他坐火车时，他意识到他走错了方向，于是跳了下来，腿被切断了。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When did Chen meet his wife?
options: A. While he was working as a street musician.
B. When he was interviewed by Ability Magazine.
C. When he was attending somebody’s wedding.
D. While he was climbing China’s Five Sacred Mountains.
questions.analysis: 138．细节理解题。根据“Chen started to sing in the street. It was there that he met the woman who would become his wife.”可知陈州街头卖唱时，遇到了自己的妻子。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the last paragraph mainly about?
options: A. It is very important to have big dreams.
B. Chen Zhou is not the only poor one in the world.
C. Chen Zhou inspires people to get over difficulties.
D. Special people can also make great achievements.
questions.analysis: 139．主旨大意题。根据“Chen has become a true inspiration for people.”可知最后一段介绍了陈州对他人的影响。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which word can best describe Chen Zhou?
questions.analysis: 140．推理判断题。根据“He gets around and climbs mountains with his hands in wooden boxes.”和“He talks about his journey visiting over 700 of China’s cities and climbing over 100 mountains.”可知陈州没有双腿，却过了不平凡的生活，走过700多个城市，攀登过100多座山，这样的人应该有坚强的意志。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which word best describes Mrs. Brown’s morning?
questions.analysis: 141．细节理解题。根据“Every day she gets up at six o’clock in the morning and then starts her work: water the plants, clean the yard, take out the rubbish, and pick some vegetables from the garden for lunch,..., a lot of work to do! ”可知，早上布朗太太有很多事做，应是很忙，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many people are there in Mrs. Brown’s family?
questions.analysis: 142．细节理解题。根据“Tom!”、“Mr. Brown”和“Mrs. Brown”可知，他们家一共3个人，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is Mr. Brown doing this morning?
options: A. Preparing for his wife’s birthday.
B. Taking care of the animals.
C. Making breakfast for his family.
questions.analysis: 143．细节理解题。根据“Today’s breakfast is cake. Birthday cake!”可知，布朗先生早上在为妻子的生日做准备。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which can be the best title for the text?
questions.analysis: 144．标题归纳题。本文讲述了布朗太太今天回家后，发现一切都不同寻常，很奇怪，最后发现竟是大家给她的生日惊喜。全文多次出现“That’s strange”，所以C项“That’s Strange”最适合做标题，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Seba wanted _______ for his third birthday.
questions.analysis: 145．细节理解题。根据“Before he turned three, his parents asked him what he wanted for his birthday. ‘Drums!’ he answered. ”可知，Seba想要鼓作为他的三岁生日礼物。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE?
options: A. Seba grew upset because he couldn’t learn from Mr. Copeland.
B. Seba started a band when he was in the first grade.
C. Seba got a professional certificate in music from Berklee at the age of ten.
questions.analysis: 146．细节理解题。根据“When he was only 10 years old, Seba became the youngest person ever to receive a professional certificate(证书) in music from Berklee. ”可知，Seba在10岁的时候获得了伯克利的音乐专业证书。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The writer organizes the passage according to _______.
questions.analysis: 147．推理判断题。根据全文可知，文章首先讲述了Seba三岁的生日礼物是鼓，之后又上架子鼓课，四岁后开始学习更多的音乐，然后他可以参加许多演出，10岁时获得了伯克利的音乐专业证书，所以文章是根据时间线组织文章，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the passage, we know that _______.
options: A. interest and practice made Seba succeed
B. a famous teacher helped Seba succeed
C. family’s support was the most important for Seba’s success
questions.analysis: 148．推理判断题。根据“So his parents bought him a professional drum kit and sent him to have drum lessons.”以及“Seba’s parents encouraged him to learn more music.”可知，在Seba学习音乐以及获得成功的路上少不了父母的大力支持，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What was the penguin like when Joao first met him?
options: A. He was tiny and sick.
B. He was strong and healthy.
C. He had clean and beautiful feathers.
questions.analysis: 149．细节理解题。根据“The penguin’s feathers(羽毛) were covered in oil. The poor bird was dying. Joao felt sorry for the sick, little bird, and so he took him back to his home.”可知当时这只企鹅又小又病。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When the penguin became healthy after a week or two, what did he do?
options: A. He still stayed with Joao.
B. He returned to his penguin family.
C. He walked sadly on the beach every day.
questions.analysis: 150．细节理解题。根据“After a week or two, Joao went down to the coast and tried to put Din dim back into the water. The penguin didn’t want to go. He stayed with Joao”可知当企鹅在一两个星期后恢复健康时，他仍然和Joao在一起。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How might Joao feel when he suddenly heard a familiar sound?
questions.analysis: 151．推理判断题。根据“Then suddenly, one day in February, Din dim disappeared. Joao was sad to lose him”可知当Joao发现Din dim消失了，他很伤心，所以四个多月过去了，当他听到一声熟悉的声音时，他很激动，也很开心，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why does the penguin swim to Brazil every year?
options: A. To star this penguin family.
B. To look for more delicious food.
C. To visit the man who saved his life.
questions.analysis: 153．细节理解题。根据“That’s 5, 000 miles a year to be with the man who saved his life.”可知企鹅是为了去看望救了他一命的人。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How was Xu Mengtao’s childhood?
questions.analysis: 154．细节理解题。根据“Xu Mengtao had a hard childhood”可知，徐梦桃的童年很艰苦，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we know about Xu Mengtao’s father according to the text?
options: A. Her father won a gold medal.
B. Her father built a large gym.
C. Her father loves sports a lot.
questions.analysis: 155．细节理解题。根据“After making his first money, her sports-loving father bought a television set.”可知，徐梦桃的父亲热爱运动，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When did Xu Mengtao begin to learn gymnastics?
questions.analysis: 156．推理判断题。根据“Born in 1991 in Anshan”和“Xu began to learn gymnastics(体操) when she was only 4 years old.”可知，徐出生于1991年，在4岁的时候就开始学习体操，即1995年。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined phrase “peaks and valleys” in Paragraph 4 probably mean?
questions.analysis: 157．词句猜测题。分析“Finishing sixth in her first Olympics at Vancouver 2010, Xu won the second place at Sochi 2014. Then 2018 seemed to be her time to win gold. But she finished ninth. After so many peaks and valleys, Xu finally realized her dream of winning Olympic gold in the freestyle skiing women’s aerials event(自由式滑雪女子空中技巧) at Beijing 2022.”可知，介绍了徐梦桃波折的夺冠之路，所以“peaks and valleys”的意思是“起伏”，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the writer have in the new home?________
questions.analysis: 158．细节理解题。根据“We’re living in a really simple house which has a nice vegetable garden”可知有一个蔬菜园。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How do the writer and Kim go to town?________
questions.analysis: 159．细节理解题。根据“we always walk here”可知他们走路去。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where is the writer writing this article?________
questions.analysis: 160．细节理解题。根据“I’m using the computer in the library at the moment, to check my email and to write to you”可知是在图书馆里写的这篇文章。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes their new lifestyle?________
questions.analysis: 161．推理判断题。根据“We’re living in a really simple house”以及“We have a simple breakfast”并结合文章的描述可知他们的生活非常简单；根据“We pick vegetables in the garden”以及“We go to bed early”可知他们吃菜园里的蔬菜，而且睡觉很早，可见他们的生活很健康。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where was Ya Ya born？
questions.analysis: 162．细节理解题。根据“When Ya Ya was born in the Beijing Zoo”可知，丫丫出生在北京动物园。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When did Ya Ya come back to China?
questions.analysis: 163．细节理解题。根据“On April 27, Ya Ya returned to China after staying for 20 years in America.”及“she was taken to the Memphis Zoo in Tennessee in 2003.”可知，丫丫2003年去美国，20年后即2023年回到中国。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The Beijing Zoo has prepared something special for Ya Ya except ________.
options: C. a research and protection plan
questions.analysis: 164．细节理解题。根据“The Beijing Zoo has prepared a special feeding place for Ya Ya as well as feeding plans, care and medical support”可知动物园准备了特别的喂养地方，以及喂养计划，还有医疗支持。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: People are not allowed to visit Ya Ya because ________.
options: A. she is taken to the Memphis Zoo
B. she is quarantined in the Shanghai Zoo
C. her health condition becomes better
D. she needs to rest and adapt to the new environment
questions.analysis: 165．细节理解题。根据“As she is old, she needs to rest and adapt(适应) to the new environment.”可知她需要时间来适应环境，故选D。

questions.prompt: Where can you most probably read the article?

questions.prompt: What would happen to Grandpa according to the doctor?

B. He might not judge things correctly.

questions.prompt: Which of the following could best describe Grant?
questions.analysis: 178．推理判断题。根据“Grant—believed to have planted seven million trees in 40 years. Once he got caught in a rockslide and broke his back. It took him years to recover, but he came back stronger than ever. His passion (热爱) for the job reminds me of what I love about it.”（据信，格兰特在40年里种了700万棵树。有一次他被困在岩石滑坡中，摔断了背。他花了好几年才康复，但他回来后比以前更强壮了。他对这份工作的热情让我想起了我喜欢这份工作的地方。）可推断出，格兰特是一个意志坚强的人，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined part in the last paragraph probably mean?
options: A. You need to be yourself.
B. You can be more careful.
C. You should be thankful for what you own.
D. You should take your bed with you next time.
questions.analysis: 179．词句猜测题。根据“And after sleeping in a tent all summer, you learn never to take your bed for granted.”可知，在帐篷里睡了一整个夏天之后，你学会了永远不要把自己的床视为理所当然。结合“So value what you have had and face the challenges in your life with great passion.”可知，要珍惜你所拥有的，并以极大的热情面对生活中的挑战。故选C。
