questions.prompt: How did the writer feel when his roommate thanked him?
questions.analysis: 214．细节理解题。根据“But I felt quite shy when he said thanks to me.”可知室友感谢作者的时候，作者感到很害羞。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why didn’t the writer often say thanks to his roommate?
options: A. Because he never said thanks.
B. Because he thought real friends needn’t say thanks.
C. Because he thought the help was too little to say thanks.
D. Because he thought saying thanks made him embarrassed.
questions.analysis: 215．细节理解题。根据“Perhaps we don’t have to say thanks to each other so often because we have become real friends.”可知作者不常对室友说感谢是因为他认为真正的朋友不必说谢谢。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What changed the writer’s attitude towards saying thanks?
options: A. The advice of the teacher.
B. The help of his roommate.
C. The influence of his parents.
D. The thanks from the little kids.
questions.analysis: 216．细节理解题。根据“My attitude(态度) towards saying thanks didn’t change until I helped a group of kids.”可知来自小孩们的感谢让作者改变了自己对说谢谢的态度。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In which order is the text written?
questions.analysis: 217．推理判断题。本文通过作者的经历讲述了作者对是否需要表达谢意的观点的转变，是以时间顺序来写的。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the best title for the text?
questions.analysis: 218．标题归纳题。本文通过作者的经历讲述了作者对是否需要表达谢意的观点的转变。最终作者认为应该勇敢表达感谢，用“Say thank you aloud.”做标题最合适。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did the woman do on the mountain?
options: A. She wanted to visit her friend.
B. She found a basket full of gold.
C. She looked for her lost bird.
questions.analysis: 219．细节理解题。根据“The woman was sad and went out to look for it on the mountain near her home.”可知女士在山上寻找丢失的鸟。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The woman went back home alone because ________.
options: A. she found the bird lived well
B. the bird gave her a basket
C. the bird didn’t like her
D. her husband asked her to do that
questions.analysis: 220．细节理解题。根据“She found it lived well with many other birds. So she decided to go back home alone.”可知女士独自回家，是因为发现这只鸟生活得很好。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did the woman’s husband go to the bird’s home?
options: A. Because he loved the bird.
B. Because he wanted to bring the bird home.
C. Because he wanted more baskets.
D. Because he wanted more gold.
questions.analysis: 221．细节理解题。根据“The man was very greedy (贪婪的) and he went to the bird’s home, too.”可知女士的丈夫去小鸟的家，是因为想获得更多的金子。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE about the woman’s husband?
options: A. He got two baskets from the bird.
B. He missed the bird very much.
C. He got lots of gold at last.
D. He didn’t treat the bird well.
questions.analysis: 222．推理判断题。根据“cried the man falsely (虚伪地). In fact, he used to treat the bird badly. The bird said nothing.”可推知女士的丈夫过去对待这只鸟并不好。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the story mainly want to tell us?
options: A. We should try our best to keep more birds.
B. Be kind to others and don’t be greedy.
C. Kind people can get everything they want.
D. We can get lots of gold if we are friendly to birds.
questions.analysis: 223．主旨大意题。本文通过鸟对女士和她丈夫的不同回报，告诉我们：我们善待别人，别人也会善待我们。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “recognized” in paragraph 1 probably mean?
questions.analysis: 224．词句猜测题。根据“He has been recognized as the oldest male to surf（冲浪）by the Guinness World Records.”可知，他被吉尼斯世界纪录认定为年龄最大的男性冲浪者。recognized意为“认定”，与accepted同义。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Paragraph 3 mainly tells us ________.
options: A. where Sano learnt to surf
C. how Sano planned to surf
questions.analysis: 225．段落大意题。根据“His secret to keep healthy and energetic, he said, was surfing. So, Sano found a teacher.”可知，第三段讲述他尝试去冲浪的原因。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the words of the young students and Sano’s surf teacher, we can infer ________.
options: A. they respect Sano very much
B. Sano’s age influences his surfing
C. they’re worried about Sano’s work
D. Sano is often hurt when practising
questions.analysis: 226．推理判断题。根据“I think age doesn’t matter in surfing”和“To be honest, I was surprised by his age”可知，师生们很佩服他冲浪没有受到年龄的限制，可推测他们都很尊重他。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, we know Sano ________.
options: A. is too old to start surfing
D. enjoys a lot from surfing
questions.analysis: 227．推理判断题。根据“Surfing helps make him less stressed. ‘People often say that surfing is life itself,’ he said. ‘I think it is true.’”可知，冲浪有助于减轻他的压力。他认同“冲浪就是生活本身”这种说法，说明他很喜欢冲浪。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Ya Ya had lived in U.S. for ________ years.
questions.analysis: 32．细节理解题。根据“after 20 years of stay at the Memphis Zoo in the U.S.”可知大熊猫“丫丫”在美国待了20年。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Ya Ya was born in ________.
questions.analysis: 33．细节理解题。根据“Ya Ya was born at Beijing Zoo on August 3, 2000.”可知“丫丫”出生在北京。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What color are new-born pandas?
questions.analysis: 34．细节理解题。根据图片中内容“Baby pandas are born pink...”可知熊猫宝宝出生时是粉红色的。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
options: A. Ya Ya is still a young panda now.
B. Shanghai Zoo is Ya Ya’s final home.
C. Ya Ya had a short flight coming back home.
D. Ya Ya helps foreigners know more about China.
questions.analysis: 35．细节理解题。根据“YaYa has become a bridge of friendship between Chinese and foreign people. (丫丫已经成为中外人民友谊的桥梁。)”可知“丫丫”帮助外国人更多地了解中国。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: This passage is ________.
questions.analysis: 36．细节理解题。根据标题“Daily News”可知，最有可能新闻上看到本篇文章。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In which section of the newspaper can we read the news?
questions.analysis: 37．推理判断题。本文主要介绍了三个有关考古的新闻，故文章可能出现在报纸的历史版面。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Those dinosaur prints were found ________.
questions.analysis: 38．细节理解题。根据“A diner eating in a restaurant’s outdoor yard, in Sichuan Province, has discovered dinosaur footprints on the ground”可知四川省一家餐馆的户外院子里，一名食客在地上发现了恐龙脚印。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The best heading for the second piece of news would be ________.
options: B. Dig and Discover the World
questions.analysis: 39．最佳标题题。通读全段内容可知，本段主要介绍了在挖掘中发现旧遗骸的快乐，故以选项B“挖掘并发现世界”为标题最合适。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Professor Luis finds the mural very valuable mainly because ________.
options: A. it’s connected to ancient society
B. it shows the birth of the mural
C. it’s the world’s earliest wall painting
D. it has a very large size
questions.analysis: 40．细节理解题。根据“The 30-meter mural shows mysterious scenes, which could reflect what the life was like in ancient Peru”可知这幅30米长的壁画展示了神秘的场景，可以反映出古代秘鲁的生活，所以它非常有价值。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: All the news above ________.
options: D. says hello to the past
questions.analysis: 41．推理判断题。根据“scientists made sure that the footprints are 100 million years old”“it is a fascinating way to uncover old remains”以及“reflect what the life was like in ancient Peru”可知这三个新闻都和考古有关，它们都和过去的事物有关。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which passages are about environmental protection?
questions.analysis: 47．细节理解题。根据“Locals Care for Natural World”和“Scientists Fight against Plastic Pollution”可知，a和e两则新闻与环境保护有关，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When did China probably begin to develop seeds in space?
questions.analysis: 48．推理判断题。根据“For nearly 40 years, China has developed over 260 new types of seeds (种子) in space.”可知，近40年来，中国在太空开发了260多种新型种子。由此可知，中国可能是20世纪80年代开始开发太空种子的。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word it in Passage c refer to?
questions.analysis: 49．推理判断题。根据“Doctors are flying to an island off the coast of West Africa after a new flu broke out. They will test different medicines to find a way to deal with it.”可知，在一场新的流感爆发后，医生们正飞往西非海岸附近的一个岛屿。他们将测试不同的药物来找到治疗它的方法。此处it指的是新的流感，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which is the best title for ________?
options: B. The World Saving Lives in Quake
C. Terrible Situation Faced by Turkey
questions.analysis: 50．最佳标题题。分析“A strong earthquake hit Turkey on February 6. More than 8,000 international rescuers (救援人员) around the world went to help, including the Blue Sky Rescue Team from China. They helped save lives and rebuild homes.”可知，本则新闻介绍土耳其发生强烈地震，来自世界各地的8000多名国际救援人员前往救援，其中包括来自中国的蓝天救援队。他们帮助拯救生命，重建家园。选项B“世界在地震中拯救生命”最适合作本则新闻的标题，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the theme shared by all the passages?
questions.analysis: 51．主旨大意题。分析几则新闻内容可知，均与“问题和为此做出的努力”相关。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does Jing Haipeng do?
questions.analysis: 52．细节理解题。根据“Jing Haipeng, one of the astronauts for the Shenzhou-16 manned spaceflight mission”可知，景海鹏是神舟十六号载人航天飞行任务的宇航员之一。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where are some of the teenagers mentioned from?
options: D. Nigeria, South America and Madagascar.
questions.analysis: 53．细节理解题。根据“These paintings were beautifully drawn by teenagers from 10 African countries including Algeria, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Egypt, Madagascar, Mali, Mauritius, Nigeria, Somalia, South Africa and Zimbabwe.”可知，这些画作由来自阿尔及利亚、刚果民主共和国、埃及、马达加斯加、马里、毛里求斯、尼日利亚、索马里、南非和津巴布韦等10个非洲国家的青少年绘制而成。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did Jing Haipeng think of these paintings?
questions.analysis: 54．推理判断题。根据“these excellent works are from the winners of ‘Tianhe Award’ for young friends from the 10 African countries”可知，景认为这些是优秀的作品，说明他认为这些画作都很精彩。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is true?
options: A. The paintings were chosen from Chinese teenagers.
B. The paintings have not been shown before in space.
C. Jing Haipeng has seen the paintings when interviewed.
D. The winners of “Tianhe Award” can get a space ticket.
questions.analysis: 55．细节理解题。根据“It’s reported that Shenzhou-16 will bring international paintings by teenagers from 10 African countries to the China Space Station.”和“At present, we have not seen the paintings.”可知，这些画作将由神州16号的宇航员带到中国空间站，而目前，我们都没有见过这些画。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the main theme of the passage?
questions.analysis: 56．主旨大意题。根据“We look forward to joining hands with all peace-loving people to create a better tomorrow”可知，景希望，我们期待着与所有爱好和平的人们携手创造更美好的明天。由此可知，本文的主题是和平与友谊。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题14 阅读理解 考点4 议论文和新闻报道（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The meaning of the underlined word “launched” in the first paragraph is the closest to “________”.
questions.analysis: 1．词义猜测题。根据第二段“For years, China has been working hard to create its own space station. Last year, China began to launch three modules(舱) of Tiangong space station, one at a time.”可知多年来，中国一直在努力建设自己的空间站。去年，中国应该是开始发射天宫空间站的三个模块，一次一个，所以第一段的launched表示“发射”，和sent up近义，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which module is the astronauts’ living area in?
questions.analysis: 2．细节理解题。根据“The main module, Tianhe, was launched in April 2021. It holds the power source and main controls for the station, as well as the astronauts’ living area.”可知宇航员的生活区在天河舱，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When was China’s largest spacecraft launched?
questions.analysis: 3．细节理解题。根据“In July 2022, China launched its first laboratory module, Wentian, which is the country’s largest ever spacecraft.”可知2022年7月，中国发射了有史以来最大的航天器。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is TRUE?
options: A. No more modules can be docked with Tiangong in the future.
B. Chang’e 5 probe brought moon rocks back to the earth in 2020.
C. China created Tiangong space station together with European Space Agency.
D. Chinese astronauts can’t use robotic arms to run experiments from inside Tiangong.
questions.analysis: 4．细节理解题。根据“In 2020, for example, its Chang’e 5 probe returned to the earth carrying moon’ rocks.”可知2020年，嫦娥五号探测器将月球岩石带回了地球。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How high can squirrels jump?
questions.analysis: 13．细节理解题。根据“They can jump up to 6 meters in height”可知松鼠可以跳到6米高，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do squirrels have?
questions.analysis: 14．细节理解题。根据“They are known for their long tails, big teeth, and the ability to climb trees.”可知松鼠有大牙齿，故选B。

questions.prompt: Why do squirrels keep nuts in the ground?

questions.prompt: In which part of a magazine can you probably read this passage?

questions.prompt: What does the writer think of making yogurt?

questions.prompt: What is the first step to make yogurt?
options: A. Pour the milk into a pot.
B. Mix the milk and yogurt starter.
C. Add some honey or fruit.
D. Cover the pot to keep it warm.
questions.analysis: 18．细节理解题。根据Step 1 “Pour the milk into a pot”可知第一步要把牛奶倒进锅里。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How long will you wait before the yogurt is ready?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The first pens were ________.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT true?
options: A. A fountain pen can hold ink inside it.
B. Ballpoint pen are good for writing in airplanes.
C. Fountain pens may leak ink.
questions.analysis: 28．推理判断题。根据“Later, a French company called Bic bought the Biros’ company.”可知，一家名为Bic的法国公司收购了Biros的公司，D表述错误，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the main idea of this passage?
options: A. We use pens and pencils every day.
B. There were many kinds of pens before ballpoint pens.
C. Pens and pencils are very useful inventions.
D. Pens were invented earlier than pencils.
questions.analysis: 29．主旨大意题。通读全文可知，本文主要介绍了钢笔和铅笔这两种发明的发展历史，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the fourth paragraph mainly tell us?
options: A. The cultural value of nut carving.
B. The knowledge craftsmen have to master.
C. The inheritor and his carving artworks.
questions.analysis: 40．段落大意题。根据“However, the craftsman also said that bringing this kind of artwork to life is not easy...craftsmen have to study each peach pit to carefully plan out their artwork.”可知将这种艺术品带到生活中并不容易，每个桃核都有自己特殊的纹理，工匠们必须研究每一个桃核，仔细设计他们的艺术品。所以第四段讲述了工匠们在雕刻时遇到的困难，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn about the passage?
options: A. Weifang nut carving goes back to the Ming Dynasty.
B. Tan thinks there could be more inheritors of nut carving.
C. More craftsmen now give up the tradition of passing down the skill.
D. Each peach pit has a flat surface and it’s easy to carve on it.
questions.analysis: 41．推理判断题。根据“Now, the number of inheritors is about 1,000. But I believe it could be bigger. More craftsmen now give up the tradition of passing down the skill only through the family and open it up to anyone who is interested in learning the skill,” （现在，继承人的数量约为1000人。但我相信它可以更大。现在越来越多的工匠放弃了只通过家庭传承技艺的传统，向任何有兴趣学习这项技艺的人开放）可推知谭认为应该有更多的坚果雕刻传承人。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What could be the best title for the passage?
options: C. Carving Artworks out of Nut
D. The History of Nut Carving
questions.analysis: 42．最佳标题题。根据“Many people may throw away the pits inside fruits after eating them, but inheritors of nut carving（核雕继承人）have turned them into artworks instead.”以及全文可知，本文主要介绍了一种特殊工艺——用坚果雕刻艺术品，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Xining to Lhasa Railway is called “the way to the sky” because ________.
options: A. most of it is over 4,000 meters
B. it gives travellers a feeling of flying
C. there are many high mountains along it
questions.analysis: 47．细节理解题。根据“It is the longest high altitude（海拔）train trip in the world and is named as ‘the way to the sky’. Most of the line is over 4,000 meters. ”可知，这是世界上最长的高海拔火车之旅，被称为“通往天空的道路”，大部分线路都超过4000米。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Mr. Green and his wife are planning a train trip from Chengdu to Kunming, they should pay ________ for their second-class tickets.
questions.analysis: 48．细节理解题。根据“Chengdu to Kunming Price: 487.5 yuan for a second class”可知，成都到昆明的二等座是每人487.5元，所以格林先生和他的妻子应该付975元，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: As for Chengdu to Kunming Railway, we can know that ______ .
options: A. it is about 2,000 kilometers long
B. it has been in service for 70 years
C. the geography along the line is special
questions.analysis: 49．细节理解题。根据“This line is called Geological Museum（地质博物馆）because of the special geography along the railway line.”可知，由于成都到昆明铁路沿线的特殊地理位置，这条线路被称为地质博物馆。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The railway from Lhasa to Rikaze makes it easier for travellers to see ________.
questions.analysis: 50．细节理解题。根据“It makes Tibet travel easier for travellers, especially those who want to see Mount Qomolangma, the highest mountain in the world.”可知，这使得游客在西藏旅行更加方便，尤其是那些想要参观世界最高峰珠穆朗玛峰的游客。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The three wonderful railway lines ________.
options: A. go across Tibet all the way
B. run from the east to the west of China
C. take us to enjoy the beauty of our motherland
questions.analysis: 51．细节理解题。根据“The 3 most wonderful train journeys provide the natural beauty of our motherland.”可知，三条最精彩的火车之旅展现了我们祖国的自然美景。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many river porpoises are living in Dongting Lake?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the weight of an adult Milu deer?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Migratory birds come to Dongting Lake in ________.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where did the flight MU9191 take off?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the main problem Côte d’Ivoire faces?
questions.analysis: 62．细节理解题。根据“He was living in Côte d’Ivoire, a country on the coast of West Africa, where plastic is a big environmental problem, compared with water and air pollution.”可知Côte d’Ivoire主要面对的是塑料污染，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn about Conceptos Plásticos?
options: A. It’s a company in West Africa.
B. It recycles plastic waste online.
C. It offers bricks for building the classrooms in Abidjan.
questions.analysis: 63．细节理解题。根据“In 2018, UNICEF built its first classrooms in Abidjan, using bricks produced in Colombia by Conceptos Plásticos.”可知它为在Abidjan建造教室提供砖块。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes the parents about their kids’ future in Paragraph 5?
questions.analysis: 64．推理判断题。根据“People couldn’t believe it at the beginning, that the classrooms were made of plastic. But now all the parents want their children in these classrooms.”（一开始人们不敢相信教室是用塑料做的。但是现在所有的父母都希望他们的孩子在这些教室里。）可知父母对孩子的未来很激动，期待他们都在这样的教室里，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many tons of plastic are needed to build a classroom?
questions.analysis: 65．细节理解题。根据“Kampo says it takes about five and a half tons of plastic and just a few weeks to build a classroom.”可知建造一间教室需要5.5吨塑料，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following would be the best title for the passage?
questions.analysis: 66．最佳标题题。根据全文可知，本文主要介绍了哥伦比亚公司Conceptos Plásticos回收塑料垃圾并将其制成砖块，用于建造学校和房屋的故事，所以A选项最符合，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did the magazine do about homework?
questions.analysis: 72．细节理解题。根据“ In order to know what kind of homework kids should do and how much kids need, the magazine interviewed several kids.”可知关于“家庭作业”，杂志做了一个采访。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who supports the idea of giving students homework?
questions.analysis: 73．细节理解题。根据Karen, 9 “Kids need homework.”可知Karen支持写家庭作业。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What will happen when homework is too much according to Paragraph 4?
options: A. Students will do no homework.
B. Students will do homework poorly.
C. Students will build a healthy mind and body.
questions.analysis: 74．细节理解题。根据“When there is too much homework, students do poorly in homework.”可知学生作业太多时，作业会做得很差。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is Robert’s opinion about homework?
options: A. Primary students don’t need to do homework.
B. High school students can do more homework.
C. Homework just repeats what is learned in class.
questions.analysis: 75．细节理解题。根据Robert, 8 “Middle and high school students can do more homework.”可知中学生和高中生可以做更多的家庭作业。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does “These” refer to（指代）in the last paragrapgh?
questions.analysis: 76．词句猜测题。根据“Besides, homework takes time away from activities like team sports. These are just as important as schoolwork, because they keep kids active.”可知家庭作业会占用团队运动等活动的时间，团队运动等活动和作业是同等重要的。划线部分“These”指代前文“activities like team sports”。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did Michael influence other teenagers?
questions.analysis: 91．细节理解题。根据“16-year-old Michael started using social media (to cheer up teenagers of his age to follow their dreams on his baseball blogs.”可知，16岁的迈克尔开始使用社交媒体鼓励同龄的青少年在他的棒球博客上追随他们的梦想。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did Lesein do to help fight climate change?
options: A. He started Trees for Goals and kept planting trees.
B. He followed soccer and basketball teams to plant trees.
C. He planted almost 1,000 bamboos outside of his school.
D. He used social media to call on other children to plant trees.
questions.analysis: 92．细节理解题。根据“With a deep love of soccer, Lesein started Trees for Goals, planting a tree for every goal he scored in a match. Later the school’s soccer and basketball teams all followed him.”可知，出于对足球的热爱，莱辛创立了“进球树”，他在比赛中每进一球就种一棵树，后来学校的足球队和篮球队都这样做。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following can be put in the ______ ▲ ?
options: A. a small dream can make a big change to the whole world
B. inventors can be everybody who’s ever tried to solve a problem
C. we all should start planting trees to make the earth a better place
D. you don’t have to be an inventor unless you are good enough
questions.analysis: 93．推理判断题。根据“People are dying because they can’t be saved in time. Another reason why I want to invent something is that I love physics and I use it to improve technologies.”可知，人们正在死去，因为他们不能被及时拯救。Alexis想发明一些东西的另一个原因是自己喜欢物理学，用它来改进技术。Alexis发明东西是为了解决问题，也想鼓励孩子发明家可以是任何试图解决问题的人，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the best title for this passage?
options: A. The Ways to Make a Difference
B. Teenagers Are the Future of the World
D. Teenagers Can Make Changes to the World
questions.analysis: 94．最佳标题题。本文介绍的是《Teen Vogue》采访的世界各地的一些有所作为的青少年，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The Double Ninth Festival is a celebration for ________.
questions.analysis: 95．细节理解题。根据“The Double Ninth Festival is a special day for elderly people in China”可知，重阳节是为老年人庆祝的节日。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following may NOT be a tradition for the Double Ninth Festival?
questions.analysis: 96．细节理解题。根据“families get together and climb mountains”以及“They also drink chrysanthemum wine (菊花酒) and wear a plant called zhuyu”可知在重阳节这天，家人聚在一起爬山，喝菊花酒并佩戴一种名为“茱萸”的植物；选项A没有提到。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is Paragraph 4 about?
options: A. Why we should respect elderly people.
B. Traditional ways of celebrating the festival.
C. What young people usually do on this festival.
D. Examples of respecting elderly people in daily life.
questions.analysis: 97．段落大意题。根据第四段“Respecting elderly people is shown not only on this special day but also in daily life”可知，第四段主要是一些人们在日常生活中尊重老年人的例子。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which is NOT the correct way to respect elderly people?
options: A. We should offer seats to the old while taking a bus.
B. We should sit straight when the old come into a room.
C. We should use double hands to present things to the old.
D. We should introduce the oldest person first while eating at the table.

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “soundly” probably mean?
questions.analysis: 193．词义猜测题。根据“This encourages you to fall asleep more quickly and sleep more soundly.”可知，能让你更快地入睡，睡得更香，所以划线单词与deeply词义相近，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which water temperature produces the best-quality sleep according to the study?
questions.analysis: 194．细节理解题。根据“A study in 2019 said that a water temperature of 40℃ to 42. 4℃ produces the best-quality（最优质的）sleep”可知，40到42℃的水温能产生最优质的睡眠，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In which part of a newspaper can you find the text?
questions.analysis: 195．推理判断题。通读全文，本文主要介绍了在睡觉前一小时左右洗一个热水澡能帮助人们睡觉，与健康有关，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who started the first zoo?
questions.analysis: 196．细节理解题。根据“The first zoo was started by a queen in Egypt in 1500 BC.”可知埃及的一位女王创办了第一个动物园。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How does the writer feel about the animals in the early zoos?
options: A. He doesn’t care about them.
B. He feels sad for them.
C. He is proud of them.
D. He is afraid of them.
questions.analysis: 197．推理判断题。根据“Sadly, the animals in the early zoos were not treated well. They didn’t receive enough attention or care.(可悲的是，早期动物园里的动物没有得到很好的对待。它们没有得到足够的关注和照顾。)”可推知作者为它们感到难过。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, zoos today must ________.
options: B. help look after family pets
C. provide health care for tourists
D. follow the rules to protect animals
questions.analysis: 198．细节理解题。根据“Today, zoos still bring people pleasure, but they try to protect animals and teach people as well. Zoos must follow rules...In this way, the rules help protect the animals.”可知现在的动物园要遵循规则去保护动物。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The phrase “disapproved of” in Paragraph 4 means “________”.
questions.analysis: 199．词句猜测题。根据“For example, people disapproved of the use of some large animals in shows. They thought the zoos didn’t have enough space for the animals to show.”可知一些人认为动物园没有足够的空间来展示动物，所以应是反对在表演中使用大型动物。划线部分“disapproved of”与C选项“反对”意思相近。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
options: B. Famous zoos around the world.
D. Zoos in the past and today.
questions.analysis: 200．主旨大意题。本文主要介绍了早期动物园以及如今的动物园的作用，但是我们还需做更多的事情来保护所爱的动物。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does “it” underlined in paragraph I refer to（指的是）?
questions.analysis: 201．词义猜测题。根据“In Dengfeng today, there are more than 50,000 students learning kung fu, a traditional art in China. They come to learn it for many reasons”可知，此处指学习功夫的原因有很多，所以it指代Kung fu，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does Hu Zhengsheng fear?
options: A. His students don’t respect him.
B. He cannot work at a large school.
C. His art cannot be passed down.
D. There aren’t enough kung fu teachers.
questions.analysis: 202．细节理解题。根据“Hu fears that his art will soon die out”可知，担心他的艺术很快就会消亡，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What has Hu done to attract new students’?
options: A. He has offered better living conditions.
B. He has given jobs to their parents.
C. He has promised them a better future.
D. He has made changes in his lessons.
questions.analysis: 203．细节理解题。根据“Recently, to attract new students, Hu has brought some changes into his kung fu lessons to make them lively and interesting”可知，为了吸引新学员，在功夫课上做了一些改变，使其生动有趣，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned in Paragraph 1?
options: A. Butterflies are a kind of insect.
B. Butterflies are good at flying.
D. Butterflies have a good sense of smell.
questions.analysis: 204．细节理解题。根据“Consider butterflies, for example. They have beautiful, colorful wings, and strong, fantastic flying skills. On summer days, you always see them flying freely over flower gardens and wild fields.(以蝴蝶为例。它们有美丽多彩的翅膀，以及强大而神奇的飞行技能。在夏天的日子里，你总能看到它们在花园和田野上自由地飞翔。)”可知第一段提到蝴蝶是一种昆虫，擅长飞行，有彩色的翅膀。并未提及蝴蝶的嗅觉很灵敏。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “caterpillar” in Paragraph 3 mean in Chinese?
questions.analysis: 205．词句猜测题。根据“It’s hard to believe that the egg will become something completely different in a few days. It becomes a walking insect. This insect is called caterpillar.”可知蛋变成了一只会走路的昆虫，叫作“caterpillar”，划线单词的含义为“毛毛虫”。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes a butterfly after the blanket breaks?
options: A. It has legs, eyes and a large body.
B. It has legs, eyes and a mouth.
C. It has six legs, a mouth, eyes and wings
D. It has legs, eyes, a mouth and a large body.
questions.analysis: 207．细节理解题。根据“After a period of time, the blanket breaks and a wet, weak butterfly appears. It now has six legs, a mouth, eyes and wings.”可知有六条腿，一张嘴，眼睛和翅膀。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can be the best title for the text?
questions.analysis: 208．最佳标题题。本文主要讲了蝴蝶生命中的四个阶段。B选项“一个昆虫，四个生命”为最佳标题。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many solar terms are there in winter?
questions.analysis: 209．细节理解题。根据“And there are six solar terms in winter.”可知，冬天有六个节气，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do people in the northern China usually have on beginning of winter?
questions.analysis: 210．细节理解题。根据“The northern China celebrates beginning of winter as the ‘Small Spring Festival’. People usually have dumplings and mutton soup on that day.”可知，通常在这一天吃饺子和羊肉汤，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When does heavy snow usually fall?
questions.analysis: 211．细节理解题。根据“Light snow usually falls on November 22nd or 23rd and heavy snow usually falls on December 7th or 8th.”可知，大雪通常在12月7日或8日，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
options: B. The solar terms in winter.
questions.analysis: 212．主旨大意题。根据“And there are six solar terms in winter. They are beginning of winter, light snow, heavy snow, winter solstice (冬至), lesser cold (小寒) and greater cold”可知，本文主要介绍了冬季的6个节气，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When did Spain first hold a celebration to honor Cervantes?
questions.analysis: 213．细节理解题。根据“In 1922,...Four years later, the first celebration took place on October 7, Cervantes’ birthday.”可知，第一次庆祝是在1926年，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What should a World Book Capital city do?
options: A. Help sell books to all ages.
C. Organize readers to visit the city.
questions.analysis: 214．细节理解题。根据“The task of the city is to carry out activities to encourage ‘a culture of reading and spreading its values in all ages in and out of the country.’”可知，世界图书之都的任务是开展活动，鼓励“一种阅读文化，并在国内外各个年龄段传播其价值观”。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “them” in Paragraph 3 refer to (指代)?
questions.analysis: 215．代词指代题。根据“Besides, listening to audiobooks(有声读物) was another rising habit, with 35. 5 percent of adults saying they were used to listening to them.”（此外，听有声书是另一个日益增长的习惯，35.5%的成年人表示他们习惯听有声书）可知，划线的them指的是上文提到的“有声书”，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the last paragraph mainly tell us?
options: A. The meaning of a Chinese saying.
B. The importance of reading books.
C. The method of getting life wisdom.
D. The way of looking into different worlds
questions.analysis: 216．段落大意题。根据“Reading books gives people the chance to look into different worlds and meet new people both real and imagined...”可知，本段主要讲述了读书的重要性，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The construction of Taihu Tunnel ______.
options: A. was divided into four parts
B. look more time than people had expected
C. started from the middle of the lake
D. was completed by using a streamlined method
questions.analysis: 218．细节理解题。根据“The construction of the 19 parts was streamlined...The construction took about four years to complete, shorter than people had expected”可知太湖隧道采用流线法施工完成。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from Paragraph 8?
options: A. Pictures in the tunnel can help keep drivers safe.
B. Drivers can control the LED lights in the tunnel.
C. The police can warn drivers through a monitoring system.
D. An audio system can help drivers check the traffic situation.
questions.analysis: 219．细节理解题。根据“The pictures can help drivers fight tiredness and travel through the tunnel safely”可知这些图片可以帮助司机克服疲劳，安全地通过隧道。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the passage?
options: A. To advise people to protect Taihu Tunnel.
B. To introduce the construction of Taihu Tunnel.
C. To share the advantages brought by Taihu Tunnel.
D. To tell the difficulties of constructing Taihu Tunnel.
questions.analysis: 220．主旨大意题。通读全文可知，本文主要介绍了太湖隧道的建造。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can AI do by knowing better about students?
options: B. Find out students’ learning speed.
C. Know more about learning favorites.
D. Offer proper personal learning plans.
questions.analysis: 221．细节理解题。根据“AI can know better about students…Then it can create a proper learning plan for each student.”可知，通过更好地了解学生，AI能够提供合适的个人学习计划。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How might students feel about educational games?
questions.analysis: 222．细节理解题。根据“Things like interactive learning apps and educational games can make subject learning more interesting. What’s more, they can make students interested in a subject at once.”可知，学生会觉得教育游戏很有趣。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why does the writer give an example of a biology textbook in Paragraph 5?
options: A. To show biology is easy to learn.
B. To describe something more about 3
C. To introduce a way of assessment.
D. To show AI can provide rich resources.
questions.analysis: 223．推理判断题。根据“Greater resources (资源): …For example, a biology textbook with AI technology may provide interactive 3D models of a human body”可知，作者以生物课本为例，来说明本段的中心：AI可以提供丰富的资源。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the best title (标题) for this passage?
options: A. AI—a smart help for learning
C. AI is much better than a teacher
questions.analysis: 224．最佳标题题。通读全文，重点结合首段和尾段可知，本文介绍了人工智能对学生学习的多方面帮助，A项适合做标题。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The example in Paragraph 2 is to ________.
questions.analysis: 225．推理判断题。根据“Well, maybe it’s time to introduce yourself to the power of ‘yet’. By adding this simple word, you can change everything.”和“I read about a school that has changed the way it marks its students’ exams. The school find out that the old pass/ fail system wasn’t helping students’ motivation(积极性)...They haven’t reached the end, but they know that they are going the right way.”可知第二段通过介绍“然而”的运用，可以改变成绩不合格的学生思维方式，以此来证明作者的观点。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, which one of the following has “a growth mindset”?
options: A. Jack got an “A” in the exam. He was quite happy to tell his parents.
B. David failed in a competition, but he stays confident and keeps trying.
C. Jenny found it hard to work out the maths problem, so she gave it up.
D. Emma was refused by school team. She didn’t want to have another try.
questions.analysis: 226．推理判断题。根据“They aren’t worried by not getting things right the first time and are happy to keep trying until they do.(他们不会担心第一次就做不对，而且乐于不断尝试，直到做对为止。)”可知B选项“大卫在一场比赛中失败了，但他保持着自信并不断努力。”中的大卫具有“成长心态”。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following can be put into ________?
options: A. Experts will help you grow up healthily in mind
B. You can train yourself to develop a growth mindset
C. Everyone has his own advantages and disadvantages
D. You can change everything by adding the small word “yet”
questions.analysis: 227．推理判断题。根据“Clearly, it is better to have a growth mindset than a fixed mindset.”和“But don’t worry if you think that you have a fixed mindset.”可知此处内容和“成长心态”相关，B选项“你可以训练自己培养成长心态”符合语境。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following can be the best title for the passage?
options: D. On the Way to Success
questions.analysis: 228．最佳标题题。本文讲述了Yet“然而”是一个很有分量的词，且在我们成长过程中起着重要的作用。选项A“‘然而’的力量”为最佳标题。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the writer’s purpose of writing the passage?
options: A. To introduce a helpful program.
B. To show us how to do farm work.
C. To praise some students from city.
D. To tell us knowledge about farming.
questions.analysis: 229．推理判断题。根据“From now on, more Beijing middle school students will have a similar experience. More than 5,500 students from 13 city middle schools will take part in a one-week farm work program in the autumn and spring, according to the Beijing Municipal Education Commission.”可知，作者写这篇文章的目的是为了介绍一个有用的计划，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Lin Ruohan thought the farm work was _________.
questions.analysis: 230．细节理解题。根据“Lin Ruohan, 13thought the work was hard, but she a felt it was very enjoyable.”可知，林若涵认为这份工作很辛苦，但她觉得很享受，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where can you probably read the passage?
questions.analysis: 231．推理判断题。根据整个文章的理解可知，主要是介绍中学将在秋季和春季参加为期一周的农活计划，以及学生们的感受，应该是在报纸上能看到这篇文章，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The Global School Community plans to ________.
options: A. make every child aware of the meanings of reading
B. bring digital books to all children and their families
C. offer chances for teachers to teach all over the world
D. build up the confidence of the children from poor areas
questions.analysis: 232．细节理解题。根据“the Global School Community aims to bring digital books to all the children of the world and their families”可知全球学校社区旨在将数字图书带给世界上所有的儿童及其家庭。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following best explains the underlined word “inexpensive” in Paragraph 2?
questions.analysis: 233．词义猜测题。根据“It can reach across the world and is fairly inexpensive”可知它可以覆盖世界各地，而且相当便宜，故此处划线部分意为“便宜的”。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does Paragraph 3 mainly talk about?
options: A. E-books help readers learn and make progress.
B. E-books provide knowledge and information.
C. E-books improve communication skills a lot.
D. E-books have more advantages than printed ones.
questions.analysis: 234．主旨大意题。根据“The first books a child reads can have a great influence on that child...”以及本段内容可知电子书对孩子有很大的影响，帮助读者学习和进步。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The writer writes the passage to .
options: A. introduce a new way to see the outside world
B. help connect all the schools around the world
C. invite us to join the Global School Community
D. explain the history and development of e-books
questions.analysis: 235．主旨大意题。本文主要介绍了全球2.5亿小学适龄儿童没有基本的阅读和写作技能，为了解决这个问题，全球学校社区旨在将数字图书带给世界上所有的儿童及其家庭，所以作者写这篇文章是为了邀请读者参加全球学校社区。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who could study in the earliest boarding schools?
questions.analysis: 236．细节理解题。根据“The earliest boarding schools were set up for white, rich boys only.”可知最早的寄宿学校只为有钱的白人男孩开办。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What should students in the boarding schools do according to Paragraph 2?
questions.analysis: 237．细节理解题。根据“Each student has his or her subject plan.”可知每个学生都有自己的科目计划。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined part “light out” mean in Chinese?
questions.analysis: 238．词义猜测题。根据“So when it’s time to go to bed, all the lights in the bedrooms are turned off.”可知到了睡觉的时候，卧室里所有的灯都关了，故此处划线部分意为“熄灯”。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn about the school uniform?
options: A. Boys hardly follow the rules.
B. Girls only wear a white blouse.
C. Boys never wear a shirt and a tie.
D. Girls sometimes wear a tie and a skirt.
questions.analysis: 239．细节理解题。根据“girls wear a white blouse, sometimes also a tie and a skirt.”可知女孩们穿白色上衣，有时还打领带和穿裙子。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the last paragraph mainly talk about?
questions.analysis: 240．主旨大意题。根据“In the UK, boarding schools provide students with delicious food...”以及本段内容可知最后一段主要介绍了寄宿学校的饮食，即吃什么。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many toy mascots were sold during the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympic Games?
questions.analysis: 241．细节理解题。根据“More than 1.4 million toy mascots were sold during the Games”可知奥运会期间售出了140多万个玩具吉祥物。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What made Hua Hua so popular among the visitors?
options: A. This year’s May Day holidays.
B. The growing ticket sales in 2023.
C. Her inability to climb trees and friendly character.
D. The different products in cultural and creative shops.
questions.analysis: 242．细节理解题。根据“has caught the hearts of visitors because she can’t climb trees and she is friendly”可知因为她不会爬树，而且她很友好，所以她很受欢迎。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why do so many young people visit Chengdu?
options: A. To buy products about pandas.
B. To see the giant pandas.
C. To trade products with the Base.
D. To celebrate Hua Hua’s birthday.
questions.analysis: 243．细节理解题。根据“many young people travel to Chengdu just to see the giant pandas”可知许多年轻人去成都只是为了看大熊猫。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What products about pandas are mentioned in Paragraph 3?
questions.analysis: 244．细节理解题。根据“Clothing, shoes, hats, feed seeds about pandas in the shops have also sold well.”可知有关熊猫的衣服、鞋子、帽子、饲料种子等也卖得很好。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which can be the best title for the passage?
options: A. Things Sold Well during the Holidays
C. People in China Celebrated the May Day
D. Hua Hua Increased the “Giant Panda Economy”
questions.analysis: 245．最佳标题题。本文主要介绍了熊猫非常受欢迎，而且在今年五一期间，很多人去成都看熊猫花花，“大熊猫经济”再次成为消费的亮点，以选项D“花花大力促进‘大熊猫经济’”为标题最合适。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many ways can we use to lower stress?
questions.analysis: 246．细节理解题。根据表格内容可知，文章一共提到了五个方法。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we do if we feel disappointed?
options: A. We can go to bed.
B. We can call our friends.
C. We can walk on the playground.
D. We can write down our problems.
questions.analysis: 247．细节理解题。根据“When we feel uneasy or disappointed, we can put problems into words. Keeping a diary is a good way to relax.”可知当我们感到不安或失望时，我们可以用语言表达问题。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we choose to do if we feel sad or angry?
options: D. To read our favorite books.
questions.analysis: 248．细节理解题。根据“If we get angry, music has a wonderful influence on our feelings. When we feel sad, it fills our hearts with warmth.”可知当我们生气或伤心时，可以听音乐。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which way can help us calm down before having a test?
questions.analysis: 249．细节理解题。根据“When we get nervous or upset before a test, take a few deep breaths”可知考试之前，可以深呼吸。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the main idea of the passage?
options: A. It talks about our stress.
B. It tells us how to exercise.
C. It talks about our daily life.
D. It tells us how to lower stress.
questions.analysis: 250．主旨大意题。根据“But there are many useful ways to lower stress”可知本文主要介绍了一些可以减轻压力的有用的方法。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Most animals move from one place to another at a certain time to ________.
questions.analysis: 255．细节理解题。根据“Most of them move to find food more easily”可知大多数动物在特定的时间从一个地方移动到另一个地方，以便更容易地获得食物。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The fish called “salmon” spends a long life in ________.
questions.analysis: 256．细节理解题。根据“This fish is born in fresh water but it travels many miles to salt water. There it spends most of its life. ”可知鲑鱼在咸水中度过了很长的一生。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The mice in the north of Europe move when ________.
options: B. there is not enough food
C. their living place gets too crowded
questions.analysis: 257．细节理解题。根据“In the north of Europe, there is a kind of mice. They leave their mountain homes when their homes become too crowded.”可知欧洲北部的老鼠在它们生活的地方太拥挤时就会离开。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where do the special lobsters go according to the passage?
questions.analysis: 258．细节理解题。根据“Nobody knows where they go.”可知没有人知道它们去哪儿，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the main idea of the passage?
options: A. Animals move from one place to another because they like to travel.
B. The migration of the fish called “salmon” is the most famous.
C. Animals move from one place to another for different reasons.
D. Animals move in order to find food more easily.
questions.analysis: 259．主旨大意题。根据“Birds, fish and other animals move from one place to another at a certain time. They move for different reasons. Most of them move to find food more easily, but others move to get away from places that are too crowded.”以及文章可知，本文主要讲述了动物出于不同的原因从一个地方迁移到另一个地方。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from every failure according to the passage?
questions.analysis: 260．细节理解题。根据“However, we can learn something valuable from every failure (失败).”可知可以从失败中学到一些有价值的事情。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the Chinese meaning of the underlined word “scary” in Paragraph 3?
questions.analysis: 261．词句猜测题。根据“Losing is not very scary. So don’t be afraid.”可知不要害怕，是因为失败并不可怕。划线词“scary”意为“可怕的”。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT true according to the passage?
options: A. We should accept and learn from our failure.
B. We should remember our failure all the time.
C. We should take action to walk out of failure.
D. We should think about how to improve when we lose.
questions.analysis: 262．细节理解题。根据“We must accept our failure and learn something from it.(我们必须接受我们的失败，并从中吸取教训。)”；“Take action to walk out of it.(采取行动走出失败。)”和“When we lose, think about what we did and how we can improve.(我们输了的时候，想想我们做了什么以及如何改进。)”可知文中并未提及“我们应该时刻记住我们的失败”。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the writer advise the losers to do after a competition?
questions.analysis: 263．细节理解题。根据“If we offer our congratulations to the winners and share their happiness, we won’t feel sorry for our failure.”可知我们向获奖者表示祝贺并分享他们的快乐。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the best title for the passage?
options: B. Advantages of both Success and Failure
C. Ideas about How to Avoid Mistakes
D. Advice on How to Be a Good Loser
questions.analysis: 264．最佳标题题。本文主要讲述了失败对于我们的好处，以及如何应对失败。D选项“如何成为一个好的失败者”为最佳标题。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “boost” in Paragraph 2mean?
questions.analysis: 277．词句猜测题。分析“Now experts in the US have found that a good conversation just once a day could be enough to boost people’s happiness and lower their stress levels.”可知，现在，美国专家发现，每天一次愉快的交谈就足以提高人们的幸福感，降低压力水平。此处boost的意思是“提高”，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How can we lower our stress according to Paragraph 3?
options: B. By pointing out others’ mistakes.
C. By talking about our school trip yesterday.
questions.analysis: 278．推理判断题。根据“These included things like sharing jokes, listening to others’ opinions, discussing recent experiences, offering real praise and showing care for others.”可知，分享笑话、倾听别人的意见、讨论最近的经历、给予真正的赞美和关心别人可以降低压力，选项C“通过谈论我们昨天的学校旅行”符合，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we infer (推断) from the researcher’s words in Paragraph 4?
options: A. Exchanging ideas with others is useful.
B. Different conversations have different influences.
C. The number of daily chats can influence our mood.
questions.analysis: 279．细节理解题。根据“The researchers also looked at how the number of daily chats affected the people’s well-being. And they found that while one good chat was enough to improve someone’s mood, those who chose to have more of these conversations had better days.”可知，研究人员还研究了每天聊天的次数如何影响人们的幸福感。他们发现虽然一次愉快的聊天足以改善一个人的情绪，但那些选择进行更多此类交谈的人日子过得更好。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the text mainly about?
options: A. Good chats improve our mood.
B. The change of mood is very important.
C. Five types of conversation affect our mood.
questions.analysis: 280．主旨大意题。本文介绍沟通交流是如何影响一个人的身心健康的，结合“Now experts in the US have found that a good conversation just once a day could be enough to boost people’s happiness and lower their stress levels.”可知，每天一次愉快的交谈就足以提高人们的幸福感，降低压力水平。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When was the new live-action film made?
questions.analysis: 281．推理判断题。根据“The character, Hua Mulan, introduces Chinese culture to the world in Disney’s 1998 cartoon movie”和“I’m glad that the new film has included this important point, showing that after twenty years.”可知，新的真人电影是2018年拍摄的，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “it” in Paragraph 3 refer to?
questions.analysis: 282．推理判断题。根据“When you check the 1998 cartoon, Mulan was described as a fighter for women’s rights, but it missed the point, as the original (最初的) story was mainly about traditional family value.”可知，当你查看1998年的动画时，木兰被描述为女权斗士，但它没有抓住重点，因为最初的故事主要是关于传统家庭价值的。此处it指1998年的动画，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from Alex’s words?
options: A. Westerners think it’s difficult to understand Chinese culture.
B. The 1998 cartoon was mainly about the traditional family value.
C. Westerners can understand Chinese culture better through the new film.
questions.analysis: 283．推理判断题。根据“I’m glad that the new film has included this important point, showing that after twenty years. Westerners now have a better understanding of Chinese culture”可知，我很高兴这部新电影包含了这一点，表明二十年后，西方人现在对中国文化有了更好的了解。由此可知，通过这部新电影，西方人可以更好地了解中国文化。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the best title for the text?
questions.analysis: 284．最佳标题题。本文介绍了花木兰这一角色在西方人眼中20年来的变化，结合“She becomes a world star.”可知，选项A“花木兰，世界明星”符合主题，故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which statement is Wrong about Song the of Seven Sons-Macao based on this passage?
options: A. It was written by Wen Yiduo.
C. Teenagers in Macao know the song.
D. It’s a piece of folk music.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How long has The Basic Law of Macao Special Administrative Region worked?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why is Guangdong a good place to go for people in Macao according to the passage?

questions.analysis: 287．细节理解题。根据“Guangdong is also a good choice since the language and food are similar.”可知广东也是个不错的选择，因为语言和食物都很相似。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.analysis: 288．细节理解题。根据“Like the young people on the mainland, they also use apps from the mainland”可知像大陆的年轻人一样，他们也使用来自大陆的应用程序。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the best title of this passage?
options: A. The Most Popular Places for Young People on the Mainland
B. The Daily Life of Young People in Macao
C. The Famous Song, Song of the Seven Sons-Macao
D. Macao, Staying Connected with the Mainland
questions.analysis: 289．最佳标题题。本文主要介绍了自从澳门回归后，澳门和大陆的联系越来越紧密，以选项D“澳门，与内地保持联系”为标题最合适。故选D。

questions.prompt: Which of the following words can best describe Gan Yu?
questions.analysis: 290．推理判断题。根据“On September 5, 2022, when an earthquake hit Luding, Sichuan, 28-year-old hydropower station (水电站) worker Gan Yu chose not to leave but stay at his workplace, saving villages downstream from being flooded.”可知水电站施工技术员甘宇在地震中依旧坚守水电站，可推知他是很负责任的。故选A。

questions.prompt: Why did Zeng Qiangfei become a volunteer when he grew up?
options: A. Because he wanted local people to thank him.
B. Because he was quite moved by Gan Yu’s story.
C. Because he learned about volunteering at school.
D. Because he was influenced greatly by volunteers.
questions.analysis: 291．细节理解题。根据“Zeng remembered seeing rescuers (救援者) and volunteers gather there to help. When he grew up, he became a volunteer himself.”可知，是因为他深受志愿者的影响，长大以后自己也成了一名志愿者。故选D。

questions.prompt: Which one of the statements below is a fact according to the passage?
options: A. Gan Yu is a hero like Lei Feng.
C. Lei Feng’s hometown is in Hunan.
D. Edginton is a “foreign Lei Feng”.
questions.analysis: 292．细节理解题。根据“This view is shared by a 56-year-old British man named James Elroy Edginton, who lives in Hunan, the hometown of Lei Feng.”可知，雷锋的故乡在湖南。故选C。

questions.analysis: 293．推理判断题。本文通过例举三个人帮助他人的经历，介绍了“雷锋精神”。故选B。

B. The spirit of Lei Feng never dies
C. The stories of young heroes

questions.prompt: What happened last summer in the passage?
options: A. The world faced the highest temperatures in history.
B. Some infectious diseases broke out (爆发) in Europe.
C. Huge heat waves swept across European countries and parts of China.
D. Many people died because of heat waves.
questions.analysis: 300．细节理解题。根据“Huge heat waves (热浪) swept across European countries and parts of China.”可知，巨大的热浪席卷了欧洲国家和中国部分地区，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined phrase “pass out” probably means ________ in Chinese.
questions.analysis: 302．词句猜测题。分析“If people stay in high temperatures for too long, the heat will harm their bodies and make people feel sick, pass out or even die.”可知，如果人们在高温中待得太久，热量会伤害他们的身体，此处pass out介于恶心和死亡之间，选项D“晕倒”符合语境，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What might cause the extreme weather event according to the passage?
questions.analysis: 303．细节理解题。根据“What caused the extreme weather event? Scientists said climate change was likely to be the reason.”可知，是什么导致了极端天气事件？科学家表示，气候变化可能是原因之一。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the passage mainly about?
options: A. Countries and organizations are looking for ways to deal with climate change.
B. Heat waves brought serious problems and countries and organizations are trying to solve them.
C. High temperatures can bring people many health problems.
D. Many foreign countries have achieved their goals of net-zero emissions so far.
questions.analysis: 304．主旨大意题。本文主要介绍巨大的热浪带来的问题以及各国和各组织为此所做的努力，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who are the super heroes in the two stories?
options: C. Emperor Yan and the Eastern Sea.
questions.analysis: 305．细节理解题。根据“Jingwei Tries to Fill up the Sea”和“Robinson Crusoe”可知故事中的两个超级英雄分别是精卫和鲁滨逊·克鲁索。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did people call the beautiful bird “Jingwei”?
options: A. Because she cried sadly in the sound “Jingwei”.
B. Because her father gave her the name “Jingwei”.
C. Because the name of the mountain where she lived was”Jingwei”.
questions.analysis: 306．细节理解题。根据“She cried sadly in the sound ‘Jingwei, Jingwei’. That was why people called her ‘Jingwei’.”可知是因为发出“精卫、精卫”的悲鸣声，所以人们称之为“精卫”。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Robinson ________ with his knife in the passage.
options: B. killed animals and birds for food
C. cut down trees to build a house
questions.analysis: 307．细节理解题。根据“He used the knife to cut down trees and built a house.”可知鲁滨逊用刀砍倒了树，盖了一所房子。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which of the following statement is TRUE?
options: A. The sea thought Jingwei did the meaningful thing.
B. Jingwei decided to fill up the sea with stones and branches.
C. Robinson had some food and tools when he first arrived on the island.
questions.analysis: 308．细节理解题。根据“Every day, she flew between the mountain and the sea, carrying a stone or a tree branch from the mountain and dropping it into the sea.”可知精卫用石头和树枝来填海。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The two stories show that people should ________ to reach their goals.
questions.analysis: 309．主旨大意题。根据“Jingwei replied, ‘I’ll fill you up no doubt! I will, even if it will take me thousands of years! I’ll fight on without taking a rest.’”和“When Robinson first arrived on the island, he had nothing...He lived on the island for many years and he was saved finally.”可知，本文通过介绍《精卫填海》和《鲁滨逊漂流记》的故事内容，告诉我们要永不放弃。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the purpose of the new VR experience?
options: A. To describe children’s reactions to fire disasters.
B. To teach children to save themselves in a fire.
C. To introduce ways of avoiding a fire to children.
D. To increase children’s interest in VR experiences.
questions.analysis: 310．细节理解题。根据“The new VR experience was developed by the University of South Australia, hoping to educate children to learn how to be safe in a fire.”可知，这种虚拟现实体验是希望能教育孩子们学习如何在火灾中保持安全。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From the findings, what’s the children’s attitude (态度) towards the new VR experience?
questions.analysis: 311．推理判断题。根据“The findings showed that over 80% of children could calmly tell the advantages and disadvantages of different choices. They also learned to make wise decisions to protect themselves from a fire. Children thought it especially important and meaningful, because 91% of them didn’t have knowledge of fires at the beginning, and 67% had said that they were too young to make safety decisions in a fire.”可知，本段通过例举数据，介绍了很多孩子们认为这特别重要和有意义，应是持支持态度。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: From Para. 3, we mainly get to know the ________ of the new VR experience.
questions.analysis: 313．细节理解题。根据“said Delene Weber, one of the researchers. ‘Well-designed VR can provide children with surprisingly valuable learning tools.’”和“‘Children don’t need to be always waiting for help in disasters. With these VR experiences, we can make children understand the risks and realize they can help,’ said Weber.”可知，本段主要介绍了虚拟现实体验的益处。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, which of the following is TRUE?
options: A. Children make no difference in the fire safety at their homes.
B. VR experiences are mainly designed for children in high school.
C. Well-designed VR can offer children amazingly valuable learning tools.
D. 91% of children believed they weren’t old enough to make safety decisions.
questions.analysis: 314．细节理解题。根据“Well-designed VR can provide children with surprisingly valuable learning tools.”可知，精心设计的虚拟现实体验可以为孩子们提供非常有价值的学习工具。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did we mainly use single bamboo drifting for in ancient times?
options: C. A form of traditional art.
questions.analysis: 315．细节理解题。根据“In the past, the ancestors who lived on the bank of the Chishui River used it as a method to go across the river.”可知，在过去，生活在赤水河畔的祖先们把“独竹漂”作为渡河的一种方法，也就是一种交通方式。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “demanding” probably mean in Chinese?
questions.analysis: 316．词句猜测题。根据“While keeping balance on the narrow bamboo pole with the thin stick, the athletes are performing skills and tricks. Jumping, push-ups, and splits（劈叉）are some of the most common ones, whereas those who are more experienced often use their imagination to try out more difficult moves.”可知，运动员们一边用细棍在狭窄的竹竿上保持平衡，一边表演技巧和窍门。跳跃、俯卧撑和劈叉是一些最常见的动作，而那些更有经验的人经常用他们的想象力来尝试更困难的动作。由此可知，这项运动的要求很简单，但是要求非常的高。demanding在此意为“严苛的”。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why is a stick needed in single bamboo drifting?
options: A. To try out difficult moves.
questions.analysis: 317．细节理解题。根据“But there’s more than just guiding. While keeping balance on the narrow bamboo pole with the thin stick”可知，运动员不仅需要用棍子来引导竹竿顺流漂移，而且还要用它在狭窄的竹竿上保持平衡。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do we know about Yang Liu?
options: A. She was a fairy with magical power.
B. She kept practicing for over 10 years.
C. She was good at the skill from the start.
D. She didn’t like the traditional art.
questions.analysis: 318．细节理解题。根据“For over ten years, combining drifting with dancing, Yang has put fresh energy into this traditional art.”和“So not surprisingly, Yang has experienced countless falls and failures.”可知，十多年来，杨将独竹漂与舞蹈结合在一起，为这项传统艺术注入了新的活力。杨经历了无数次跌倒和失败，这并不奇怪。由此可知，杨苦练了十多年。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What mainly made single bamboo drifting famous around the world?
options: A. The spread of sports spirits.
C. The popularity of Chinese festivals.
D. The continuous efforts of generations.
questions.analysis: 319．推理判断题。根据“It also represents single bamboo drifting（独竹漂）, an intangible cultural heritage（非物质文化遗产）passed from generation to generation among the people in Guizhou Province.”可知，独竹漂是贵州人民代代相传下来的非物质文化遗产。因此，独竹漂得以闻名于世是因为一代又一代人的不懈努力。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why were there no weekends in ancient times?
options: A. Because ancient people were more hard-working than modern ones.
B. Because ancient people didn’t use a weekly calendar.
C. Because the emperors didn’t allow their people to have a rest.
D. Because ancient people wanted to make more money.
questions.analysis: 320．细节理解题。根据“In ancient China, there were no weekends because people did not use a weekly calendar.”可知，在中国古代，没有周末，因为人们不使用周历。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many ways are mentioned to stay cool in ancient China in the passage?
questions.analysis: 321．细节理解题。根据“People collected ice blocks in winter and stored them in an icehouse. When summer came, people could take the ice blocks home and use them to make their rooms cooler. There was a kind of pillow (枕头) made of porcelain (瓷器) that felt pleasantly cool. Ancient people also made bamboo into bed mats (垫子) to sleep on.”可知，文章提到了三种中国古代保持凉爽的方法，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did people in ancient times keep takeout dishes warm?
options: A. They put hot water between plates.
B. They lit candles under the dishes.
C. They covered the dishes with thick cloth.
D. They walked fast to deliver (送) the dishes.
questions.analysis: 322．细节理解题。根据“They also used warming plates made of two layers (层) of porcelain. Hot water could be put between them to keep dishes warm.”可知，他们还使用由两层瓷器制成的加热板，可以在它们之间放热水来保持盘子的温暖。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题13 阅读理解 考点3 说明文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, which of the following is TRUE?
options: A. In ancient China, people like farmers and businessmen worked all year round.
B. Ancient people used bed mats made of silk to stay cool.
C. Along the River During the Qingming Festival was painted in Song Dynasty.
D. Modern people still have the same lifestyles as ancient people.
questions.analysis: 323．细节理解题。根据“In the famous Song Dynasty painting Along the River During the Qingming Festival”可知，《清明上河图》绘于宋代，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What will Bill most probably write in his diary?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “viral” in Paragraph 2 mean?
questions.analysis: 41．词句猜测题。分析“ He thought it was meaningful, so he helped. After he posted a short video online, it went viral. He won thousands of followers.”可知，他认为这很有意义，所以他帮忙了。他在网上发布了一段短视频后，赢得了成千上万的追随者。所以是在网上走红了，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the passage?
options: A. Du Yi is believed to be the best miniature artist in China.
B. People who need miniature houses want to live in the past.
C. Miniature artists make a lot of money by posting videos online.
D. Du Yi’s excellent skills and hard work are helpful for his success.
questions.analysis: 42．推理判断题。根据“It usually takes him one to two months to make a model with the pictures provided by customers. Hundreds of small pieces and about 50 different materials, including wood, paper, and materials straight from nature are used. He often visits the villages to take a closer look at the details. He can spend the whole week studying one building, trying to understand the story, shapes and colors.”可知，Du Yi通常需要一到两个月的时间根据客户提供的图片制作一个模型。数百个小碎片和大约50种不同的材料，包括木材、纸张和直接来自大自然的材料。他经常走访村庄，仔细观察细节。他可以花整整一周的时间研究一栋建筑，试图理解它的故事、形状和颜色。所以他出色的技术和勤奋的工作有助于他的成功。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In which part of a newspaper can you probably read this passage?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Kendall spends much time in the garden to _______.

B. play games with her family there

D. enjoy growing food with her family and friends

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The underlined word “it” in Paragraph 2 refers to _________.
options: A. digging the small potatoes in the field
B. putting the small potatoes in the ground
C. watering the small potatoes in the garden

questions.analysis: 49．细节理解题。根据“Grandma told her. ‘Don’t throw away the small ones, because if you put them in the ground, they will grow back.’ Kendall tried it and was amazed when the small potatoes grew new leaves.”可知，Kendall试了试把小土豆埋在地里，当小土豆长出新叶时，她感到很惊讶，所以“it”指代的是“把小土豆埋在地里”这件事情，故选B。

questions.prompt: How many problems about kerosene lamps are mentioned according to Paragraph 2?
questions.analysis: 88．细节理解题。根据“First, it can cause illnesses such as coughs. Also, the light can hurt people’s eyes. Besides, it can lead to fires. Lastly, kerosene is expensive, so families have less money for food.”可知，首先，它会导致咳嗽等疾病。此外，光线会伤害人们的眼睛。此外，它还可能导致火灾。最后，煤油很贵，所以家庭买食物的钱更少。因此，文章一共提到使用煤油灯的4个问题。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why does the writer give Julia’s example in Paragraph 5?
questions.analysis: 90．推理判断题。根据“Thousands of people had safe light. Julia, a mother of three, said, ‘Thanks to Evans, my children have light to read, and I have my own light to cook.’ The solar lamps made a big difference.”可知，成千上万的人有安全的照明。Julia是三个孩子的母亲，她说：“多亏了Evans，我的孩子们有了读书的灯，我也有了做饭的灯。”太阳能灯起到了很大的作用。举Julia的例子是为了说明Evans的发明创造给人们带来的影响。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is Evans like according to the passage?
questions.analysis: 91．推理判断题。通读本文可知，Evans在艰苦的学习环境下还上了大学，说明他非常勤奋，他为了解决使用煤油灯带来的一系列问题，发明创造了太阳能灯，说明他富有创造性，他想方设法降低太阳能灯的制作成本，让穷人也能用得上太阳能灯，说明他富有爱心。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

D. Because he wanted to ask for information.
questions.analysis: 92．细节理解题。根据“A young man with excellent grades wanted to get a job in a big company. He met the manager for the interview.”可知是因为年轻人想找份工作。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did the young man’s parents do?
questions.analysis: 93．细节理解题。根据“They work as clothes cleaners.”可知年轻人的父母是衣服清洁工。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did the manager ask the young man to do after going home?
options: B. To talk with his parents.
D. To clean his parents’ hands.
questions.analysis: 94．细节理解题。根据“Now go home and clean your parents’ hands, then see me tomorrow morning.”可知经理让年轻人回去给父母洗手。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we infer (推断) from the last paragraph?

B. The young man failed the interview.

D. The manager was angry with the young man.
questions.analysis: 95．推理判断题。根据“The manager smiled and said, ‘This is what I’m looking for.’(经理微笑着说：“这就是我要找的。”)”可知年轻人知道了父母为他的学业所付出的艰辛，并因此得到了这份工作。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the text mainly tell us?

B. We should learn to be thankful.

D. It’s hard to get a job in a big company.
questions.analysis: 96．主旨大意题。本文的主旨是教育我们作为子女要懂得感恩父母为我们所付出的艰辛。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is “Lunch Money” used for?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the best title（标题） for the text?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do we know about Lu Hong when he was young?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did Lu Hong make his shop successful?
options: A. By giving a good first impression.
B. By taking pictures for free.
C. By improving skills and service.
questions.analysis: 122．细节理解题。根据“ Thanks to his skills and hard work, Lu impressed his customers and his shop’s business grew stronger.”可知，由于他的技能和努力工作，陆给他的顾客留下了深刻的印象，他的商店生意越来越好，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did Lu Hong offer jobs to the disabled?
questions.analysis: 123．细节理解题。根据“It’s not easy for people with disabilities to find work. I hope to provide them with an opportunity to realize their full ability and go for their life goals”可知，残疾人找工作不容易。他希望为他们提供一个机会，让他们充分发挥自己的能力，实现自己的人生目标，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did Lu Hong do during epidemic?
options: A. He didn’t pay the workers.
C. He tried his best to save the company.
D. He guarded the factory with the workers.
questions.analysis: 124．细节理解题。根据“During the epidemic, the factory was forced to close for a while, but he kept on paying salaries (工资) to the workers as he guarded the empty factory alone.He bought machinery and equipment worth nearly 5 million yuan ($726,000) to make sure production when his staff could not come to work.”（在疫情期间，工厂被迫关闭了一段时间，但他一个人守着空荡荡的工厂，继续给工人发工资，他购买了价值近500万元(72.6万美元)的机器和设备，以确保员工不能上班时的生产）可知，疫情期间他尽了最大的努力挽救公司，故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what kind of person is Lu Hong?
questions.analysis: 125．推理判断题。通读全文可知，陆鸿小时候患有脑瘫，但是他并未一蹶不振而是靠自己的努力创办了自己的照相馆，说明他有坚强的意志力；除此之外他还凭借自己的技能和努力，将自己的小作坊发展成为一个正规的公司，根据“Lu Hong’s factory is a celebrated company that has made a great contribution (贡献) to supporting the poor and providing jobs for the disabled. ”可知，他有社会责任感，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why was the rich man surprised by his dream?
options: B. God got only two bananas.
C. God liked the bananas very much.
questions.analysis: 126．细节理解题。根据“In his dream, God visited him and said, ‘The two bananas you gave me were very good.’ The rich man woke up suddenly and was surprised by his dream.”可知，在他的梦里，上帝来探望他，对他说：“你给我的两根香蕉很好’。富人突然醒了，被自己的梦吓了一跳。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we say about the rich man?
options: A. He planted banana trees for God.
B. He asked others to help the villagers.
C. He offered the children a place to get educated.
questions.analysis: 127．细节理解题。根据“He gave away food, clothes and money to the poor, and he even built a school for the children.”可知，他向穷人分发食物、衣服和钱，他甚至为孩子们建了一所学校。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the change of the village?
options: A. Asking the rich for help is useful.
B. Being kind to others makes us happy.
C. Giving more bananas to God is helpful.
questions.analysis: 129．推理判断题。根据“His kind actions inspired others to do the same. Great changes took place in the whole village soon. Everyone was happy, and there was no more poverty. They learned that the true path (道路) to happiness was through kindness.”可知，富人的善举激励其他人也这样做，整个村子很快发生了巨大的变化，每个人都很快乐，再也没有贫穷了，他们了解到通往幸福的真正途径是通过善良。所以善待他人使我们快乐，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who paid for the author?
questions.analysis: 130．细节理解题。根据“When I finally reached the station, the toll station worker told me that the person in front had paid for me and I was free to go. ”可知，一个好心的陌生人帮忙作者付了钱。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题12 阅读理解 考点2 记叙文（第01期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did the author pay forward the toll?
